tei:div.tei:p: karma pa sku phreng gnyis pa

karma pakshi'i lo rgyus/ ༄༅/ /rje des smin par mdzad pa'i bu slob kyi tshogs ni/ ches mang ba byon yang kun gyi mchog tu gyur pa brgyud pa 'dzin pa'i sras kyi thu bo ni/ mchog gi sprul pa'i sku dpal karma pa chen po yin te/ de'i rnam par thar pa rgya mtsho lta bu las/ sngon 'das pa'i rnam par thar pa'i tshul phyogs tsam grub chen nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rnam thar rnams dang gsung sgros zin bris su byas pa rnams las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ ming yongs su grags pa karma pa yang*/ sngon nas rang gi rang ma rig cing bdag gir 'dzin pas ngan song gnas gsum dang*/ mtho ris gnas gsum du 'khrul zhing 'khor ba mtha' yas pa'i lus shes par 'dug ste/ 'di yin 'dir skyes mang po brjod kyang gang gis shes shing su zhig yid ches par 'gyur/ ming yongs su grags pa karma pa/ bye brag tu slob dpon log pa'i rjes su zhugs shing mu stegs kyi lta sgom spyod pa la spyad pas/ gzugs can gzugs med phywa dang dbang phyug /khyab 'jug gi rigs su skyes shing brjod du med pa'i bya ba sgrub pa rnams dran par 'dug ste bshad kyang yid ches tshad mar 'dzin pa su zhig yod/ yang ming yongs su grags pa karma pa/ thog ma med pa'i dus nas nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i grub mthas blo sgyur zhing drang don gyi sde snod gsum la zhugs nas/ dka' thub dka' spyad sna tshogs bskal pa grangs med mtha' yas bsgrubs pas/ tshangs dang 'khor los sgyur rgyal 'jig rten chen po thams cad thob cing*/ zag pa dang bcas pa'i bde ba dpag med myong ba yang dran zhing shes par 'dug ste brjod kyis mi lang ba'o// yang ming yongs su grags pa karma pa/ nyan thos theg pa'i bsam gtan bzhi la goms pas dge sbyong gi 'bras bu bzhi thob pa dang*/ mthar gyis gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs shing yid byed phra mo la chags nas/ gzugs can gzugs med kyi lha du mar skyes shing*/

yid bzhin bde ba mchog gis ma rtogs pa'i tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod kyang bshad pa tsam gyis yid ches par ga la 'gyur/ sngon 'das pa'i dus rdzogs ldan gyi tha ma rtsod ldan gyi dang po'i dus/ rgyal po kun gyis bkur ba rgyal po'i thog ma ste/ de'i dus su dpal rdo rje 'chang ind+ra buddhi dang tha dad med pa'i rnal 'byor nam mkha' 'od ye shes sgrib pa med pa zhes kyang bya/ yang shākya'i rigs mthong na yid du 'ong ba'i mdun du/ rnal 'byor pa nam mkha' 'od ye shes dbyings su gyur pa dran zhing shes te/ de tshun dkar po'i las dang smon lam gyi 'brel pa sna tshogs kyis gdul bya 'dul ba'i phyir dran shes bzhin du/ skye 'jig gnas gsum ston zhing*/ rdo rje 'chang gis lung bstan pa/ ind+ra buddhi bar pa dang tha mar yang ming du mar grags shing rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa 'dzam gling khyab par spel ba/ da lta sngags 'chang rang byung rdo rjes de dang de'i don rnams phyogs ris med par ngo sprod cing byin gyis brlabs pa las the tshom med cing zhum pa med pa'o// de'i phyir sems dpa' rang byung rdo rje/ sprul pa'i sku sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi drung du bka' bsgrubs dgongs pa rdzogs par byas shing*/ 'gro ba dpag tu med pa mtho ris thar pa la bkod pa'i tshul/ sgrib pa med pa dran par 'dug ste mang po brjod pas ci zhig bya/ sku gsum la bye brag tha dad med de/ khro bo gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rgyud las/ hūm̐/ yongs su dag pa'i dkyil 'khor du// drag pos 'dul ba khro bo bcu// theg pa dman la mchog brgyad de// zhi bas 'dul la sems dpa' brgyad// tshe 'dir grub pa ston pa'i phyir// rnal 'byor grub chen brgyad du gsungs// zhes 'byung ba'i phyir/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i gnad kyis lo dang zla ba tsam gyis grub pa thob cing*/ grub rtags sna tshogs bstan pa/ rgyud lung dang mthun par shes shing*/

dran par 'dug ste kun gyis mi go the tshom za bar 'gyur bas ma brjod do// rgyal po dza'i dag snang la ma la ya dang*/ sing ga la'i gling du rdo rje theg pa'i char 'bab pa de'i tshe/ sngags 'chang rang byung rdo rje yang rgyal po dza'i tsha bo badzra shrī zhes bya bar gyur ba dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam 'phrul lha'i bu kun dga' snying po rgyal po pra haṣti'i bu mo dge slong ma'i thugs kar zhugs shing*/ rdzogs pa chen po klong chen rab 'byams ston pa'i tshe/ chos sku dri med rang byung rdo rje yang tog tse rnal 'byor dbang phyug ces bya bar gyur cing*/ rdzogs pa chen po'i sgra don thams cad rtogs te/ rnal 'byor nam mkha' 'od ye shes dbyings nas da lta'i bar gsang sngags gsar rnying gi sgra don mngon du gyur pa'i tshul nam langs pa la gnyid sad pa bzhin mngon du gyur pa'o// de'i phyir dus gsum mkhyen pa ni ind+ra bhuti'i rnam par 'phrul pa'am rang byung ye shes kyi byin gyis brlabs shing*/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha dang ngo bo gcig ste/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pa dang*/ ming yongs su grags pa karma pa tha dad med pa'i sngon byung 'das pa'i gleng gzhi dang*/ gleng slong mdor bsdus pa ste ma 'ongs gdul bya rnams kyis shes shing rtogs par mdzod/ ming yongs su grags pa karma pa ni dran shes bzhin dang ldan zhing skye 'chi gnyis la rang dbang thob pa ste/ de yang bye brag tu sngon sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhal bzhugs pa'i tshe/ rgyal po chen po zhig tu gyur nas rgyal srid la chags thogs med par btang nas rab tu byung ste/ da lta snyan grags phyogs med du 'gyed pa'i don yang de yin/ yang slob dpon klu sgrub kyi dus/ dge slong yon tan blo gros zhes bya bar gyur nas/ thugs rje chen po don yod zhags pa la bsnyen pa byas/ rang gzhan gyi sgrib pa sbyong nus pa zhig yin/ yang rgya nag tong kun gyi yul du/

rig 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor pa zhig tu gyur nas lha 'dre mi gsum dam la btags/ mchod rten dang gtsug lag khang dpag tu med pa bzhengs/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa drag po'i sgo nas btsugs pa zhig yin/ yang rgyal chen ris bzhi'i gnas lcang lo can du gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po'i bur skyes nas/ gnod sbyin gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa gsang sngags kyi lam la bkod pa zhig yin/ yang dge slong shes rab rgyal zhes bya ba sgrol ma khro gnyer can la bsnyen pa mang du byas pas phrin las sna tshogs grub pa zhig yin/ yang mes srong btsan sgam po dang dus mtshungs su/ shar phyogs kyi gling du 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po seng ge rab rtsal zhes bya bar gyur/ byang lam na yar 'ong dus dmag chen po de nga rang yin snyam pa dang*/ hor 'di kun bzlog na tshegs med snyam pa byung*/ de dus shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gsal/ mi tri'i rnam 'phrul bzhin/ kho bo da lta 'dir byung ba ma gtogs pa/ rgyal po de da lta de nyid na yod pa yin/ slob dpon zhing gi rdo rje zhes kyang bya/ slob dpon las kyi rdo rje zhes kyang bya ste de rnams dus mtshungs yin/ yang nub ba lang spyod na brtul zhugs spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa nyi ma'i 'od zer can zhes bya bar gyur/ phyi pa mu stegs pa mang du btul/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar rgyas su byas/ de'i stobs kyi da lta yang mu stegs pa 'dul sla bar 'dug cing de dang dus mtshungs par nub phyogs de nyid du/ mgon po nag po la dbang sgyur ba'i sngags pa zhig tu gyur nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrungs te/ mi rnams kyis ma hā kā la dngos yin zer ba byung*/ yang rgya gar nub phyogs na rnal 'byor pa seng ge ye shes spyan zhes bya bar gyur/ brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa sna tshogs kyis 'gro ba thabs kyis 'dul ba zhig yin/ de dang dus mtshungs rnal 'byor ma chang 'tshong mar gyur nas/

snang srid dbang gi phrin las kyis rgyal po la sogs skye bo thams cad smin grol la bkod/ de dang dus mtshungs ngo bo gcig tu sa zin med par rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs ston cing 'gro don phyogs med byed pa/ deng sang gi 'di bzhin rgyal khams kun tu spyod pa zhig kyang byung*/ yang byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten khams na padma dbang chen grub pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig tu gyur/ gdug pa can rnams btul rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs bstan nas gar song gar 'dug cha med par nam mkha' la 'phur pa bzhin gling thams cad du rgyu nus pas/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa zhig byung*/ de dang dus mtshungs nam mkha' lding gi rgyal por gyur nas klu rnams btul ste/ de'i stobs kyis deng sang klu rnams dbang med du btul zhing bstan pa la btsud pa yin/ de dang dus mtshungs su slob dpon padma bod la byon pa'i sngon rol/ rgyal po dza'i rjes tsam la gsang sngags rnying ma ston shes pa'i gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa zhig tu gyur nas/ gsang sngags kyi chos rgyas par byas te/ mtshan yang rdo rje ye shes 'bar bya ba yin/ yang slob dpon padma'i slob ma ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs zhes bya bar gyur/ padma nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis byin gyis brlabs pa zhig yin/ de'i don gyis padma dang rta mgrin nga rang yin snyam pa'i nges shes byung*/ gar phyin pa'i gdug pa can 'dul nus te gzhan gyis mi shes/ de min yang de dus gzhan don mdzad pa zhig dang*/ sangs rgyas ye shes rnams sprul pa dus mtshungs yin/ yang mai tri pa'i slob ma 'bar ba'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba spyod pa sna tshogs ston pa zhig yin/ yang kha che'i grong khyer krig bstan na dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa phyi dge slong du 'dug pa/ nang gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa dpal ma mgon bran du khol ba brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas dregs pa can zil gyis gnon pa 'khor dge slong stong tsam gyis bskor ba/

mtshan yon tan rgyal po zhes bya ba yin/ yang o rgyan gyi nub phyogs su brtul zhugs grub pa'i rnal 'byor pa 'jigs med grags pa zhes bya bar gyur nas/ mu stegs la dga' ba'i sdig sbyong gi rgyal po glang po cher sprul nas bcom/ yang rje btsun ras chung ba dang 'brel ba yod pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig yin te/ da lta yang ras chung pa'i gdams ngag rnams dang*/ rlung sems kyi zab chos rnams rang bzhin gyis sems la 'char zhing 'dug /bram ze chen po dang mai tri pa dang ti pu rnams da lta mjal ba de sngon gyi dpon slob gyi 'brel par 'dug /bsre ba'i gdams ngag 'di rnams sa ra has brda' bstan/ mai tri ti pus dag snang du gsungs te/ sngon chad nā ro'i brgyud pa la med pa yin/ de dang dus mtshungs kham pa lung pa dang 'brel ba yod pa zhig ste/ byang chub kyi sems dang thugs rje chen pos 'gro don dpag tu med pa byas/ 'phan yul dang dbu ru stod du phyin tsam na shes rgyu zhig byung*/ rgya gar rnal 'byor pa dar ma dbang phyug de dang de gsum ngo bo gcig yin/ yang shud ke'i ban rgan de yin par 'dug /bstan pa bsrung ba'i ched du byung ba yin/ da lta lha mo dang grub thag nye zhing dngos su bstan rgyu yod pa'i don yang de yin/ de dang dus mtshungs sprul sku la stod dmar po de yang sku'i bkod pa cha gcig yin/ sangs rgyas ye shes kyi slob ma rdo rje dbang phyug ces bya ba rta mgrin zhal gzigs shing bskyed rdzogs la dbang thob pa dang*/ rdzogs chen 'ba' zhig sgom pa'i cog ro sgom chen dang*/ de rnams ngo bo gcig yin/ de'i don gyis da lta yang rdzogs chen gyi chos thams cad phyogs med du rtogs pa dang shes par 'dug/ yang rdo rje srin po'i zhal gzigs zhing dregs pa can 'dul ba'i sngags gshen re thul can yin snyam pa byung*/ slob dpon padma'i phrin las kyi lhag ma gdug pa can thams cad 'dul ba'i sprul bar 'dug

yang bal po'i rnal 'byor ba dhan shrī zhes bya ba gsang sngags kyi spyod pa sna tshogs ston pa zhig ste/ da dung yang de'i gdan sa dang bu slob yod/ yang rgya gar gyi rnal 'byor pa buddha bo ddhi zhes bya ba grub rtags mang po ston/ mu stegs pa rnams btul/ 'gro ba rnams skye ba med pa'i don la bkod pa yin/ da res zhal tshom drang por yod pa dang*/ gdug pa can rnams 'dul ba sngon gyi rnam 'gyur dang spyod pa'i 'phro yin/ yang rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug nyag se zhes bya ba yin/ spung rir phyin pa'i dus shes rgyu zhig byung*/ da lta phyi'i spyod pa tsab tsub dang tho co sna tshogs kyis phan gnod kyi phrin las sgrub pa de sngon gyi spyod pa'i 'phro y-in/ yang jo bo spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa thod rgal bas 'gro don mdzad pa yin te/ thugs kyi sprul pa sa ra ha/ sku'i sprul pa padma/ gsung gi sprul pa dam pa rgya gar/ de gsum ngo bo gcig ste/ dus mkhyen bram ze'i sprul pa yin/ mes srong btsan thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa yin/ byang sems blo gros rin chen rta mgrin gyi sprul pa yin/ padma'i rnam 'phrul mi tra dzo ki yin/ la stod tshun chad nas deng sang yan du rang cag mi tras byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnam 'phrul gyi skye ba bcu drug tu thugs rje chen po dang rta mgrin gyi sgo nas 'gro don dpag med byas/ rgyal po dmag dpon lta bu'i 'gro don grangs med byas pa'ang yod/ deng sang thugs rje chen po'i phrin las sgrub pa'ang de ltar yin/ e ka dzā ṭi dang ma mgon 'di kun skye ba bcu drug gi chos skyong yin/ zhes gsungs shing*/ grub chen nyid dang dus mtshungs kyi sku'i bkod pa'ang da lta kho bo dang dus mtshungs yu gur gyi nang na nga 'dra ba'i rnal 'byor pa gcig yod/ bya byad spyod pa thams cad nga dang mthun/ sems can dpag tu med pa'i don byed/

de'i ming yang ma hā dzo ki zhes bya bar grags/ yang bal bod kyi mtshams na rngon pa'i gzugs can mda' gzhu thogs pa bud med dang bcas pa zhig yod/ bud med de ye shes kyi ḍā ki ma yin/ de yang rje mi tras byin gyis brlabs pa zhig yin/ sems can 'ga' tsam la phan/ gnas lugs kyi don rtogs pas khong gis kyang shes kyang srid/ yang yar lung kyi 'dir rnal 'byor pa chags lam pa zhig yod/ des kyang sems can mang po la phan/ gnas lugs kyi don rtogs nas rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur cir yang sprul nyan te/ brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa la rang dbang thob pas ci byas nyan pa yin/ zhes gsungs/ grub chen karma pa nyid kyi rnam par thar pa ni/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i rnam thar las/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su bod yul lho brag grub pa'i gnas mdun du gdul bya gcig gi don du 'byung gsungs pa dang*/ 'bri chu ngo mthong nas gcig gis nged kyi dgongs pa rdzogs par byed gsungs pa dang*/ yon bdag dgon pa ba skye ba gnyis sam gsum gyis lam rnal mar tshud gsungs pa gsum dus mtshungs pa ste/ dgongs pa de gsum rdzogs par bya ba'i don du/ ming yongs su grags pa karma pa yang*/ dran pa shes bzhin dang ldan pas 'bri klung dam pa chos kyis phyug pa'i yul du/ btsad po dbu'i rigs su skyes zhes gsungs te/ sngon chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyis sras sad na legs/ sad na mjing yon gnyis kyi snga ma 'bangs kyis bkrong*/ phyi ma la sras gsum yod pa'i chung ba gnang bu gnang stag gi bu/ stag nam mkha'i lha gzungs te/ bi ma la mu tra dang*/ padma saṃ bha wa/ gnub nam mkha'i snying po rnams kyis dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlabs/ sngags la mnga' brnyes shing grub pa thob/ na bza' nyi ma'i srab mda' la 'gel zhing*/ 'ja' 'od la chibs nas nam mkha' la gshegs nus shing*/ khyad par rdo rje srin po dreg pa pho dgu mo dgu dang tha dad med par gyur pa de/

mched ya stag ste'u ri bkra'i sras gsum yang*/ dgyes pa rdo rje dang*/ rdo rje srin po'i rnal 'byor rig pa 'dzin pa yin pas khu dbon de rnams khams su mi sde'i mgo lung la btang bar dbur ming du chags pa'i brgyud la/ sngags pa tshe thung shos mi rabs bco lnga tsam dang*/ tshe ring ba'i dbang gis mi rabs bcu gcig tsam song ba'i dus sa stod dkyil le'i tsag to zhes bya bar/ yab rgya dbang tshur tsha sprang thar/ yum seng nge bza' mang skyid gnyis la sras 'ga' yod pa'i chung shos su me pho stag gi lo la sku bltams/

mtshan chos 'dzin zhes bya ba dad pa che zhing yang dag pa'i don la mos pa ste/ lo drug nas yi ge phyogs med du shes shing*/ lo dgu dang bcu lon gyi bar sangs rgyas ky-i gsung rab tha dag la bltas te/ klog 'don thengs re tsam gyis thams cad shes shing khong du chud nas/ sems nyid kyi gshis 'gyur ba med pa la rang bzhin gyis gnas pa rgya mtsho'i gting gi chu lta bu mi g.yo ba gnas kyang*/ ci ltar yin cung zad ngo ma shes pa la/ rin po che spom brag pas ngo sprad pa ste/ de yang rje nyid dbus su pheb dgongs te byon pa la/ rin po che spom brag pa dang sha 'bom na thog mar mjal ba'i dus su/ btsun chung khyod gang nas 'ong ba yin gsungs/ nged sa stod nas 'ong dbus su 'gro ba yin zhus pas/ khyod nga'i gdul bya e ma yin gar yang ma 'gro 'dug cig gsungs nas/ de nub shes rab blo gros la dbang bskur mdzad pa'i gral du khrid nas thugs la btags/ dbang bskur thub nas mi med pa'i dus su do nub khyod 'dug pa'i thad na/ dus gsum mkhyen pa sogs bka' brgyud kyi bla ma gsal/ khyod las can zhig yin par 'dug /des na sil ko dgon par byon pa'i dus su/ sil ko zhe kho gnyis kyi bar sgang zhe mur 'og mgul na byon pa'i tshe/ spom brag pa'i zhal nas/ de ring rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i snang ba nam mkha' gang ba zhig byung*/ lar yang khyod dang 'phrad phyin dag pa'i snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung bas/ khyod skal ldan zhig yin par 'dug 'dir sdod la nga'i chos 'di tsho nyams su long gsungs/ mngon par mkhyen pa rgya chen mnga' bar 'dug ste gsang bar snang gsungs/ dgung lo bcu gcig bzhes pa'i lo der/ rin po che spom brag pa nyid kyi drung du rab tu byung nas mtshan chos kyi bla ma ces gsol/ de nas spom brag dgon par dbang bskur zhing*/ sems bskyed zab khrid sogs dam pa'i chos dpag tu med pas rjes su bzungs shing pha bu 'phrad pa bzhin thugs la btags/

tshe rabs kyi bla ma yin par 'dug gar yang mi 'gro bsdad dgos snyam nas chos thams cad thugs nyams su bzhes shing bka' bzhin bsgrubs/ sa ra ha'i do ha dang dwags po'i phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid gnang nas ngo sprad pa'i dus su/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang rig ye shes rab 'byams su ngo 'phrod de/ rin po che la zhus pas/ ngo bo rtogs pa yin yang 'khor ba thog med nas 'khrul pa yun ring ba'i phyir/ sgom med kyi dbyings su rlung sems gnad kyi 'khor lo bskor dgos pa dang*/ khyod la des chog kyang gdul bya sna tshogs kyi don byed pa la bka' brgyud kyi gdams ngag rnams dgos shing*/ slob ma rnams la phyogs med du ngo sprod cing gegs sel ba dang bogs 'don pa rnams shes dgos pa yin gsungs nas brgyud pa'i gdams ngag yod tshad gnang*/ der khrid mdzad pa la 'bul rgyu gzhan med pas klog rgyun tshar gcig la bzhugs nas/ de'i yon rin po che la phul bas khra spom brag sna 'di nor gyis bkang nas phul ba bas/ sgom chen sems ngo shes pa gcig dga' gsungs/ de nas bla ma 'di sgrub pa kho na la mnyes par 'dug dgongs nas/ rje nyid kyis kyang sku bzhi ngo sprod kyi don la gnad bzhi chos nyid kyi 'khor lo rgyun chad med par bskor bas/ me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar rigs drug gi gnas sbyong du ma shar zhing*/ dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med par rtogs pa'i dbang gis phyogs bcu'i zhing dang sku rgya mtsho rnams rtag tu gzigs shing*/ chos gsan pa sogs dag pa'i snang ba 'byams klas pa byung*/ khyad par nub gcig rmang lam du thugs rje chen po zhal bcu gcig pa nam mkha'i dbyings khyab pa zhig gi zhal nas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar ba bzhin du 'od zer phyogs thams cad du khyab cing de'i sna las khyod kyis thugs rje chen po'i sgra phyogs med du drag du sgrogs shig ces pa'i sgra grags pa dang*/

mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i zhal nas chos 'di kun la bstan 'dis 'dul ba'i dus la babs pa yin gsungs pa byung*/ 'on kyang shar phyogs spungs rir ma phebs kyi bar su la'ang ma bstan pa yin gsungs/ da rung mnyam rjes cung zad ma 'dres pas dgun sgang chen srod la phyir bud nas mtshan yal ras rkyang bzhes nas/ gtum mo gtso bor bsgom ste/ rlung sems gnad kyi 'khor lo drag tu bskor bas/ ko bo'i yul sil ko dgon par gnam brag dben du sgom med kyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ thun bar rnams su rje btsun ma'i bsnyen pa mdzad pas zhal yang rtag tu gzigs/ der slob dpon rin po ches/ brgyud pa 'di'i gdams ngag la khyod 'dra'i sgom sgrub stsol ba dgos pa yin/ brgyud pa kun gyi gdams ngag gi che ba 'don cing dgongs pa rdzogs par byed pa khyod la 'byung gsungs nas mnyes/ de nas rin po che kaḥ thog pa byams pa 'bum gyis mkhan po dang*/ spyan snga mang phu bas slob dpon mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad/ rin po che spom brag pa la ma mgon gyi gtor dbang zhus pas/ ting nge 'dzin ji ltar yod pa bzhin zhal mthong*/ nye gnas byas pas kyang byin rlabs dang phrin las shin tu che bar byung*/ sel ko'i brag go tshang can na gcig pur bsgom pa'i tshe/ thugs rje chen po zhal bcu gcig pa dbu la a mi dhe wa bzhugs pa/ sku la 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba/ 'od zer re re'i sna la'ang yi ge drug pa yig 'bru'i gzugs/ kha dog sna lnga la dmar po shas che ba/ nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon ltar bkra lam me 'dug pa/ yi ge drug pa'i sgra nam mkha'i mthas khyab tshad du grags pa'i nang nas/ spyan ras gzigs dbang thuḍa rje yi/ /phrin las 'od zer phyogs bcur rgyas/ /zhes grags ste/ nam mkhas khyab tshad 'gro ba re re'i mdun na'ang thugs rje chen po'i sku dang*/ yi ge drug pa rnams yod pa 'od zer rang nyid la thim/

yang de'i phyis nub gcig nam mkha' 'od dmar pos gang ba byung de'i nang na rje btsun ma sku mdog byi ru ltar dmar ba/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dkar khro le gsol ba/ rigs bzhi ḍā ki yang sku mdog dmar ba/ gri gug thod pa kha ṭāṃ ga dang ldan pa ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ gtso mo'i dbu la rnam par snang mdzad kyis brgyan pa/ ḍā ki bzhi la gzhan bzhis dbu brgyan pa/ gtso mo'i zhal nas/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /rgyud rnams kun gyi rtsa ba yin/ /gsungs te/ rje mi la'i gsung gis/ rje btsun ma 'di'i sgo nas rgyud sde bzhi'i sgo bdun brgya phyed pa yin gsungs pa'i don 'di yin par 'dug snyam pa byung*/ yang nub gcig gi rmang lam na/ lung pa dmar po yangs shing rgya che ba zhig na chang gi rgyun chu bo chen po dbyar 'brub pa lta bu zhig 'bab cing 'dug /de'i 'gram na bud med cig snang ba la 'di ga nas 'bab dris pas/ 'di'i phu la song dang mthong 'ong gi chang gi rgyun 'di khyod kyi yin/ da dung yang yun ring du 'bab pa yin zer/ de nas de'i phur phyin pas ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba zhig nas 'bab cing 'dug pa mthong*/ de'i steng gi nam mkha' la rje btsun ma sku mdog dmar mo rgyan cha lugs dang ldan pa zhig la/ lha mo dmar mo bcu drug gis bskor ba'i zhal mthong*/ nam mkha' thams cad ḍa ma ru'i sgras gang ba byung*/ de la sogs pa go tshang brag tu rlung sems kyi 'dus tshul rigs drug gi gzigs snang dpag tu med pa byung gsungs/ lar go tshang brag tu zla ba hril po lnga bsgoms pa yin gsungs/ yang sil ko dgon du chos skyong gi zhal gyi dkyil 'khor gnam sa kheb pa zhig nyin gcig gi bar du snang ste/ spyan kun nyi zla shar pa tsam la 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'khrigs shing 'dug /zhal nas hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs shing snang srid zil gyis gnon pa'i phrin las dpag tu med pa 'byung gsung ba byung*/

yang spom brag na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ dpal mgon po phyogs bcu'i mgon po'i 'khor dang bcas pa dar mdung ba dan nag po can bsnams te/ shar lho mtshams na phar thal ba byung*/ ba dan nag po de rin po che 'da' ba'i brdar 'dug de'i tshe dus 'pho 'gyur gyi dbang gis hor dang mi log thams cad kyis yul brlag pa'i dus su smar khams smad du/ rje 'gro mgon ras pa'i dbon po sogs bstan pa dar rgyas yod pa gsan nas dpon slob rnams der byon pa'i tshe/ hor gyi gnod pa sna tshogs byung zhing*/ mtsho rong dgon du phebs/ ras chen pa'i slob ma rnams kyis kyang mi log mang po byung zer nas phan 'dogs su ma btub/ rin po che spom brag pa'ang gshegs shing*/ rje nyid thugs chad pa'i dus na rdo rje dpal brtsegs dang*/ 'dam chen rtse'u ras bgo byas bu 'bor gyi gzhi bdag thams cad bsu ba la byung ba gzigs/ legs ldan mgon po ber nag can gyis tsandan gyi beng thogs shing zhabs sa la brdabs nas/ beng gis sa la ri mo gsum byas/ 'di na ma 'dug shar gyi phyogs su 'deng gsungs pa'i ltas byung*/ ri mo gsum ni/ bsod nams ri bo bzhin du brtan/ /brgyud 'dzin nyi zla bzhin du gsal/ /snyan pas nam mkha' bzhin du khyab pa'i brda' dang*/ zhabs brdabs pa de 'dzam gling g.yo nus pa'i brdar dgongs/ mtsho rong mchod khang gi sgo la nged mi log la khyed rnams mi dgos/ 'dzam gling khyab pa'i bdag po 'ong bar yang sus shes/ zhes bris nas bzhag /rje nyid dpon slob 'ga' zhig yod pa des/ rin po che'i rten rnams gdan drangs nas nam la gar song cha med par bzhud/ sgo rig gi yul du 'byon dgongs nas 'bal thang du pheb tsa na/ sgo rig gi gzhi bdag rnams mi nag dar dkar 'dzin pa mang po'i tshul gyis bsu ba byas/ 'bri rgyud de dag tu brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa sna tshogs mdzad cing*/ nad pa dang zha bo sogs la phyag lcag gnang ba tsam gyis sos pa byung*/

de phyogs kyi 'gro ba rnams kyis gus pas phul ba'i nor rnams phongs med du gzhan la bkyes/ grub thob kyi snyan pa phyogs med du grags/ kaṃ po gnas nang du byon pa'i tshe/ 'ja' tshon lta bu'i gzhal yas khang du bde mchog gi lha tshogs dang*/ rje dus mkhyen bzhugs pa gzigs/ dge bsnyen gyis rin po che'i khri brtsigs nas khyed 'dir bzhugs zer ba rmis pa gdan sa gsar rnying gnyis zug pa'i brdar 'dug gsungs/ gnas nang nas 'char slong na sgom pa'i tshe/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang sku'i bkod pa thams cad zhag bdun gyi bar du gsal bar gzigs pa byung*/ de nas spungs ri la 'byon pa'i tshe/ gnas nang lung pa'i g.yas phyogs dpa' bo'i dkyil 'khor/ g.yon phyogs dpa' mo'i dkyil 'khor rnams gar khyug khyug byed cing bsgyel ba gzigs/ dus gsum mkhyen pa dpag tu med pa bzhugs pa'i zhal nas dag pa mkha' spyod 'di rang yin gsung ba byung*/ nyi ma phyi dro zhig la dpal lha mo zhal gyis gnam sa khyab pa nag mo 'bum sde dang bcas pa rngam nas byang phyogs na phar thal ba zhig byung*/ stod nas tshur hor 'ong ba bzlog pa'i brda' yin gsungs/ ra rong nas yar byon pa'i dus su/ sgo rig gi gzhi bdag rnams bsur 'ongs pa dang*/ dge bsnyen 'khor bcas 'thab cing 'dug pa la gtor ma byin nas ma 'thab gsungs pas/ dge bsnyen na re/ da res khyed rnams rgyal ba gyis dang*/ lo 'ga' lon nas nga rang gis gdan drangs pa yin zer zhing 'dug /de ni phyis gnas nang na bstan pa dar ba'i rtags yin/ sgo rig rngab pa yon btsun tshul rgyal gyi pha smyo ba'i dus su gdan drangs par gtor dbang bdun gyis sos pa bya snyam tsam na/ bon po rnams kyis ban de pe kar gyis pe kar mi thub/ de sngon gtor dbang gsum byas pa kyang ma phan zer bas/ thugs 'khrugs nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khar btab kyang gang ba'i snang ba ma byung*/

gtor ma chen po mi bzhis mi theg pa zhig yod pa de/ phyag ya gcig gis blangs te 'phangs/ de'i dus su steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad chos skyong mgon pos gang ba byung nas/ phyogs bcu'i mgon po'i bstod pa'ang mdzad/ rdzi mgor rnal lam du gnas po chen po bang ri byon nas ri 'di nye ba'i gnas yin/ khyed kyi pho brang 'dir thob dang gdul bya rgya mtsho lta bu 'byung*/ yon bdag sum smar gyi gzhi bdag rnams dang*/ ngas kyang byed pa yin zer ba byung*/ slong mdor byon pa'i tshe dge bsnyen chen po bang ras lha khang 'di khyed la 'bul zer nas phyag skor byed pa byung*/ de phyir sgo rig nang du phrin las thogs rdugs med pa byung*/ de nas sgo rig gi yul de nyid du kaṃ po gnas nang gi nye ba'i gnas/ spungs ri zhes bya ba dpa' bo sprin bzhin du 'du ba'i gnas/ sngon bla ma nyag se'i sgrub gnas su gyur pa der pheb/ der 'tshogs pa'i 'jig rten gyi ḍā ki la sogs pa 'byung po rnams kyis thog char 'bebs pa sogs gnam sa g.yo nus pa'i cho 'phrul bstan pas de rnams dbang du bsdus shing zil gyis mnan/ stsol sgrub sna tshogs kyis phrin las re re zung zung 'grub pa la dgos pa med/ ting nge 'dzin sna tshogs kyi grub rtags zhi khro rab 'byams ltar lhun gyis grub pa ma byung na/ yul khams re re zung zung tsam gyi slob dpon la yang dgos pa med snyam nas/ byi ru 'ga' yod pa nas dang za ma la btsong nas dam bca' brtan pos/ gnad bzhi chos nyid kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing*/ sgrub pa nan tan du mdzad pas tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i nor sgrub kyi gnad kyis sku bsod rgyas shing slob ma mang du 'dus/ grwa pa lnga brgya tsam re 'tshogs pa la stsol sgrub med par rgyags bkyes nas sgom du bcug ma mgon lcam dral pho nyar bkye/ lha srin sde brgyad bran du bkol nas rgya dang 'jang yan chad la drag po'i phrin las dngos su bstan nas/

lam rgya mdzad/ sgo rig rnga pas lam rgya dral ba la bzhes drangs pa'i dus su bu 'bor gyi sgang mgon po'i lha dmag gis gang zhing*/ dngos su yang rlung thog gis thang shing dpag tu med pa bsgyel ba zhig byung*/ phyis chos khrims rtsod du gzhug pa'i dus su khyod la bstan rgyu e yod zer ba la/ mgon po la gsol ba btab pas/ nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad dpal mgon pos gang zhing*/ kun gar byed cing ha ha sgrogs pa zhig byung*/ de'i dus su gzhan snang du yang mi mang pos mngon sum du mthong zhing*/ mi rnams rengs zhing brgyal ba dang*/ mkhar 'dar ba la sogs pa cho 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig byung*/ de la sogs pa'i cho 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab brjod kyis mi langs te mdo tsam zhig bkod pa lags gsungs/ de ltar sgo rig sol mtsho nag po de sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bcug cing*/ dkar mo dung mtsho lta bur mdzad/ spungs rir phyin nas lo gnyis tsam lon pa'i dus su stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab pa'i padma'i sdong po byang chub kyi snying po/ rgyan yid du 'ong ba 'bras bu dang lo ma thams cad nor bu rin po che dang bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyad dang*/ dngos grub sna tshogs 'byung ba'i bum pa dang*/ mi 'gyur rdo rje rin po che sna tshogs grub pa'i dbus na/ snang ba mtha' yas thugs rje chen po dang dbyer med par bzhugs shing*/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad na de bzhin gshegs pa grangs med pa rnams dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs thams cad dang*/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs sprin spungs gtibs pa lta bu me tog re re'i kha na re re bzhugs shing*/ mtha' yas mu med pa steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad nas/ gtso bo la bskor te bzhugs pa'i gtso bo'i zhal nas/ thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs 'di rnams gsungs shing*/ da phyin chad 'gro ba'i don thams cad yi ge drug mas gyis gsung ba zhig byung*/
byang chub shing gi thang ka'i bkod pa yang de'i dpe yin/ de phyin chad thugs rje chen po phyogs med du bstan pa'o//

spungs rir bzhugs pa'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams dpag tu med pa gzigs pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pas lung bstan pa dang*/ bka' brgyud thams cad byon pa gzigs shing byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ stong gsum gsal ba dang*/ 'gro ba'i skye ba dang*/ 'chi 'pho ba mkhyen pa byung*/ dud 'gro kha 'thor ba 'di rnams kyi skad go ba yang byung*/ rje bram ze yin po de sku mdog smug nag la rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yab yum gsum/ 'khor ḍā ki sde bzhi dang bcas pa dus rgyun par zhal gzigs lung ston chos gsung ba rtag par byung*/ yang slob dpon padma a tsa ra sku mdog nag po spyan dmar ba/ brjid pa ag tshom ring ba/ ḍā' ki ging dang bcas pa yang yang gzigs/ lung ston chos gsung ba byung*/ yang dpal sha ba ri sku mdog smug nag rus pa'i rgyan can/ btsun mo gnyis dang bcas pa/ 'khor mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba zhal gzigs/ yang o rgyan gyi gnas kyis gtso bo byas/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi thams cad ma bsgribs par gsal ba dang*/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad kyang gsal bar gzigs/ lar ting nge 'dzin thun gcig gi dag snang kho na'ang bsam gyis mi khyab cing brjod kyis mi langs ba'i phyir ma bris pa yin gsungs/ yang da res la mi'i slob ma bas mi ma yin gyi slob ma mang ste/ rgya gar shar phyogs kā ma rū pa'i gzhi bdag gi slob ma kho na'ang dpag tu med pa yod gsungs/ yang spungs rir dgon pa gsar pa cig mdzad bzhed cing ji ltar bya dgongs pa'i dus/ dpal mgon pos beng gi rtse mos sa la ri mo byed pa byung te/ ri mo ji ltar byas pa bzhin rmang bting*/ gyang btab pas mkhar las la cang mi dka' bar byung*/ yang phyis nub gcig gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang bcas pa gar mdzad cing*/ khyod kyis kyang ma ṇi padme bgrang mi shes gsungs/ 'o na ji ltar bzla zhus pas/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhis mgrin gcig tu bsdebs nas dbyangs su gyer yin 'dug

/da phyin chad 'di ltar dbyangs su blangs na gang thos thams cad byin gyis brlabs shing 'gro don shin tu che ba yin gsung ba rnal lam du byung bas/ de phyin chad ma ṇi padme dbyangs su gyer ba'i phrin las mdzad/ yang rnal lam du thugs rje chen po'i sku mdog sngon po baiḍūrya 'dra ba zhig gi zhal nas/ rnam par snang mdzad gangs chen mtsho yang nga'i sprul pa yin te/ sems bskyed dang smon lam rgya chen po ji tsam btab pa bzhin 'grub pa yin pas/ smon lam mtha' yas tshad med pa thob cig gsung ba byung bas/ kun gzhi byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /zhes pa'i smon lam yang de'i dus su mdzad/ yang spungs ri'i rtse mkha' 'gro gnas su gtor ma gtong bar phyin pa'i tshe/ 'dam chen po'i rtse'u ra'i mgon tshur la sprin dkar po shel gyi kha dog 'dra ba gangs ri dang dbyer med pa zhig byung*/ de'i nang na thugs rje chen po sku mdog ser ba la dkar ba'i mdangs chags pa gar thabs su mdzad cing*/ steng 'og thams cad mkha' 'gro rgya mtshos gtibs pa zhig gis zhal nas/ 'gro ba kun gyi sems rgyud la nged kyis 'od zer bkye ba yin gyi/ da res yi ge drug mas 'gro don dpag tu med pa byung*/ de'i phyir kun la phyogs ris med par ston cig gsungs te/ de phyin chad thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs kyi gsham na dbang ma thob pa dang*/ lung ma mnos pa dang*/ slob dpon gyis chos ma rdzogs pa rnams kyang*/ phrin las thugs rje chen po dang mnyam par gyur cig /ces smon lam btab yod pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin gsungs/ yang rta mgrin dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i zhal gzigs/ yang snga dro zhig na rigs lnga'i zhing khams thams cad dus gcig la zhal gzigs pa byung*/ de'i dus su sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams lta ba zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos mdzad/ de phyin chad rmang lam shar tsam nyid nas 'khrul pa chad pa byung*/

chos kyi sku mnyam pa nyid dri ma med pa nyag cig la snang bya snang byed med par 'khor 'das ma 'dres par gsal bar 'dug pas gang gang ngo ti bya rgyu ma rnyed gsungs/ spungs rir bzhugs nas lo brgyad lon pa'i dus na/ thugs rje chen po sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' chos skyong la sogs pas sems can gyi don la 'gro ran zer ba yang yang byung na'ang*/ cung zad kyang ma 'gul bar lo phyed dang gsum tsam gyi bar du rlung sems gnad gyi 'khor lo bskor te/ lo hril po bcu ngo mthong gcig dang bcu gcig tu spungs rir kho na bzhugs/ de nas dbon po nor lon gyi dmag gis kol ti gnas nang la sogs pa thams cad brlag pa'i dus su/ de dag gi sde dgon gso ba'i phyir*/ grub thob chen po nyid kyi de phyogs su phebs nas dbyar dgun gsum la bzhugs/ rlung sems kyi gnad kyis rgya 'jang yan chad dbang du bsdus shing*/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i ting nge 'dzin gyi byin rlabs kyi mthu stobs dngos su bstan/ kol ti'i sde chen po la'ang gser 'phru btsug pa sogs thang gsum gsos shing dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ gnas 'dir grub thob o tra lam po bya ba gzigs/ gnas nang du mtsho 'gram na chos khri brtsigs nas sa slong ba dang*/ bu 'bor sgang gi lha 'dre yod tshad dbang du bsdus nas bka' bsgo mdzad pa'i dus gzhan snang du/ ri nyil ba dang*/ gangs 'grogs pa dang*/ skad sna tshogs pa grags pa dang*/ thang shing rnams rlung gis bsgyel ba dang*/ rkya mi dmag tshogs dpag tu med pa mthong ba byung*/ dge bsnyen rdo rje dpal brtsegs dang gzhi bdag rnams kyis/ phyi ma'i mu mtha' thug gi bar du khyed kyi bu slob rnams kyi bstan pa nged kyis srung ba yin/ mdo la yan chad khyed kyis gdan sa gyis/ mdo la phyin chad nged kyi yin/ ma trang la ril ma phyin chad la ma reg zer ba zhig byung*/ yang gnas nang du thugs rje chen po dmar po nam mkha'i dbyings khyab pa la nyi ma'i 'od zer rdzogs pa lta bu zhig gi zhal nas/

phyogs bcu'i zhing khams mtha' yas pa na snang ba mtha' yas thugs rje chen po'i rnam sprul bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod de/ khyod kyang yi ge drug ma'i phrin las sgrub mi yin pas skyo dub med par ston cig gsung ba byung*/ gnas nang nas sa stod la byon pa'i dus su/ dge bsnyen gyis dar dkar gyi na bza' zhig phul nas dus gsum mkhyen pa'i bstan pa khyed kyis srungs zer ba zhig byung ba lam na grib dang bar chad mi 'ong ba'i brdar mkhyen/ de nas spang bkra na sgrol ma dkar mo'i zhal gzigs/ ru yon 'o de dgon du/ gnas brtan kun dga' bo dang mjal/ kun snang dang ba'i lha gnas su/ chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor ba'i tshe/ lha ma srin sde brgyad kyi ltas dang cho 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams/ tshad med pa'i snying rje chen pos btul zhing*/ rdo rje sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor du byin gyis brlabs/ de nas tsha yul gcong brag tu phebs pa'i dus su/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang chen po'i dbus su/ rdo rje sems dpa' zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs la/ ma mo grangs med pas bskor zhing*/ gzhi bdag rnams kyis bsu ba byed pa byung*/ gzhan snang du'ang na bun shel gyi kha dog 'dra ba dang*/ gur phub pa 'dra ba dang*/ 'od dang*/ 'ja' dang*/ nyams dga' ba'i ltas mang po byung*/ rong btsan kha ba dkar po'i gangs ri de ye shes pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa thams cad kyi pho brang du gzigs skabs 'dir kha ba dkar po'i lam yig cig kyang mdzad/ gnas 'di phrin las sna tshogs 'grub pa'i gnas yin gsungs/ gnas chen 'di'i phyogs su/ dbyar dgun gnyis tsam bzhugs shing*/ lang dkar nag yan chad du bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ de nas karma pa'i gdan sa nyams pa gso ba'i ched du sa stod na yar byon pa'i tshe/ 'bri 'dan gnyis dang*/ lho lung chen bco brgyad kyi lha 'dre mi gsum/

rlung sems kyi gnad kyis dbang du bsdus shing*/ phrin las rnam bzhi'i sgo nas bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa rgyas par mdzad de/ karmar lo gcig bzhugs/ de skabs shig tu 'gro mgon yab sras sogs bka' brgyud bla ma kun bzhugs pa la/ mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor ba byed pa'i snang ba byung ste/ bstan pa la phan pa'i brdar 'dug /yang dus gsum mkhyen pa'i ring bsrel mang du byon pa snyam byed de/ da dung sgom chen mang po 'byung ba'i brdar 'dug gsungs/ zhang zhung la sogs pa'i btsun chung rnams la/ tshogs dang gtor ma byed du bcug pas ma mgon rnams kyis/ mtshur phu'i gdan sa 'jigs la khad pas/ 'byon ran zhes yang yang bskul ba byung*/ de nas mtshur phur byon pa cha ba'i tshe/ sngags bdag gis nor bu rin po che 'bul ba byung ste/ bsam pa 'grub pa'i brdar mkhyen/ de dus byang lam hor dang mi log gis gang bas/ kong po'i lam brgyud nas byon lho brgyud du pheb pa'i tshe/ dpal ldan lha mo nag mo 'bum sde dang bcas pa nub gsum du byon te/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i bstan pa 'jig la khad pas/ dbus la myur du 'deng zer ba gzigs/ yang de'i tshe/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gsal ba dang*/ sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa'i gsal snang byung*/ de dag thams cad rlung sems kyi 'dus tshul te/ kho bo yang tshe ring bar 'ong bar 'dug snyam pa byung gsungs/ ngom ting thog na phyin pa'i dus/ rtsi shing nags tshal thams cad lha mo gri gug thod khrag thogs pa grangs med par gyur nas/ lam la ma thogs myur du 'deng gsungs zhing sngon la thal ba byung*/ rngu chu 'gram du nya nag 'dongs kyis bar chad byed tshad pa la/ srid pa gsum gyi ma mo 'khor bcas ha ha sgrogs shing*/ snang srid zil gyis gnon pa zhig byung*/ yang byang lam na phyin pa'i dus/ da khams na mar mi phyin/ gtsang mnga' ris man chad 'dul dgos dgongs pa'i tshe/ thugs rje chen po 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i nang na bzhugs pa zhig gi zhal nas/

dbus gtsang na 'gro don mang po byed rgyu yod kyang*/ khams na gdul bya'i phyed drang po yod pas der 'gro dgos pa 'byung gsung ba'i ltas byung*/ der lam nor ba yang min te/ bstan pa'i che ba 'don pa'i phyir/ mgon po la drag tu bos pas/ mgon po lha dmag dang bcas pa gar thabs mdzad nas phar thal bas/ bram 'gying gzhi bdag rnams bros pa zhig byung*/ gangs dkar zhol du pheb nas dbus gtsang gi lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du bsdus shing zil gyis gnon pa'i dus su/ lha 'dre rnams kyis cho 'phrul drag tu bstan cing*/ 'brug chen po sa g.yo ba tsam dang*/ thog ser drag tu 'bab pa byung*/ de ni dbus gtsang bstan pa dar ba'i brda yin pa 'dra gsungs/ 'bri khung du rten 'brel dbang gis che ba 'don pa la/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor nas/ 'bri gung gling rangs pa la gar khyug khyug byed pa byung*/ 'bri gung thel pa byams pa'i rgyu mtshan yang der 'dug /skyi shod nas phyir byon pa'i dus su/ jo bo rje 'od zer dang bcas pa mang du snang ste/ de'i phrin las kyi lhag ma yod pa'i brdar 'dug /lha sar phyin pa na rgyal ba shākya thub pa 'od kyi rang bzhin can bzhengs pa zhig las/ 'od zer mang po byung*/ rang nyid la thim ste bstan pa la phan pa'i brdar gzigs/ de'i tshe lha mo thams cad go khrab gon nas/ rlung nag 'tshub cing sngon la thal ba byung ste/ gling la sogs pa la bar chad 'ong ba'i brdar gzigs/ ca rar phyin pa na ma mgon gnyis ka byung nas/ dgra thams cad gnyen du byas/ bar chad ci yang mi byung*/ phrin las thams cad nged kyis sgrub zer ba byung*/ mtshur phur sleb pa'i tshe/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i sku grangs med pa steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad gang ba byung ste/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i phrin las phyogs med du 'byung ba'i brdar gzigs/ de'i tshe mtshur phur dgon pa'ang gling dang be ris bshig cing*/

mi su yang med pa'i skabs su pheb pa las/ lo ngo drug gi bar du bzhugs shing*/ phrin las rnam bzhi sgyu ma lta bur sprul nas/ gdug pa can rnams btul zhing*/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i mtshan dang bstan pa phyogs med du grags shing khyab par mdzad/ de yang mtshur phur phyin nas zhag 'ga' lon pa'i tshe/ dpal lha mo khams gsum la sku yis sleb pa 'khor dang bcas pas/ ri chen po rnams tsog por 'phen zhing*/ phyogs bcu kun tu rgyug pa zhag mang po'i bar du byung*/ gzhan snang du'ang 'ur sgra sa g.yo ba tsam byung bar 'dug chang 'thung ba la sogs spyod lam mi dge ba sna tshogs mtshur phu bas byed cing 'dug pas 'gro dgos snyam tsam na/ dpal lha mo'i zhal nas/ nged kyang byang shar mtshams nas pho brang 'dir spo ba yin/ khyed kyang 'dir bzhugs zer te/ pho brang ma lus pa spos pa'i ltas byung*/ gzhan rnams yid ches par bya ba'i phyir/ khyod tsho la zhag gnyis kyi bar du bstan pa yin te/ de phyin chad kho bos kyang mi mthong gsungs/ yang nam tho rangs cig lha mo 'khor bcas kyi zhal nas/ nga'i lha bkod thams cad 'di rnams kyis gtor/ da phyin chad gtor du ma bcug /gal te gtor na khrag gi kha phru gtor ba yin gsung bas/ de phyin chad shin tu gnyan par byung*/ yang dpal lha mo'i zhal nas/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i brgyud pa 'dzin cing*/ gdan sa skyong ba rnams sgrubs thabs mi shes kyang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gnas kyi bar du/ nged kyis stong grogs dang phrin las thams cad sgrub pa yin zer ba yang yang byung*/ yang mtshur phur tshes bcu'i tho rangs kha zhig la dwags po'i phyogs nas/ bla ma lha rje ri tsam la/ 'od zer nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bur rang nyid la thim ba byung ste/ sgrub brgyud kyi byin brlabs zhugs pa'i brdar mkhyen/ sa ga'i bco lnga la/ bram ze chen po la grub thob thams cad kyis bskor ba/ nam mkha' gang ba'i zhal nas/

skye ba med pa'i sgra phyogs med du sgrogs pa byung ste/ mchog gi dngos grub thob pa mang po 'byung ba'i brdar gzigs/ lha sar jo bo la gser gsol du 'byon pa'i dus su/ rta mgrin dbu stong phyag stong yod pa la/ slob dpon padma grangs med pas bskor zhing*/ 'od zer nyi zla ltar 'bar ba zhig byung ste/ snang srid dbang du bsdus shing zil gyis gnon pa'i brdar dgongs/ ca ra nas gdung rten bkra shis 'od 'bar gdan drangs pa'i tshe/ 'khor lo bde mchog kun du zhal kha dog sna tshogs zhal phyag grangs med pa phyogs bzhi nas/ rje btsun ma rigs bzhi dang zhal sbyor du yod pa/ mdun rgyab med par kun du gsal ba la dpa' bo mkha' 'gro nam mkha' gang bas bskor ba'i zhal nas/ nam mkha' gang ba'i bde mchog 'di// gang nas bltas kyang sgrib pa med// chos dbyings rab 'byams ma lus pa// 'khor lo bde mchog dkyil 'khor yin// gsung ba byung*/ rje btsun mi la'i gsol zhal la gsol ba btab cing rten rnams rab gnas byed pa'i tshe/ rje btsun mi la ras dkar po'i na bza' gsol ba mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho grangs med pas bskor ba byung*/ nam mkha' 'jas gang ba de 'ja' rnams mkha' 'gro ma'i 'od du 'dug /lo sar rgyal nya'i dus su tsā ri'i gzhal yas khang chen po de'i nang na tshogs 'khor bskor ba'i mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pa'i gtso mo khros ma nag mos mdzad pa gzigs/ grub chen nyid kyang der phyin pa dang*/ nyams dga' bkra shis pa'i ltad mo mang po byung*/ yang mtshur phu'i bla ye'i chos khri la bzhugs pa'i dus su/ ma mgon la sogs chos skyong rnams sprin gtibs pa bzhin byung*/ rong ba sogs dgra rnams zil gyis gnon pa'i dus la bab pa yin/ mthu khas mi len pa ci yin zer/

yang nub gcig lha mo 'khor bcas za 'og gi rgyal mtshan mang po thogs nas 'cham pa rmis te/ rong pa dbang du 'dus pa'i brdar 'dug gsungs/ yang nub gcig sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku grangs med pa sprin ltar du gtibs pa'i zhal nas/ spul sku'i 'gro don byed pa la/ /brtson 'grus ci yang med pa yin/ /gsungs byung ste/ phrin las rtsol med du 'byung ba'i brdar mkhyen/ yang tho rangs kha cig /sa gzhi bar snang thams cad 'od dmar por song ste/ cung zhig lon pa na/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams shig na sangs rgyas la 'khor nyan thos byang chub sems dpa' grangs med pas bskor ba gzigs/ sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas/ gzugs kyi de bzhin nyid ni gang nas kyang ma byung*/ gang du'ang mi 'gro /gang du'ang gnas pa mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes theg pa chen po'i chos tshad med pa gsung zhing 'dug / nam mkha' la 'ja' 'od kyi gur nang nas lha'i bu dang bu mos gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i mchod pa mang po 'bul zhing*/ 'jig rten gyi khams padma can zhes bstod pa'i sgra gsan/ de nas sangs rgyas de'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad me long gi gzugs brnyan bzhin gsal bar 'dug /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyang smig rgyu'am 'ja' tshon lta bur 'dug mthar sangs rgyas de 'ja' bzhin du yal/ de phyin chad phal cher 'gro ba lha mi'i sgra dang*/ 'dzam bu gling gi bya byed thams cad sems la gsal bar 'dug/ yang dben rtsa phug gi shing bcad pa'i dus su slob dpon padma la gsol ba btab pas rta mgrin zhal gsum phyag drug pa zhig gi thugs ka nas/ bya khyung dmar po gshog pa'i 'ur sgra dang*/ khyung gi skad sgrog pas klu thams cad rang dbang med par dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'dong zer ba byung*/ spyir yang slob dpon padma 'khor mi ma yin mang pos bskor te chos gsung ba yang dang yang du byung*/ de'i phyir slob dpon padma la yang yang gsol ba btab pa yin gsungs/

shar phyogs sman bla'i zhing khams yang dang yang du gsal/ de'i nyan thos rnams kyi rdzu 'phrul dpag tu med pa'ang gzigs/ mtshur phu nas gtsang la byon pa'i dus su/ bde mchog zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa dpa' bo mkha' 'gro du mas bskor ba sprin rlung gis skyod pa ltar gtsang gi phyogs la 'gro ba byung te/ gtsang phyogs su bstan pa dar ba'i brdar mkhyen/ gnam du pheb pa'i dus thang lhas gtso byas kha rag ma dang*/ gangs dkar ma la sogs brtan ma'i tshogs bar snang gang ba dar dang rin po che sna tshogs gzung nas bskor ba byed pa byung*/ 'brang bur mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes kyi sku las 'od zer dmar po zla gam gyi dbyibs can zhig 'phros nas/ gtsang dang ru mtshams thams cad gang ba byung ste/ dbus gtsang thams cad dbang du 'dus pa'i brdar 'dug /'brang bu na rab gnas mdzad pa'i dus rnal lam du rdo rje gtum po phyag na rgyal mtshan bsnams pa 'od zer kha dog lnga phyogs bcur 'bar ba gzigs/ 'jig rten gyi brtan skyong mkha' reg ma dang*/ gangs dkar ma dang*/ kong lha la sogs pa rnams bud med mdung shing tsam dar dkar gyi go zu gon pas bskor ba byed pa dang*/ phyag 'tshal ba byung*/ byang gnam mtsho'i klu sman gyis gser gyi bum pa zhig phul/ lha chen thang lha rgyun du 'ongs shing gus pas bskor ba byed pa 'dug /nyid kyi bu slob rnams la'ang brtse dung che bar 'dug mi ma yin rnams kyi nang na shin tu khas drag par yang 'dug gsungs/ yang nub gcig gi rnal lam du u rgyan gyi gnas gsal bar gzigs te der rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la ye shes dang 'jig rten mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pa dang*/ mgo brnyan can mang pos bskor zhing tshogs kyi 'khor lor 'du ba'i brda' skad kyang mang po gsan/ yang nub gcig tsā ri la sogs pa mkha' 'gro ma'i gnas mang po gzigs shing*/ tsā ri'i mkha' 'gro ma kun gyi gtso mo khros ma nag mor mkhyen/

g.yu mtsho'i dkyil na chos 'byung baṃ dang bcas pa 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba gzigs pas de shin tu gnyan pa'i brdar mkhyen/ yar chab gtsang po'i 'gram du byon pa'i tshe/ gtsang po rangs pa klu sbrul mgo zeng nge bar gyur nas phyag 'tshal ba byung*/ g.yag sde na bzhugs pa'i dus su nyi ma snga dro zhig nam mkha' 'jas gang ba byung*/ de'i dus na bkra shis tshe ring ma dang*/ kha reg gangs dkar la sogs 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gro ma mang po 'ja' tshon gyi gur nang na gar dang glu dang rol mo sna tshogs byed cing phyag 'tshal ba byung*/ bye gling dgon par ha bo gangs bzang mi dkar rta dkar can grangs med pa mdung dar dkar po bzung nas phyag 'tshal bskor ba byas/ khyed kyi zhabs tog ngas sgrub zer ba byung*/ de nub dmar gtor cig btang bas slob dpon padma dang*/ dpal rta mgrin hūm̐ sgra sgrogs shing gar thabs mdzad pa byung*/ rma bya na phyin pa'i dus dgyes pa rdo rje yab yum mkha' 'gro nag mo sprin gtibs pa lta bus bskor ba gzigs/ de ni rma bya ras pas chang zangs lnga tsam khyer 'ongs pa byin rlabs mdzad cing*/ nam mkha' la gtor ba'i tshe yin pas khong dgyes rdor la mos gus che ba'i brdar dgongs/ brag gong du byon pa'i tshe/ bla ma don grub pas tshogs mchod cig zhus pa'i dus su/ dus gsum mkhyen pa dang rje btsun ma nam mkha' gang ba gzigs/ de'ang don grub pa bla ma la mos gus che ba'i brdar 'dug gsungs/ spyi bsdus su gtor ma chen po zhig btang nas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la drag tu bskul ba'i dus su/ phyag na rdo rje khyung gi tshogs dang bcas pa gtsang lung par mi shong ba snyam byed pa byung*/ rgya mkhar dbu rir byon pa'i dus su/ gtsang dang mnga' ris kyi lha 'dre thams cad kyis bsu ba byed pa byung*/ yang dbu rir tshad ma pa 'dul ba'i dus su/ nyid rang rje 'bir wa pa dngos yin dgongs pa byung*/ der gtor ma chen po zhig btang ba'i tshe ma mgon sprin ltar du gzigs/

mdol chung du bsad pa gso ba'i rdzu 'phrul bstan pa'i tshe/ ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa rje nyid yun ring du gyur pa zhig byung*/ nye gnas seng ge dpal la dbang bskur ba'i tshe/ sgrol ma sngon mos nam mkha' gang ba byung*/ dbu ri'i mda' stag lung du dbang bskur mdzad pa'i tshe rje btsun ma zhal gcig ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa la/ mkha' 'gro sde bzhis bskor nas gar byed pa zhig byung*/ rma bya ras pa la bstan pas gtso mo de mthong ba 'dra gsungs/ yang dbu rir dbang bskur zhig mdzad pa'i dus su rje btsun ma yan lag ma tshang ba mang po byung ste khong rnams dam tshig gi sel yod pa'i brdar dgongs/ tshong dus mgur mor snga res byon pa'i tshe/ lha 'dre thams cad bros nas thal/ dge bsnyen ha bo gangs bzang de phyag 'tshal zhing khyed la nged rnams shin tu skrag par 'dug pas/ gzi brjid chen po mi ston pa zhu zer ba byung*/ de nas btsan brag na byon pa'i dus su rgya gar lho phyogs kyi mkha' 'gro ma kha dog mgo brnyan du ma yod pa mang po nam mkha' la 'phur te byung nas/ do nub dur khrod rnams na tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gdan 'dren pas/ khyed rlung sems la dbang thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed nus pas 'byon par zhu zer/ de'i dus su kārti ka dang*/ u rgyan dang*/ dpal gyi ri la sogs pa gnas mang po gcig tu byon/ grub thob mang po dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang lhan cig tshogs 'khor bskor ba dang*/ cir yang sprul nus pa rmi lam lta bur dngos su byung gsung zhing*/ gzhan snang du sku khams cung zad mi bde ba'i tshul bstan/ yang dbu ri nas rma bya la bzhud pa'i tshe 'khor lo bde mchog nam mkha' gang ba/ 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba byung ste 'gro don rgya chen po 'grub pa'i brdar dgongs/ yang phyir lam tshong 'dus 'gur mor pheb cing rab gnas mdzad pa'i dus su/

slob dpon padma dang*/ thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho nam mkha' gang ba la 'od zer 'ja' tshon lta bur kun du 'phro ba byung*/ de nyid duu sa 'dul mdzad pa'i tshe sa'i lha mo brtan mas nam mkha' la sa 'thor ba dang*/ khrom mgu'i mdzad pa'i tshe mkha' 'gro rgya mtshos gar byed pa byung*/ tshur lam jo mo gangs dkar gyi mgul du gangs dkar mas gtso byas brtan ma bcu gnyis dang*/ 'jig rten srid pa'i ma mo 'tshogs nas mtshan rangs par phyag 'tshal zhing bskor ba byed pa byung*/ dbyar sgang kha ba pus nub tsam zhig babs pa de khong rnams kyis dngos grub phul ba'i brdar dgongs/ yang mtshur phur byi ba lo'i tshes gcig la/ tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul ba byung ste/ lha'i rtsar rlung sems 'dus pa'i brdar mkhyen/ yang mtshur phur nam mkha' 'jas gang ba'i dbus na phag mo zhal bzhi ma yab dang bcas pa mkha' spyod dkar dmar gyis gtso byas pa'i mkha' 'gro ma thams cad 'dus te dngos grub stsol ba'i gzigs snang byung*/ yang thugs rje chen po zhal phyag grangs med pa sku mdog dmar po la/ 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba la 'od zer re re la yang yi ge drug ma'i gzugs kha dog sna lnga la/ dmar po shas che ba'i sgra las/ spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i bdag/ phrin las 'od zer phyogs bcur rgyas// spros pas ma spros zab mo'i don// snying po'i dbang gis phyogs bcur rgyas// zer ba byung*/ yang mtshur phur byi ba lo dbyar zla 'bring po'i nyi shu dgu'i nyin/ phyag na rdo rje la khro bo bcu'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i zhal nas/ yod med las 'das bdag 'dzin med// ting 'dzin sems la dbang thob cing*// mthu stobs khro rgyal rnams dang mnyam// gdug pa can rnams khyod kyis thul// zhes gsungs te/ rje nyid gar bzhugs shing rab gnas dang dbang bskur mdzad kyang sa chen po 'dul zhing*/ dgra bdud thams cad 'joms pa'i rtags su mkhyen/

yang skabs zhig tu rje nyid spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par zhal gyis bzhes pa dang*/ sku'i bkod pa'i tshul sna tshogs gsungs shing*/ kho bo brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa la rang dbang thob pas ci byas nyan pa yin/ nga'i bu slob rnams la'ang gzhan dang mi mnyam pa 'ga' re 'ong*/ hor 'di dga' rab dbang phyug dang*/ gnam thel gyi sprul par 'dug pas bstan pa bshig pa la ngas sus kyang ma tshor bar 'dul zhing*/ gar phyin gar 'dug gi yul khams thams cad bde ba dang bod 'di je 'jam la 'ong yang shes/ zhes gsungs/ yang mtshur phur glang lo'i tshes bcu'i dus gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa gsal zhing*/ lha dang*/ klu dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ 'gro ba kun gyi gnas phyogs med du gsal ba byung*/ rang cag gi'ang tshe rabs mang po'i skye ba'i gnas dang*/ 'chi ba'i mal dang*/ gzhan don 'phrin las sna tshogs 'grub pa'i shul dang*/ gdan sa rten dang bu slob kyi brgyud pa yod pa rnams ci lta ba sngar bas shin tu gsal bar shes pa zhig byung gsungs/ yang mtshur phu na glang lo'i tshes gcig gi dus shig tu brtan skyong rnams kyis gtsos pa'i gzhi bdag thams cad 'dus nas/ khyed khams su ma 'byon khyed kyi gsung nged rnams kyis bsgrub zer bar/ nged thang gcig khams su 'gro dgos pa yod/ nga'i gdan sa dang bu slob rnams skyongs shig gsungs pas/ kun kyis phyag 'tshal zhing de ltar bgyi zer ba byung*/ stag lung du 'gro dgos dgongs nas 'bras skud du phyin pa'i dus/ khong gis ma 'ong zer nas log pa'i tshe/ ye shes 'jig rten gyi chos skyong thams cad khro shing 'khrugs pa gzigs te/ khong la 'khrugs pa dang ma legs pa 'ong ba'i brdar dgongs/ rag ma me shug brag la phyin pa'i tshe dam pa rgya gar gnam gyi skar ma tsam gzigs/ yul de dam pas byin gyis brlabs par mkhyen/ stod lung mda' la phyin pa'i tshe/ mkhar nag rdo rje rgyal pos bsu ba byas pa la mgo brnyan can bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/

dar zab la sogs pas sa gzhi bar snang gang ba byung*/ kho 'dug pa'i brag ri de rin po che sna bdun las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang du 'dug /kho klu'i rgyal po dung skyong gi bu yin par 'dug ste/ kho'i 'khor gyis dbus gtsang khams gsum thams cad khyab par snang*/ dbus gtsang gi sa cha 'di rnams kyi mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa khyed la 'bul zer ba byung*/ de'i phyir na dbus gtsang du'ang bstan pa dar nas 'ong ba 'dra gsungs/ gru gu sgang du gral dpon byon pa'i tshe mgon po'i lha dmag gis snang srid zil gyis gnon pa gz-igs/ yang g.yor po byang thang la byon pa'i tshe yar chab gtsang po'i sdong gru 'dor ma nyan pa'i dus/ mkha' 'gro ma mang pos nged kyis gdan 'dren zer nas nam mkha' la bteg nas byon pa'i thugs nyams shar/ de'i tshe steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin gtibs pa lta bus gang ba gzigs/ gzhan snang du chu la ma reg par 'ja' tshon gyi gur nang 'dom gang tsam gyi nam mkha' la bzhud pa mthong ba dang*/ la las bu mo mang pos 'ja'i snam bu la gdan drangs par mthong ba dang*/ slob ma phar khar thon pa rnams kyis chu la pus 'bogs mdzad par mthong*/ phar kar byon nas nye gnas kyis na bza' dang chab lh+wam la bltas pas chu la ma reg pa snang*/ yang de'i dus/ rgyal ba shākya thub pa la sangs rgyas dpag tu med pas bskor ba lho phyogs kyi nam mkha' gang ba yin ring du byung ste/ lho phyogs 'dir yang bstan pa dar bar 'ong ngam sems gsungs/ yang lo gsar rgyal nya'i nyin par rgyal ba rigs lnga la byang chub sems dpa' grangs med pas bskor ba mthong ste/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams kho na ma gtogs pa ma dag pa'i 'jig rten yud tsam yang med pa cig byung*/ yang mtshur phu na yod pa'i tshe rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras gser gyi khrab gyon pa mdung dar thogs pa/ 'khor gser khrab can dpag tu med pas bskor ba 'brug la zhon nas 'brug sgra sgrogs shing 'ongs te/

nga'i pho brang du byon dgos zer ba byung*/ de nas mi ring bar rgya nag hor dus kyi rgyal po go be las sngon gyi las dang smon lam gyi 'brel pa dang*/ grub thob chen po nyid kyi sku che ba'i yon tan rnams thos par brten/ gser yig pa btang nas gdan 'dren du byung ba'i dus su/ 'byon nam mi 'byon dgongs pa la/ klu rgyal sngags kyi bdag po dang dga' po tha dad med pa'i rdzu 'phrul 'ja' 'od lta bu bstan zhing 'phrin las thams cad rdzogs par 'gyur zer ba'i ltas gzigs nas 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes te gser yig pa slar btang*/ de nas 'byon par chas pa'i tshe dpal lha mo nag mo 'bum dang bcas pas/ khyed kyis da rung bya ba mang po sgrub long yod kyi nor thams cad mal du zhog zer ba byung*/ de nas hor yul du ma phebs kyi bar du'ang khams phyogs su sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ sde dgon gogs pa rnams gso ba dang*/ lam na yod pa'i skye bo rnams kyi don rgya chen po mdzad de/ rgyal bu go be la dmag chen po'i tshul gyis byon pa dang*/ rong yul gser stod ces bya ba'i sa char mjal zhing*/ de nas pho brang 'u tor phebs nas rgyal 'bangs thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur rgya chen po byas/ mu stegs lta bu'i chos log yod pa rnams/ thugs rje dang rdzu 'phrul gyis btul/ rgyal bu sras dang btsun mor bcas pa rnams kyi rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' nor bzang dang klu sgrub la sogs pa'i gzigs snang mang po byung*/ grub chen hor yul du pheb cing*/ go be la dang mjal ba'i lo 'di grub chen nyid kyis dgung lo lnga bcu bzhes pa'i shing yos kyi lo yin zhing*/ shing 'brug lor sa paṇa khu dbon gsum rgyal bu go dan gyis spyan drangs nas lo ngo bcu gcig song bar snang*/ des na phyis kyi blun po snying phod can 'ga' zhig gis/ sa skya pa'i pho rus la bsam nas/

grub thob bla chen 'phags pa min pa mdzad pa sogs cal col mang du smra ba la rigs mthun 'ga' zhig gis tshad mar byed pa ni ches ya mtshan pa'i gnas su snang la/ yig tshang mkhyen pa'i sa skya pa'i dpyod ldan dag ni de'i rjes su 'brang bar mi snang ngo*//

der rgyal bu dang yon mchod 'phrod pas rtag tu bzhugs par gsol ba btab kyang*/ ma 'ongs pa na chags sdang gi rtsod pa mang po 'ong bar mkhyen cing*/ thugs rje chen pos kyang*/ 'di na yun ring ma 'dug cig/ chags sdang mang po 'byung bar snang*// byang phyogs yangs pa can gyi yul// kun gyis bkur ba'i gnas su 'dongs// zhes gsung pa dang*/ mgon po nag po me'i phung po dang*/ mtshon cha sna tshogs 'tshub ma 'khyil pa lta bu'i nang na bzhengs nas dug gsum chags sdang rtsod pa 'ong bas 'dir ma bzhugs gsung pa dang*/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mang pos kyang sngon gyi 'brel pa'i stobs kyis byang phyogs su 'byon dgos par yang yang bskul bas/ zhal gyis ma bzhes pas rgyal po yang cung zad yi chad/ de nas byang phyogs mi nyag 'ga'i yul du byon/ grub chen nyid legs par bkur ba'i rgyal por gyur pa tshun gyi 'khor slob mang po yul der skyes shing gdul bya dus la babs par dgongs nas/ lha khang dang sde mang po btsugs shing*/ khyad par mi nyag gi yul go ra nya na pheb pa'i tshe/ rlung mi nyag gi yul g.yo nus pa tsam byung ba'i dus su mgon po ber nag can/ sku shin tu che ba zhabs ya gcig bzhag na 'dzam bu gling du mi shong ba tsam gzigs pas tshe rabs mang po'i gdul bya mi nyag na yod pa'i phyir/ lha khang gi sde tshugs/ khyed kyi rta sga de/ der zhog dang sa srung rgyal pos thos nas 'dzam gling khyab pa'i snyan pa 'byung*/ zhes gsungs ba dang*/ gzhan yang dpal lha mo dang rnam thos sras gser gyi mche ba can dang*/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyis/ 'jig rten pa rnams ngo mtshar zhing*// bstan pa rgya mtsho 'byung ba'i phyir// gnas 'dir cung zhig bzhugs pa dang*// gtsug lag khang chen bzhengs par zhu// zhes yang yang bskul bas zhag brgya'i nang du 'phrul snang sprul pa'i lha khang rdzogs par bzhengs/ de'i dus su du ma ro gcig pa'i dbyings su rnam par snang mdzad kun tu zhal phyogs bzhi na rigs bzhi phyag rgya dang bcas pa zhing khams thams cad sku la rdzogs shing*/

skus zhing kun la khyab/ sku'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas phyogs kun du bskor zhing khyab par bzhugs pa yun ring du gsal bar gzigs te/ phyis 'dzam gling rgyal po la dngul bre stong tsam zhus nas/ mi nyag gi yul thams cad du lha khang sum stong tsam zhig pa gso ba dang gsar du mdzad/ de ni sku mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo 'byung ba'i snga ltas tsam yin par snang*/ dad pas 'dus pa'i skye bo dpag tu med par dbang bskur zhing*/ sku bzhi ngo sprod kyi khrid kyis theg pa chen po'i lam la bcug /bde mchog drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ sangs rgyas bdun dang*/ spyan ras gzigs dang*/ 'phags ma sgrol ma sogs yi dam gzigs snang rgyun chad med par byung*/ khyad par ku ru kulle'i zhal nas lcags kyu lta bu'i 'od zer spro zhing*/ 'byon par bskul bas byang phyogs ling ju'i mkhar du byon/ der zin shing la sogs pa'i rtog ge pa rnams bdud kyis rgyud bskul nas phrag dog rlung ltar 'tshub pa rnams/ byin rlabs kyi gzi brjid dang rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs pas btul zhing pham par byas/ rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro sprin gtibs pa ltar gzigs shing*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i zhal nas/ yid 'ong mdangs gsal 'ja' tshon gsal// ma 'jigs ma 'jigs rnal 'byor pa// nga ni snang srid dbang gi lha// dbang mchog dbang du bsdu bar bya// zhes mkha' 'gro'i brda' skad du gsung ba gsan/ de'i tshe yul khams de thams cad dbang du bsdus shing dgra rnams gnyen dang*/ bar chad thams cad dngos grub tu shar/ thams cad la sku bzhi ngo sprod kyi gnad kyis/ nyin med mtshan med du dbang bskur ba'i tshe du ma ro gcig pa'i dbyings su/ thugs mi bskyod rdo rje sems dpa' thugs kyi rgyal ba sras bcas mtha' yas pas bskor zhing bzhugs pa'i snang ba yun ring po'i bar du byung ba ni/ thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i snga ltas tsam yin par dgongs/

de nas yos lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gcig gi tho rangs kar tshangs pa dung thod can 'ongs nas 'byon par bskul bas kong jo'i mkhar du byon/ bud med ser mo bum pa thogs pa zhig gis nor bu rin po che phul nas/ khyed kyi yon bdag ngas bgyi/ yul khams 'dir 'gro don rgya chen po 'byung zer ba byung*/ yul de dang 'brel ba'i mi nyag dang hor gyi mtshams rnams su/ rgya hor mi nyag la sogs pa'i mi rigs mi gcig pa thams cad rang dbang med par 'dus shing*/ sa g.yo ba tsam gyis thams cad rang dbang med par dbang bsgyur ba'i tshe/ du ma ro gcig mtha' yas pa'i dkyil 'khor du snang ba mtha' yas las gsung gi lha tshogs 'od zer dmar po'i tshul du 'phro zhing thim pa yun ring du byung ba ni/ gsung mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i snga ltas tsam du dgongs/ de nas 'brug lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gcig gi tshe/ thang lha dang brtan ma bcu gnyis sogs bod yul gyi gzhi bdag rnams 'ongs nas/ lan gcig bod du 'byon par gsol ba btab pas/ cong kha'i yul du byon/ der se phu bya rgod kyi dgon pa na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ du ma ro gcig gi dbyings su phrin las yongs su rdzogs pa don yod grub pa la/ bya ba grub pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyis bskor zhing 'od zer ljang gu byang phyogs su 'phro zhing phyogs kun du khyab pa yun ring du byung ba ni 'phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i snga ltas tsam yin par dgongs/ de'i dus su zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du nam mkha' 'ja' 'od 'khyil zhing me tog gi char babs pa byung*/ der mi dkar dar gyi ral ga gyon zhing 'od 'phro ba zhig gis/ nga gnam lha dkar po yin/ bla ma khyed byang phyogs kyi yul du 'byon par zhu zer ba sogs/ ye shes pa dang 'jig rten gyi lha tshogs mang pos 'byon dgos par bskul ba bzhin/ rgyal po chen po mong gor gan gy-is snyan pa gsan nas/

gser yig pa stobs ldan mang po spyan 'dren du mngags pa 'byor/ 'byon par zhal gyi bzhes shing byon pa'i lam du hor mi nyag gi mtshams su cha ga pa'i gnod pas nyi ma 'grib pa byung bas rdo rje srin po'i lta stangs kyis skad cig la med par mdzad/ de'i sa dang bye ma thams cad kyang byin gyis brlabs pas da lta yang 'bu sbrang gi gnod pa byung na thub pa yod ces grags/ de ni thung mong gi grub rtags 'go ma tsam yin gsungs/ gzhan yang gser yig pa rnams kyis mngon sum du mthong ba'i rdzu 'phrul mang po bstan/ da lag rtan phebs pa'i tshe byang phyogs rgya mtshor thug gi bar gyi klu dang sa bdag sogs gdug pa can gyi lha 'dre 'tshogs nas bar chad dang nyams tshad sna tshogs byas shing*/ khyad par rgyal po'i pho brang du pheb par nye ba na/ gnam lcags kyi thog char bzhin du phab pa rta mchog gi rgyal po'i brtul zhugs kyis zil gyis mnan cing dbang du bsdus nas dam la 'dogs par mdzad/ 'ang gi bya ba'i yul du rgyal po chen po yum sras 'khor bcas dang dus gsum du 'brel tshul sna tshogs thugs la shar/ de yang sngon glang po che'i gzugs kyis sdig spyod kyi rgyal po btul nas gnas spar ba de/ rje dus mkhyen kam po gnas nang na bzhugs tshe kam po rdza la bya bar bon po 'byor pa can zhig tu gyur/ zhabs thog thams cad bsgrubs ci yod chos rje'i phyogs su btang bas yon bdag dgon pa bar grags pa de/ rgya mi nyag hor bod thams cad kyi rgyal po mong gor gan du gyur te/ sngon gyi btsun mo sras nye du dmag dpon la sogs pa rnams kyang dpon mo il jig ma dang*/ rgyal bu a ri bo ka sogs su skyes par gzigs/ des na sngon gyi bag chags kyis rgyal blon 'khor bcas kyis mu stegs er ga 'o yi grub mtha' 'dzin cing*/ er ka'i slob dpon mang po'i dbang du gyur pas mu stegs su 'gyur ba mkhyen nas/

mo gor gan gcig pu lam log pa las bskyab pa'i ched kho nar rje nyid kyis bsams bzhin du srid pa bzung ba ste/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pas sems can gcig gi don du bod yul 'ongs shing*/ yun ring du mi 'dug gsungs pa der dgongs/ 'brug gi lo la pho brang 'ur rdor rgyal brgyud thams cad 'tshogs pa'i dus su pheb pa'i tshe/ byang chub kyi sems dang spyan ras gzigs kyi lta stangs kyis rgyal po mo 'gor gan byin gyis brlabs shing dag pa'i snang ba du ma bstan/ rgyal pos bar chad bzlog par gsol ba btab pas zhal gyis bzhes/ zas nor dang rgyal srid la phongs pa med par gnam mchod cing*/ bla ma'i gdan sa gso ba dang*/ bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen bsgrub pa dang*/ btson rar gnas pa'i nyes can 'don par bka' stsal pas/ rgyal pos kyang gsung bzhin du mdzad/ klu bdud kyi gzugs 'jigs su rung ba dang*/ rā hu la'i rnam 'phrul sogs kyis thog ser char bzhin 'bebs pa sogs bar chad dang cho 'phrul sna tshogs pa byung ba rnams khro bcu'i dkyil 'khor las/ 'dzam gling khyab pa'i me dpung spros nas bsreg cing 'dul ba'i cho 'phrul dngos su bstan/ hūm̐ gi sgra sgrogs shing chibs rgyug mdzad/ 'brug lo dgun zla ra ba'i tshes dgu'i nam gyi cha smad la mgon po lha dmag dang bcas pa ha ha sgrogs shing sprin ltar gtibs nas/ rgyal brgyud thams cad 'tshogs pa'i dus su 'jig rten na che ba'i dngos grub 'byung bas/ rnal 'byor pa'i nus pa 'don par 'tshal lo/ /zhes bskul bas/ zin shing dang ta'o gsi dang er ka'o la sogs pa'i rtog ge pa rnams la zla ba 'di'i tshes bcu dgu la/ rang cag stobs dang rdzu 'phrul 'gran par bya yi shog cig /ces phyogs rnams su dril bsgrags shing dus bor bas/ sus kyang 'gran ma nus par zhabs la btud/ lo de'i zla ba dgu pa nas bcu gnyis pa'i bar du khro bcu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis kha ba dang lhag pa rnams bcad cing*/

drod dang ldan par mdzad pas hor gyis mi rnams ngo mtshar du gyur/ a la ga'i pho brang du rgyal po chen po sogs skal ldan rnams la 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur zhing*/ rgyal pos sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor dngos su mthong bar byin gyis brlabs/ gzhan yang ngo mtshar gyi cho 'phrul mang po bstan/ grub chen nyid 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du bzhengs nas/ pho brang nang gi chang mdzod thams cad dus gcig la bzhes pa'i rdzu 'phrul bstan/ phrin las rnam bzhi'i sgo nas rje 'bangs thams cad kyi snang ba rang dbang med par 'gyur nas/ mu stegs kyi grub mtha' las rje 'bangs thams cad bzlog cing*/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa la btsud/ de'i tshe na bram ze chen po sa ra ha la grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhis bskor zhing*/ grub thob re res kyang rnal 'byor dpag tu med pa 'phrul zhing byang phyogs hor gyi yul khams thams cad khyab par gar la sogs pa rnam 'gyur bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad cing*/ /rje 'bangs thams cad byin gyis rlob pa dang thim pa'i snang ba nyin zhag gsum tsam la byung ba'i dus su/ sa srung rgyal po sems gzung 'dzin las grol zhing*/ rje'u 'bangs thams cad blo yangs par gyur nas/ mdzod kyi rgyal srid thams cad chags thogs med par kun la bkye ba'i dus su/ blo che ba dang gtong ba che ba zhes pa'i sgra thos pa yang byung*/ de phyin chad rje sa ra ha la grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhis bskor ba 'di bri ba shin tu byin rlabs che bar 'dug gsungs/ de'i tshe na 'dzam gling gi rgyal po la nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i sdom pa zla ba gcig la dus gsum du bsrung du bcug cing*/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur zhing*/ sku bzhi ngo sprod kyi khrid dang byin rlabs rgyun chad med par mdzad/ rgyal po nges shes brtan zhing nyams myong bzang po rgyud la shar/

chab 'og gi mi sde thams cad zla ba so so'i dus chen rnams la/ sems can gyi srog mi gcod cing sha mi za bar rang rang gi grub mtha' dang mthun par sdom pa bsrung dgos pa'i 'ja' sa bsgrags/ dus chen bzhi la khrims kyang mi gcad par dge ba la bkod par bkas gnang*/ de'i tshe na mdzod thams cad kyi zas nor rnams kyang*/ lugs lnga'i bla mchod rnams la phyogs med du bkye zhing*/ sems can rnams la snyoms par sbyin pa gtong ba dang*/ btson dong sprugs thang bcu gsum zhus pa gnang zhing thams cad tshe thar du bcug pa ste/ gu rum na rgyal po nyid kyis phyag len mdzad nas/ 'dzam bu gling na khyad par 'phags pa'i lha khang chen po bzhengs pa dang*/ rgyal khams thams cad na lha khang mchod rten zhig pa gso ba dang*/ gsar du lha rten mang po bzhengs pa rnams la yul khams kyi nor mdzod thams cad chags thogs med par bkye ba la sogs pa dkar po dge ba'i phyogs bsam gyis mi khyab cing brjod las 'das pa/ grub thob chen po'i bkas bskul nas mdzad/ de'i tshe rgyal po'i khrims 'og tu tshud tshad thams cad mi dge ba bcu spangs shing*/ dge ba bcu la mos nas gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa dar bar byas shing*/ thams cad la smin grol dbang gi rgyal mtshan phyar bar mdzad cing*/ gsung yi ge drug ma'i rang sgra phyogs med du bsgrags/ rgyal po chen po'ang lam rnal ma rtogs pas da ni gar skye gar byung gar gnas kyang*/ 'brel ba bzang ngan 'bring gsum thogs tshad rim gyis mtho ris dang thar pa la 'god nus zhes gsungs/ de'i rjes su rgyal po'i khab hor dang sog po'i yul khams kyi sa cha/ cha ga ta'i rgyal sa na pheb pa'i dus su dgos 'dod char bzhin du 'bab cing*/ phyi rol mu stegs kyi tshogs rnams kyang dad cing gus pa sprin ltar 'du ba'i dus su/ sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung ldan du ma ro gcig dang tha dad med par/ yon tan gyi rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyis bskor ba/

'od zer ser po phyogs kun du khyab pa'i dag snang yun ring du byung ba ni/ yon tan mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i snga ltas tsam yin zhing*/ yon tan thams cad rang nyid la rdzogs par dgongs/ de nas rgyal po dang mchod yon lhan cig tu lu pan shan na pheb pa'i tshe/ 'dzam gling bdag por he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlabs/ ltas dang cho 'phrul dpag med byung zhing*/ rnal 'byor ma'i zhal nas/ grub thob gsum gyis byin brlabs shing*// dharma siddhi zhes bya ba// phyi nang grub mtha' shan 'byed cing*// sangs rgyas bstan la bya ba byas// rnal 'byor dbang phyug e ma ho// zhes gsungs/ der rgya hor gyi rje 'bangs thams cad 'dus shing*/ thams cad kyis dad pa mos gus bkur sti rim gro phun sum tshogs pa mdzad pa'i dus su/ duu ma ro gcig chos kyi dbyings rab 'byams yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ sems can dang sangs rgyas thams cad gcig tu ye shes lhun gyis grub par yun ring por phyogs med tu rtogs shing*/ kun khyab kun gsal sprin med nam mkha' la nyi ma shar ba bzhin du yun ring 'phel 'grib med par shar/ hor dang rgya'i mtshams su thun pa chen pos mnar ba'i tshe/ rgyal pos gsol ba btab pas/ grub thob chen po klu rgyal sngags kyi bdag po kha rlangs sprin ltar gtibs pa gzigs pa la char dbab pa'i bka' bsgos pas/ nyin phyi mar kha ba chen po phyogs med du babs/ der rgyal po thugs dgyes nas bla ma dang dge 'dun rnams la gser gyi 'bul ba rgya che ba phul/ rgyal po dbyar bzhugs kyis khyi tan dang*/ yul dang*/ lu pan shan dang*/ tshan gyi mkhar rnams su rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal bcu drug par bzhengs nas/ snang srid thams cad zhal du brngubs te zla ba gsum gyi bar du thog ser dang 'brug sgra char rgyun drag po rnam zil gyis mnan cing skem par mdzad/

yon mchod rgya dang mi nyag gi mtshams su bzhugs pa'i tshe/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pa seng ge la chibs pa grub thob mang pos bskor ba'i zhal nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la 'phel 'grib 'byung bas da lo bod la gshegs par zhu gsung ba 'byung*/ de la brten nas rgyal khams kyi 'pho 'gyur sna tshogs 'byung ba mkhyen yang*/ rgyal pos sman tse'i yul du mchod yon lhan cig par 'byon ba'i zhu ba phul kyang*/ zhal gyis ma bzhes par da ni bod yul du bya ba rgya chen po bsgrub pa'i phyir 'gro gsungs/ rgyal po'ang dgyes bzhin du bsnyen bkur 'bul nod rgya chen po phul nas/ ban de thams cad khyed shes su chug /chos kyi khrims legs par mdzod gsung ba'i lung byung*/

de nas grub chen nyid yar byon cing tha hu chu ma mkhar du phebs ba'i tshe/ mkhar nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gsan shang gsan shing dbang po rnams 'dus nas/ chu ma mkhar 'di'i phu na nags ri chen po yod pa la dgon pa btab/ mkhar chen po nged rnams kyi byed nas bzhugs dgos zer ba'i dus na/ rgyal ba shākya thub pa la sprul ba'i sku steng 'og phyogs mtshams khyab par duu ma ro gcig gi dbyings su gcig gis gcig mi sgrib ba'i snang ba yun ring du byung ba'i dus su 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag cing sgyu ma sprul pa 'dra ba'i phyir na/ gang dang gang yang mi byed cing sems can rnams kyi bsod nams 'grib pa'i dus la bab po zer ba'i rang sgra phyogs med du grags snyam byung ba na de'i dus na/ rgya rnams la 'di skad smras pa yin/ sngar dus la babs pa'i dus na 'dzam bu gling pa'i don byas shing sems can rnams bde ba la bkod pa yin/ da phyin chad du zla ba mar gi ngo bzhin du thams cad kyi bsod nams 'grib dogs yod pa'i phyir na/ gnas dgon mang pos ci zhig bya bzlas nas/ bod kyi yul du rings par 'ongs pa yin gsungs/ lcags sprel lo la rgyal po mo gor gan sman tse'i yul du gnam du gshegs nas/ de'i sras la sogs pas rgyal po a li po ga khrir bton rgyal po e chi ga'i dang go dan sogs kyis go ba la shang tor khrir bton/ de gnyis 'khrug nas a li bo ga hor yul du bros pa sa tshal gyi slob ma khams pa sga ras zhes pa tshe bdag grub pa zhig gis sngags kyi mthus bkrong*/ lcags bya lor go be la'am se chen gan de 'gran zla med pa'i rgyal por gyur pa ste/ 'khrug rtsod kyi skabs de dag tu grub thob chen po nyid bod du phebs par dgongs nas/ i la zhes bya ba sog po'i yul du pheb pa'i tshe/ tshe rabs mang po'i las ngan gyis 'thab rtsod 'di 'dra'i nang na 'dug dgos pa dgongs nas/ zhag bdun gyi bar du sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul zhing mchod pa 'bul ba dang*/

skye bo rnams la ras la sogs pa'i sbyin gtong rgya chen po mdzad pa'i dus su/ nub gcig rnal lam du sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i sku 'dom bcu yod pa tsam zhig sprin med pa'i nam mkha' la/ nyi ma shar ba bzhin du gsal zhing nyi ma'i 'od zer phyogs med du 'phro ba'i 'od kyi sgra las/ khyod ring por mi thogs par bod kyi yul du phyin zhing*/ sangs rgyas kyi sku 'di tsam zhig bzhengs pa dang*/ 'dud kyi cho 'phrul zhi zhing rgyal khams bde bar 'gyur gsungs ba'i sgra grags pa snyam byed pa'i dus su/ phyi nang gi 'khrug pa 'di 'dra ba'i dus na bod yul du ni nam zhig phyin/ lha 'di tsam pa ga na grub snyam pa'i dus su/ yang 'od zer las sgra grags pa/ rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs pa dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyis grogs byed pa'i phyir na/ the tshom mi za bar gsol ba thob dang 'grub par 'gyur zhes grags pa byung*/ de nas slar yang tshur la pheb ba'i dus su hor sog gi mtshams/ a ras zer ba'i gangs ri'i rgyud chen po zhig la/ 'dzam gling gi skyong ma rnams gnas pa yin zer ba'i rtsar pheb pa'i dus su/ rmang lam na ri nag po gnam la zug pa zhig gi rtse mo na/ nyid gcig pu bzhugs pa lhung la khad kyi dus na/ rta dkar po bya'i 'dab ma yod pa lta bu zhig byung ba la chibs nas/ rta la mi'i lag pa'i spor mo bzhin snang bas/ brag de la skad cig tsam gyis 'dzegs nas/ thang yangs shing rgya che ba nyams dga' ba zhig tu pheb pa'i dus su/ zhal nas/ rta mchog khyod ni ngang pa gser ldan 'dra// mi mchog nga ni rgyal bu don 'grub 'dra// 'jigs pa che las bdag ni khyod kyis bsgral// ces gsungs shing*/ rta dang nyid gnyis tha dad med pa'i sku las 'od zer phyogs med du 'phro ba'i sgra las/ da dung khyod la gzugs can dang gzugs med kyi tshogs thams cad bdud du langs nas 'jigs pa chen po 'byung ste/

de yis che ba bton nas rnam par rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /zer ba snyam du dgongs pa na mnal sad de/ mnal sad pa dang ma sad pa gnyis khyad med par dag pa'i snang ba bzang po byung*/ de nas rgya hor gyi sa mtshams su rgyal po go be las thog mar rgyal po nyid kyi bla ma chod du bzhugs par gsol ba la zhal gyis ma bzhes shing gzhan du byon pa la ma dgyes pa'i snying nad dang*/ gzhan dag gi dkrug sel la brten nas/ grub thob chen po la 'ja' sa drag tu bsgrags shing gshed ma rnams bkos nas thabs du mas sku srog la bsdos kyang*/ gshis skye med du rtogs pa'i dbyings su ro snyoms shing*/ rtsal 'gag pa med pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang nus pa'i stobs kyis zil gyis mnan nas/ bdud bzhi las rnam par rgyal ba'i ngang tshul skye bo thams cad la mngon sum du bstan pa ste/ rnam thar mya ngan 'das chung ba las/ rgyal bu go be la yi rgyal sar byon// rgyal po'i bka' phab nyes pa bsgrags pa'i tshe// spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis// sgra rnams grags stong brag cha lta bur rtogs// dar yug bsgril mas dam du bcings pa'i tshe// 'ja' tshon lta bu'i skur bstan rang sar grol// drag po'i dug blud chad pa bcad pa'i tshe// rma bya lta bu'i skur bstan dug rnams zhi// thur ma gri mtshon mdung sogs brgyab pa'i tshe// rdo rje 'chang gi skur bstan rdeg mkhan rengs// shing bzhi'i rtse la bcings shing bskyon pa'i tshe// rgyal ba rigs lnga'i skur bstan bcings pa grol// brag gi rtse nas g.yang la bskyur ba'i tshe// bya rgyal rgod po lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul bstan// chu bo'i gzhung dang mtsho gting bskyur tsam na// gser bya ngang pa lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul bstan// tsher dong me dong sbal dong bskyur ba'i tshe// thugs rje che dang drang srong me lhar sprul// mer bsregs chad pa sna tshogs bcad dus su// dpal ldan lha mos rlung dmar rdzu 'phrul bstan//

zhes dang*/ grub chen nyid kyi gsung rnam thar gdug pa zil gnon las/ chos sku rab 'byams rtogs pa yis/ /dmigs pa med pa'i 'gro don 'grub/ /drag cing gtum pa'i gdul bya yis/ /shin tu rmad pa'i tshig phyung nas/ /tsha zhing rtsub pa'i mtshon phyung ste/ /gshin rjes skye bo gshags pa bzhin/ /ha ha'i 'jigs sgra sgrogs pa'i tshe/ / thub pa'i bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'phyar/ /skye med zhi ba ta la la/ /e ma rnal 'byor rmad du byung*/ /da ni 'jigs pa ston no zhes/ /bstan pas 'dzam gling khyab par byas/ /u tsu ma la sogs pa yi/ /yi ge'i tshogs dang bral gyur kyang*/ /snang srid dpe char shar ba yis/ / dgag par nus sam a re 'khrul/ /'on kyang chos la bdag po yod/ /mdze lhog phol dang smyo 'bog dang*/ /rims dang ltas ngan sna tshogs kyi/ /bskal pa'i tshul la da tshur ltos/ / log chos pa yi khrims lugs las/ /smar ra ag rtsom gnyan par bshad/ /de 'dra'i lugs ni ngan pa la/ /sbyar tshe gshed ma cir gyur ba'i/ /tshul la rab tu blta bar gyis/ / bstan srung mgon po'i bka' 'khor rnams/ /sha khrag dmar la rol pa mthong*/ /dpal ldan lha mo'i spyan snga na/ /dmar gyi rakta 'khyil ba mthong*/ /tsha zhing rtsub pa'i gdul bya rnams/ /shin tu skrag cing dngangs par mthong*/ /da ni rnal 'byor 'di skad zer/ /nga ni rang byung rdo rje ste/ /rdo rje rgyal po rang dbang che/ /chos sku skye ba med par rtogs/ /longs sku'i yon tan rab brgyan pas/ /sprul sku 'jigs med brtan pa thob/ /tshe 'di'i 'jigs dang bral ba'i phyir/ /padma dbang po rgyal po 'dra/ /ma rungs pa yi lha 'dre dag /thams cad dam la btags nas bzhag /ma dag pa yi sa gzhi las/ /le bar nyis brgya 'phags pa'i tshe/ / sa 'dzin de yi pho nya ba/ /e ma rgan zhes bya ba yod/ /sdig par gyur ba'i sems can ni/ / las tshar ngan la zhe ba bcad/ /tshig rtsub gad mo cher sgrogs byed/ /yul khams gang ba'i thog ser 'bebs/

/srid pa 'khrugs pa'i shwa chud kyis/ /rigs can mi dang 'dab chags bya/ /khyi glang rnga mo nor lug sogs/ /gur dang shing rtar bcas pa dag /thams cad rgya mtsho'i gling du bskyal/ /kye ma kye ma ma dag pa'i/ /sdig can 'di dag snying re rje/ /dpal ldan lha mo'i dmag tshogs kyis/ /dam tshig ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /sdang ba'i dgra la bhyo bhyo zer/ /gza' bdud dmu can thams cad kyis/ /phrin las thams cad sgrub bo zhes/ / rang byung rdo rje la gtogs pa'i/ /bu slob yon bdag 'khor bcas rnams/ /thams cad sems kyi dpa' rtsal skyed/ /de tshe rnal 'byor 'di skad zer/ /chos sku rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /dug gsum rang bzhin rnam dag pas/ /me chu 'byung ba'i 'jigs dang bral/ / sdang sems ldan pa'i dgra bo dag /cho 'phrul 'di la da tshur ltos/ /snang srid dbang du 'dus pa yis/ /rlung sems gnyis la 'khor lo bskor/ /gang du phyin yang dgra dang bral/ / zhe sdang can la 'di skad smros/ /dus kyi tha mar gyur pa dang*/ /phrag dog can gyi tshig rtsub smras/ /sa 'dzin rgyal po rab tu khros/ /gshed ma pa la rang dbang med/ /khro 'khrug rngam pas rang sdug g.yos/ /rnal 'byor sems la g.yo ba med/ /rang snang lha'i gzhal yas su/ /bka' brgyud bla ma thams cad dang*/ /grub thob dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i mkha' 'gro rnams/ /mgrin gcig bsdad nas 'di skad gsungs/ /da lta ma dag dus 'di ru/ /sdig can ma rungs 'di lta bus/ /shin tu gdul ni dka' ba ru/ /mtshan ldan rje la gsol ba thob/ /'chi med tshe yi dngos grub 'byung*/ /dus min 'chi ba bzlog par nges/ /sku gzi brjid ldan pas rab brgyan te/ /mgur du shis pa'i sgra skad gsungs/ /de tshe rang byung rdo rje yis/ /chos sku rab 'byams lta ba rtogs/ /yon tan brgya phrag thugs su chud/ /mtshan dbyangs mgur gyi bum pa nas/ /bkra shis gsol 'debs 'di ltar byas/
