/ yang dag don gyi 'og min na/ /chos sku rab 'byams kun bzang la/ /phyag 'tshal nye bar skyabs su mchi/ /dus min 'chi ba bzlog tu gsol/ /'og min tshad med gnas mchog na/ /bzhugs mdzad rdo rje 'chang chen la/ /phyag 'tshal nye bar skyabs su mchi/ /dus min 'chi ba bzlog tu gsol/ /padma can gyi gnas mchog na/ /rang bzhin lhun rdzogs rigs lnga la/ /phyag 'tshal nye bar skyabs su mchi/ /dus min 'chi bar bzlog tu gsol/ / phyogs bzhi phyogs med gnas mchog na/ /rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma la/ /phyag 'tshal nye bar skyabs su mchi/ /dus min 'chi bar bzlog tu gsol/ /lcang lo can gyi pho brang na/ /gsang mchog rdo rje 'dzin pa la/ /phyag 'tshal nye bar skyabs su mchi/ /dus min 'chi ba bzlog tu gsol/ /shrī na ga ra yi dgon pa na/ /rgyal sras tai lo bzang po la/ /phyag 'tshal nye bar skyabs su mchi/ /dus min 'chi ba bzlog tu gsol/ /ri bo gser gyi dgon pa na/ / bzhugs mdzad nā ro pan chen la/ /phyag 'tshal nye bar skyabs su mchi/ /dus min 'chi ba bzlog tu gsol/ /ljongs kha ba can gyi byang phyogs na/ /skyes mchog mar pa lo tsā la/ /phyag 'tshal nye bar skyabs su mchi/ /dus min 'chi ba bzlog tu gsol/ /rgyal ba'i bzhugs gnas ti se na/ /bzhugs mdzad mi la ras pa la/ /phyag 'tshal nye bar skyabs su mchi/ / dus min 'chi ba bzlog tu gsol/ /bya rgod spungs pa'i sgam po na/ /bzhugs mdzad zla 'od gzhon nu la/ /phyag 'tshal nye bar skyabs su mchi/ /dus min 'chi ba bzlog tu gsol/ / lung bstan gangs ri'i gnas mchog na/ /bzhugs mdzad dus gsum mkhyen pa la/ /phyag 'tshal nye bar skyabs su mchi/ /dus min 'chi ba bzlog tu gsol/ /karma sangs rgyas gdan sa na/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug ras chen la/ /phyag 'tshal nye bar skyabs su mchi/ /dus min 'chi ba bzlog tu gsol/ /chos sku dri med zhing khams na/ /snying po don gyi rje btsun la/

/ phyag 'tshal nye bar skyabs su mchi/ /dus min 'chi ba bzlog tu gsol/ /sku lnga yongs rdzogs zhing khams na/ /bzhugs mdzad rang byung rdo rje la/ /phyag 'tshal nye bar skyabs su mchi/ /dus min 'chi ba bzlog tu gsol/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rnam 'phrul bka' brgyud bla ma la/ /lhag bsam dang bas gsol ba 'debs/ /'chi med rdo rje'i sa thob shog /de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i tshe/ /khams gsum gang ba'i 'ja' tshon 'khrigs/ /ma dag skye bo dad par byas/ /khrims gcod rang sems khong du chud/ /sa 'dzin rgyal po rab tu khros/ /gshed ma rang srog rang la phab/ /de tshe byang shar mtshams phyogs nas/ /dpal ldan lha mo drel zhon ma/ /dmag dpung bzhi khri bzhi stong dang*/ /myur mgyogs dang bas rab chas te/ /ha ha'i gad mo cher sgrogs shing*/ /dam tshig ldan pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /rdul phran tsam zhig gnod gyur kyang*/ /thal rdul bzhin du mi brlag re/ /dbu bsnyung bzhes nas gad mo sgrogs/ /de tshe ma la phrin las bskul/ /de nas lha mo rab khros te/ / rlung lha nag mo zhal gsum pa/ /'jigs su rung ba'i pho nya bskul/ /khams gsum gang ba'i rlung thog 'bab/ /sa rdo ri brag nam mkha' las/ /smyo 'bog nad kyi char pa phab/ / gur dang shing rta thams cad kyang*/ /bya spu gtor ba bzhin du thal/ /mi rnams kye ma kyi hud 'bod/ /lha rnams dkar po'i rgyal mtshan 'phyar/ /dpal ldan lha mo 'gying shing bsgyings/ / sdig can dgra yis lha 'bod cing*/ /dngangs skrag mi bzad 'bog cing 'gyel/ /sa rnams 'dar zhing ri rnams g.yos/ /la la rin chen srog dang bral/ /nad kyis btab pa bsam mi khyab/ /la la ba spu g.yos zhing 'dar/ /kun kyang dad pa rab tu skyes/ /sngon chad cho 'phrul 'di lta bu/ /kun gyi mthong ngam thos pa med/ /da lta ma rungs 'di lta bu/ /sdig pa'i las la zad pa med/ /ces 'byung*/ de'i tshe lha mos rlung dmar gyi cho 'phrul bstan tshul yang lha mo'i gleng gzhi sogs las 'di ltar 'byung ste/

dpal lha mo la gsol ba btab pas dregs pa pho dgu mo dgu'i 'khor dang bcas pa 'dzam gling khyab pa tsam 'dus nas/ rlung nag gi tshogs sa g.yo ri dgul ba tsam gyis le bar stong tsam gyi rgya mi rnams sa la yod pa gnam du khyer/ gnam du yod pa sar brgyab pa sogs kyi chos 'phrul bstan/ ces dang*/ rgya hor gyi mtshams kha ping hu zhes par/ dpal lha mo dregs pa pho dgu mo dgu'i tshogs dang bcas pa zhal gzigs nas/ ma gcig lha mo dpal lha mo// 'jigs pa che las bsgral ba dang*// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol// ston pa'i bstan pa bdag gis bsrung*// 'gro drug lam sna bdag gis 'dren// ma dus la babs po sa ma ya// zhes thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul ba'i dus su// 'jigs ma 'jigs rnal 'byor pa// 'jigs pa che las ngas bsgral lo// zhes gsungs pa snyam du dgongs ba'i tshe/ drang srong chen po lha dgu gdong mo bzhi dang bcas pas phyogs rnams su skar mda' bzhin du 'phros nas thal ba'i dus su/ cho 'phrul chen po'i stobs kyis 'jigs pa thams cad zil gyis mnan cing zhi bar mdzad/ ces 'byung*/ de'i dus su lha chen po 'dzam gling rgyan sku tshad 'dam bcu dang ldan pa bzhengs/ lha bzo ba phan yun na pagshi bya ba yod/ zangs rag ram pa zangs khung nas thon bya ba dang*/ nyid kyang bod yul du mi ring bar 'byon pa sogs bod du 'byams yig chen mo gnang nas/ nye gnas 'dan sgom la gser drel rgyab bdun sogs mtha' yas par bskur te/ 'dam cog rtse la nas gaṇḍir mthong ba gyis gsung ste brdzangs/ de'i tshe na shang pa chos 'bum gyi skye mched kyis/ lo ston zer ba'i sngags pa gcig dang*/ khrag seng bya ba gnyis kyis gong na bzhugs pa'i rje rgyal la dran gsos nas rgya mtsho'i 'gram rgya nag ke'u cu'i mkhar zhes bya ba/ chu ngan zhing tshad pa che bas yul gzhan gyi skye bo sdod du mi btub pa'i sar bskrad pa'i tshe/

der zla ngo brgyad tsam du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal sku mdog ser po zhal bcu gcig pa phyag stong yod pa/ phyag re re na lhung bzed re re'i nang na/ sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku re re bzhugs shing*/ zhabs stong dang ldan zhing 'od zer ser po lta bus steng 'og phyogs mtshams khyab par yun ring du gsal ba'i zhal nas ma 'ongs pa'i dus su/ rgya mi nyag la sogs pa rgya mtsho la thug gi bar du khyod kyis 'dul zhing grol bar 'dug pa'i phyir na/ yul khams 'di rnams lhan skyes ye shes su byin gyis rlob pa dang*/ nged kyis kyang dus gsum byin gyis rlob pa yin gsung ba'i sgra skad phyogs med du gsan pa yun ring du gyur nas/ phyis mi nyag gi 'phrul snang sprul pa'i lha khang gi rgyab ngos na/ ka gling gcig la de'i rtogs brjod ri mor 'bri bar mdzad/

gzhan yang 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi byin rlabs dang cho 'phrul mang po byung zhing dngos su mjal nas zhus lan nyi shu rtsa gcig pa mdzad/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpas byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ shes rab chen po'i rtsal rdzogs pa'i phyir na/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos thams cad la mi shes pa'am/ ma rtogs pa gang yang med par rang byung ye shes su rdzogs pa'i dus su/ kun mkhyen rang byung rdo rje yin zhes gsungs/ de'i tshe na 'jam pa'i rdo rje bde mchog gi lha tshogs rnams yun ring por mngon du gyur nas/ bde mchog la sogs gsang sngags thams cad kyi sgra dang don mngon sum du mkhyen/ sgra skad thams cad theg pa sna tshogs grub mtha'i phyi nang chos kyi 'khor lo'i sgrar gsan zhing*/ mkhyen nas bstan pa rgya mtsho mtha' yas sogs theg pa dgu'i chos kyi 'khor lo'i bstan bcos phal cher de nas gsal zhing rgyas par mdzad/ sngags kyi bdag po pho nyar bkyes nas char rgyun bsil ngad can phab pas thams cad bde skyid dang ldan par gyur/ rnam par rtog pa ye shes su mthu brtas shing rgya rnams la thun mong gi grub rtags sna tshogs bstan/ thams cad yid ches bas yon tan snyan pa phyogs med du bsgrags pa rnams rje rgyal 'khor bcas kyis thos nas byon cig zer ba'i lung byung ba dang*/ slar yang rgya mtsho'i 'gram du lo ngo gnyis bzhugs/ de nas pho brang chen po cang to mkhar du byon/ rgyal po'i log rtog cung zad bri yang da dung bgam pa'i phyir/ zhag bdun du gsol zas med par lha khang du bcug pa'i tshe/ mkha' 'gros 'tsho ba 'dren pa sogs kyi cho 'phrul rnams khang pa shel ltar byin gyis brlabs nas kun gyis mthong bar mdzad de/ rnam thar bdud dpung zil gnon las/ de nas rgyal po'i khab tu byon/ /dgyes pa'i mtshan ma cung zad tsam/ /da dung ma dad dad bya'i phyir/ /spyan ras gziḍa kyi lha khang du/ /zhag bdun bar du grub rtaḍa bstan/

/ sgo ni lcags gzer khro chus bsdams/ /srung byed skye bo sum rim gyis/ /res byas nas ni mel tshe byed/ /de tshe bde chen nyams dang ldan/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog nas/ / rje btsun lha mo zhal gcig ma/ /dngos su byon nas ma bsgribs zhal/ /gsal ba nyid du kun gyis mthong*/ /ye shes ḍā ki rnam bzhi yis/ /ha ha la yi dur khrod nas/ /bcu drug gzhon sha rab rgyas pa'i/ /bram ze'i bu mo gsal ldan ma/ /gtsang zhing dri ma med pa zhig / 'phos nas lus srog bral ba'i ro/ /mkha' 'gros byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ro zhes/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i ḍā ki rnams/ /ma la ya yi dur khrod nas/ /dri zhim ro mchog ldan pa yi/ /shing tog sna tshogs blangs nas phul/ /dkar phyogs nam mkha'i lha bran rnams/ /ro mchog brgyar ldan char du phab/ /gsang mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor mas/ / bha ga la yi pho brang nas/ /brgyud ldan rgyal bo'i gsol zas rnams/ /sna tshogs 'ongs nas rtag tu drangs/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas rnams/ /yi dam lha yi tshogs rnams kun/ /rgyun chad med par gsal bar bzhugs/ /dag snang lha yi gzhal yas su/ /blun po rnams kyis rtogs par byas/ /zhes byung*/ de dag gi tshe yul khams su srung ma rnams kyis me chu rlung dmar nad yams sogs kyi bka' chad drag po dngos su phab pas rgyal po go be la'ang shin tu 'jigs shing yon tan gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mchog tu ngo mtshar ba'i dad pas/ grub thob chen po'i zhabs kyi padmar btud de gong gi 'phror/ de nas dgung bdun 'das pa na/ /sa bdag rgyal po dga' bar byas/ /zhabs kyi padmo cod pan la/ /blangs nas dgyes pa'i tshig brjod de/ /phrag dog ldan pa'i gang zag kun/ / e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am/ /bsgrub brgyud 'dzin pa'i sgom chen kun/ /bka' brgyud rgyal sa ma zin nam/ /dge slong dge 'dun bcas pa kun/

/shāka thub bstan pa ma rgyas sam/ /mthu dpung ldan pa'i sngags pa kun/ /bstan srung che ba ma bton nam/ /zhe sdang ldan pa'i dpa' bo kun/ /zhi zhing dul bar ma byas sam/ /byang sems ldan pa'i rgyal sras kun/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan ma btsugs sam/ /snyan rgyud zab mo'i don gdams pa/ /kun gyi che ba 'don pa yin/ /de ltar go ba'i gang zag kun/ /bcu gsum yi ge'i tshogs chen gyi/ /sa lam bgrod par mi dka'o/ /zhes gsungs/ de'i tshe dad pas 'dus pa'i skye bo rnams kyis mchod pa'i sprin dpag par dka' bas mchod cing*/ de dag la nyin mtshan med par chos kyi 'khor lo bskor pas dus 'da' bar mdzad/ rgyal pos kyang nongs pa bzod par gsol te/ bzhugs par zhus kyang*/ bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyis bod du 'byon dgos par lung bstan pas/ karma pa de ma shi tsog ge bsdad kyang tsubs se mang ba ste/ karma pas tsab tsub 'di byed gyin 'dug /'di byas zin zer ba rgyal khams mis bzla dogs yod pa'i phyir dang*/ gong na bzhugs pa'ang mi mnyes dogs pa'i phyir na nged phyogs med kyi rgyal khams su 'gro ba yin gsungs nas ma gnang bas/ gar bde bar bzhud la nged la smon lam bzang po thob cig gsungs/ de nas cong to mkhar nas mtshur phu'i bar du lo brgyad mdzad nas bod du chibs kha bsgyur/ rgya yul hun ci mkhar du pheb dus/ ma mo 'khrugs pa'i kha rlangs kyi nad yams sna tshogs pas yul de nyog nyog por gyur pa la/ thugs rje chen pos bden pa'i tshig brjod cing*/ sman gyi bla'i skur bzhengs nas bdud rtsi zhu ba'i 'od zer gyis sems can rnams kyi nad bsal bar mdzad/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi zhal nas sdug bsngal gyi zug rngu 'byin no gsung pa gsan/ rdzing dang khron pa dang chu mig rnams byin gyis brlabs pas chu de 'thung tshad kyi nad gdon zhi ba byung bas thams cad dad de bsnyen bkur mtha' yas pas mchod/

rgya bod gnyis kyi mtshams shir kun mkhar dang nye ba'i sa rgya nag gi mgor pheb pa'i tshe/ rgya'i lha 'dre thams cad kyis cho 'phrul bstan/ rlung nag gis sa rdo khyer ba byung*/ chibs rta rgod cig yod pas 'phag nas sku sa la lhung*/ de ma thag rta mgrin dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad par bzhengs te/ rta skad shugs glur blangs pas zil gyi mnan te srog snying phul/ mi rnams kyis sku mdog shin tu dmar ba mthong*/ rgya hor mi nyag yu gur sogs kyi skye bo thams cad 'dus pa chos la bkod/ gar byon gyi nad yams chad/ 'khrug rtsod zhi/ dgon sde mchod khang 'khogs pa rnams gsor bcug /bande mi gtsang ba thams cad tshul khrims la sbyar/ sngags pa rnams bskyed rdzogs la bkod/ bstan pa nyi ma shar ba ltar mdzad/ cho 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam thar las/ rnal 'byor dbang sdud rdo rje yang*/ /a rta hor gyi rgyal sar phyin/ /ltas dang cho 'phrul cir yang bstan/ /ngo mtshar ltad mo dpag med mthong*/ /ya mtshan bkur sti rgya chen mthong*// padma thod phreng ji bzhin du/ /yul ris rgyal khams byin gyis brlabs/ /bdud dang lha 'dre zil gyis mnan/ /tshe rabs mang po'i sngon rol nas/ /yon bdag mchog tu gyur pa rnams// rgyal srid pho brang mnga' bsgyur zhing*/ /chos dang dam tshig smon lam gyis/ /tshe rabs 'brel pa zab pa'i phyir/ /yon mchod rten 'brel 'grigs par byung*/ /'dzam gling 'jig rten 'di nyid na/ /brtul zhugs grub pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /ltas dang cho 'phrul bsam mi khyab/ /'di ru cung zad bris pa lags/ /'dzam gling yul gyi byang phyogs su/ /ratna badzra rgyal khams bskor/ /don med sa mthar bskor ba min/ /bya ba rgya chen bsgrub pa yin/ /zhes gsungs/ de'i tshe na kaṃ po gnas nang de/ phal po che nas gsungs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thugs rje can gyi gnas yin zhing*/ gzhi bdag rdo rje dpal brtsegs sa thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis kyi zhabs tog byed cing tshe bskal pa gcig thub pa yin pas/

des sa bdag 'khor du bsdus nas/ khyod kyi bya ba thams cad bsgrub phyi ma'i mu mthar thug gi bar du khyod kyi gnas bsrung bu slob thams cad bdag gis bskyang ba'i phyir na/ sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kyi sku zhig bzhengs shing rab tu gnas par mdzod/ ces bskul ba dang*/ karmar pheb nas mtshur phur 'byon par rtsom pa'i dus na/ thugs rje chen po'i rnam 'phrul mi dkar po 'od kyi rang bzhin can zhig gi zhal nas/ dga' ldan nas mgon po byams pas 'jig rten gyi khams rnams la 'od zer bkye zhing*/ byin gyis rlob 'dug pa'i phyir na/ 'dir byams pa'i sku tshad dang ldan pa bzhengs dang*/ nged kyis lha 'dre mi gsum bskul zhing phrin las byin rlabs chen po 'byung gsung ba'i ltas chen po byung bas nor rdzas dpag tu med pa bzhag ste/ gnas nang du mar me mdzad dang*/ karmar mgon po byams pa'i sku bzhengs par bkas gnang zhing zhal bkod legs par mdzad/ rgya yul du pheb pa'i phyir lam karma na 'bum thang gi stod du chos khri brtsigs shing*/ len bzhi tsam du grub chen nyid kyis chos 'khor bskor nas/ 'di na'ang mchod rten zhig gyis dang*/ karma pa'i rus pu 'jug dgos pa yin/ 'ga' zhig gi brgyud pa gong ma rnams kyi gnya' na byas zin zer yong shes te gong ma 'og ma sus shes/ shes mi yod na dpang po gyis gsungs/ yang lan 'di res da dung karma pa re zhig mi 'chi bar 'dug gsungs nas tshems zhig mchod rten nang du gzhug par mdzad/ phyogs bzhi'i mtha' dmag bzlog pa'i rten 'brel du mchod rten bzhugs pa'i khang par sgo bzhi dod par mdzad/ de'i tshe nye gnas 'dan sgom gyis mtshur phur mchod khang chen po'i dri gtsang khang khyams dang bcas pa brtsigs pas snang srid kyi lha 'dres grogs byas te myur bar tshar/ lha bzo dang zangs rag kyang ji ltar gsung ba ltar byung*/ rus shing tshugs nas lo gsum na lha chen po 'dom bcu gsum pa zangs rag las lugs su blugs pa grub/

rgya gar gyi yul gru zhig tu hor dmag drangs nas gtsug lag khang chen po zhig gi gaṇḍir dang gser gyi bya 'dab dmag gis hor yul du khyer ba mi 'tsham pa'i cho 'phrul gyis sus kyang bdag gir byed ma nus pa/ grub thob chen pos ltas ngan g.yang du blangs te/ rgya bod kyi mtshams ga chu'i 'gram du rdzu 'phrul gyis drangs kyang rten 'brel zhig ma 'grig pas bya 'dab g.yon las ma 'drongs par de nyid du mdzod nag chen mo/ da lta sus kyang reg mi nus pa zhig na yod/ phyis bya 'dab g.yon gyi chung ba de nyid dum bu gnyis su byas te rgyab mdun gyi thog tu bkal/ bya 'dab chung ba gnyis stong par bzhag /rtser gaṇḍir chen mo gser bya khung gi gter nas byung ba'i gser bya zung dang bcas pa btsugs/ de'i tshe grub thob chen po khams nas yar byon te 'dam cog rtse lar pheb/ dbus gtsang na yod pa'i hor bod kyi mi dpon/ bla ma dpon chen/ zon 'u'i sri'i mi dpon khri dpon rnams thams cad kyis so so nas ja 'dren bsu ba bsnyen bkur byas/ tshogs chos chen mo gsungs/ zhwa nag gi bstod pa yang mdzad pas thams cad mi phyed pa'i dad pa skyes te mtshan grub thob chen po 'ba' zhig tu sgrogs/ nye gnas sogs kyi nga rgyal bcag phyir/ cog tse la dang gnam la dang sbrid la rnams nas rim par ma tshar ba e yin gaṇḍir ma mthong gsungs shing bkyon/ mtshur phur pheb tshe mchod khang yang chung*/ lha chung 'di 'dra ba gsung nas bkyon/ nye gnas dang lha bzos nyid lta bur ma song 'di las che ba blo khog tuu gshong ba yin/ lar sa 'di yangs pa zhig na gaṇḍir cog tse la las thag ring ba nas mthong zhus pas/ da slar cher gtong thabs yod dam gsung pa la de ma mchis lhag rnams la ldem gnyis dang rigs lnga bzhengs zhus pas shin tu mnyes te/ lha legs par grub 'dug khyed la nyams sar byas pa gsung nas/ slar byams pa dang spyan ras gzigs rgyal ba rigs lnga rnams kyi lha chen re bzhengs/

gtso bo la bde bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel bre gang*/ rje sgam po pa'i thugs ljags spyan gsum/ dgra bcom pa nyi ma gung pa'i tshems/ rje mi la'i gsol zhal/ phyag 'khar/ skyer rgang pa'i snam sbyar/ nyan thos mchog zung gi lhung bzed 'khar gsil snam sbyar/ rje nyid kyi tshems ring bsrel dang bcas pa gnyis/ gser dngul gyi bka' 'gyur po ti brgya lnga bcu/ tshogs dung dkar mo rgyangs grags sogs mtha' yas par bzhugs/ lha gzhan rnams la'ang ring bsrel bzhi'i tshogs kyis bltams shing nyid kyi tshems ring bsrel dang bcas pa re'ang bzhugs/ gzungs gzhugs grub nas lha chen g.yon du shin tu yo bas lha bzo bas thabs med cing sdug bsngal ba'i tshe/ grub thob chen pos khyod de 'dra mi dgos/ rlung sems la rang dbang thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa yin pas bcos kyi khyod rang tshod gyis shig gsung ste/ lha chen gyi mdun du skyil krung gis bzhugs te rlung ro len gsum bus nas bum can bzung ste/ sku g.yon du yon por mdzad nas g.yas su rim gyis bsrangs pas lha chen po tsheg tsheg zer nas 'khrongs/ drang por gyur pa na bla ma rin po che da ran da ran zhus pas shin tu legs par byung*/ rtsa rlung bsgoms pa la yon tan de 'dra yong ba yin gsungs/ rab gnas la rgyal ba byams pa 'byon pa yod pas/ chos khri chen po rtsigs gsung ste byams pa chos khri brtsigs/ gdugs rgyal mtshan gser 'phan dar mo che bkra shis khra ring sogs chos khri nas mchod khang chen mo'i bar du khyab/ de'i tshe dbang po rab kyis rgyal ba byams pa gtsug tor dbu ri dang mnyam pa dang*/ la las khri de skus khyab pa'i na bza'i lhub khri las 'phyang bar mthong*/ kha cig gis grub thob chen po nyid sku lha chen las che bar der bzhugs/ karma pa grangs med pas bskor nas phyag nas 'thor bar mthong*/ thams cad kyis mthun snang du grub thob chen po nyid sku sngar bas che ba zhig bzhugs nas phyag nas mdzad pa dang*/

lha chen gyi drung na mchod pa mdzad pa dang*/ bla yel chen mor chos gsung pa ste/ sku'i bkod pa gsum dus mnyam dang gzhan yang du ma mthong*/ zla ba gcig tu me tog gi char dang spos kyi dri sngon ma tshor ba rgyun ma chad/ lha chen dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du mtshan gsol/ rje dus mkhyen gyi thugs ljags spyan gsum bzhugs pa'i gdung rten bkra shis 'od 'bar dang*/ phyis rje nyid kyi thugs ljags spyan gsum bzhugs pa'i bkra shis lhun grub dang ldem gnyis rigs lnga dang bcas pa dang*/ phyis thugs rje chen po'i lha khang dang yig bcu'i khang pa mdzad pa'i rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang da lta der bzhugs te/ bod yul na zla dang bral ba'i gtsug lag khang yin pas der rdog pa bzhag pa'i skye bo la ngan song med par rje na rim thams cad kyis gsungs so// lo rgyus rgyas pa las ni/ lha chen 'dzam gling rgyan sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs khro bo rnams kyi mthu stobs dang*/ chos skyong rnams kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis sgyu ma lta bur rnam par 'phrul zhing bzhengs nas snang ba khri thog tu thon pa'i tshe/ bdud dang mu stegs log par lta ba can la dga' ba'i lha 'dre mthu stobs can rnams kyis bar chad rtsam zhing thams cad 'khrug par byed pa'i snga ltas su/ zhag gnyis la sa 'gul thengs drug tu byung*/ ka ba 'then pa'i thag pa chad nas bande lha bzo ba rnams de'u bsad byas/ lha bzo grwa pa phyi nang kun gyi snying du bdud zhugs nas 'thab rtsod kyi 'khor lo chen po bskor ba brtsams/ dge 'dun tshal pa la gtogs pa'i so nam pa 'ga' zhig gi snying du bdud zhugs nas/ rje dus mkhyen gyi dbon po byang chub 'das lam la bkod/ yul khams kun du nad 'khrug gnod pa sna tshogs 'byung bar 'dug pa la/ sngags 'chang rang byung rdo rjes de rnams bdud kyi cho 'phrul du go zhing rtogs nas rta mgrin rdo rje srin po dang*/

gsang ba mchog gi sku yakṣa rdo rje srin po'i lha tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du gsal zhing brtan pa 'dzam gling khyab pa tsam du zhag bdun gyi bar du thams cad zhal du bstabs shing zil gyis gnon pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi 'od zer cho 'phrul chen po bkye nas/ bdud dpung zil gyis mnan pa'i dus su sa rdo rtsi shing nags tshal/ khyad par mtshur nang phu mda'i ri klung thams cad rdo rje srin po'i dkyil 'khor du byin gyis brlabs/ dgos su dgon sar gyi phar thad kyi brag la rta mgrin rdo rje srin po'i 'od zer brtan par byas pas/ rta mgrin rdo rje srin po yum gsang ye dpon g.yog gsum me ri bcas pa brgyangs nas bltas kyang gsal bar bstan cing byin gyis brlabs/ khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor du chos thams cad kyi ngo bo rang bzhin mtshan nyid rnam par spros pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal pos rgya che ba 'dzam gling yang zhi rgyas su rab tu gnas par byin gyis rlob pa dang*/ khyad par du lha chen po rab tu gnas zhing 'gyur ba med pa brgya rtsa brgyad kyi 'od zer 'phro 'dus mtshur phu'i ri brag thams cad kyang rgyal ba sku gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du byin gyis brlabs shing*/ rab tu gnas pa'i 'od zer ting 'dzin phyogs med du spros pa ste/ ri brag thams cad la yang 'gyur ba med pa rdo rje'i lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis rab tu gnas par byas shing*/ khyad par du so ring zam kha'i rdo ba zhig la ting 'dzin gtad pas 'gro ba mos shing yid chags pa nyes pa'i skyon rnams 'dag par nus pa ste/ rten gyi bya ba dang dgos pa de yin pa'i phyir/ kun bzang yangs pa'i rgyud las/

de nyid rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas// bskal pa bdun nam nyi shu gcig/ rab gnas 'jigs par mi 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs shing*/ sku gsum lhun grub kyi rab gnas dang ldan pa'i rten la sems can rnams yid 'jug cing*/ chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid kyis rab tu gnas pa'i rten rnams kyi drung du sus phyin yang sems gnas shing 'bral mi phod pa dang*/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i sems gnas pa'i phyir na/ sems can rnams kyi yid la 'jug/ sems can rnams kyi yid 'phrog pa// zhes gsungs so// sngar gyi bar chad de rnams las ma rgyal na/ rgya chung ba dbus gtsang*/ che ba 'dzam gling tsam du cho 'phrul dang 'khrug rtsod chen po 'byung bar 'dug kyang*/ gsang mchog kun gyi bdag po'i rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje srin po'i mthu stobs dang ting 'dzin gyi rtsal chen po rdzogs bas phyi nang gi 'thab rtsod dang bdud kyi dmag tshogs rnams zhal du bstabs shing zhi bar mdzad pa'i phyir dang*/ zhi ba lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las yul khams 'di thams cad du byung zhing 'byung la 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i phyir na/ lha chen po'i phrin las dus gsum rgyun chad med par je che je bzang la 'byung ba ste/ skad ris mi gcig pa'i mi rnams kyis kyang thag ring po nas mos gus byed cing bdag tu 'dzin pa dang*/ mchod pa byed pa mang du 'byung la snang ba dag pa rnams kyis sku g.yo 'gul dang*/ 'od zer mthong ba dang*/ gsung 'byon pa thos pa dang*/ 'bring dang tha mas kyang dad pa skye zhing na tsha sdug bsngal zhi sems gnas nas phyir 'gro mi 'dod pa sogs nyams ltas mang ba 'byung ste/ lha chen po 'dzam gling rgyan mthong thos phyag mchod bgyid pa rnams 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan dang dngos grub mtha' yas pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro// ye shes mgon po lcam dral rnams kyang rang bzhugs la lha srin sde brgyad khyad par du rdo rje legs pa tsha zhing myur mgyogs can dang bod khams kyi brtan ma 'dzam gling skyong ma/

gnyan chen thang lha/ mkhar nag rdo rje rgyal po la sogs pa klu dang sa bdag rnams kyang*/ dam tshig chen po'i dbang gis dkor srung dang yon bdag dang lha chen po'i chos skyong dang bka' srung du rang dam rang gis bcas te/ rgyun chad med par phrin las sgrub pa'i phyir na lha rten lha dkor rnams la thag thug ma byas shing mchod na phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub cing bstan pa yun du gnas pa'i phyir/ shin tu gnyan zhing rab tu gnyan par shes par bya'o/ /zam kha'i rdo la 'od zer phog pa 'di la yang rab tu gnas pa de kho na nyid kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa yin na/ bla ma dge bshes mang po'i byin rlabs dang phrin las las kyang rgya che zhing yun ring bar 'byung ste/ mthong thos dran pas kyang sgrib pa 'dag cing byin gyis rlob par 'gyur ro// brag glo'i rta mgrin rdo rje srin po'i gzugs brnyan 'dra ba 'di yang dpal rta mgrin rdo rje srin po yis/ bgegs 'dul zhing bdud btul ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi 'od zer drag po'i phrin las cha gcig phog pa yin/ yul khams 'dir bgegs kyi tshogs rnams mi gnas shing*/ rig 'dzin sgrub pa po rnams la/ bdud mi zhugs shing bdud kyi tshogs rnams tshar gcod cing zil gyis gnon pa'i byin rlabs dang ldan pa ste/ nad dang*/ gdon dang*/ mdze dang*/ smyo ba dang*/ snying rlung dang*/ sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i mi rnams brag lha'i mdun du mos gus dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul zhing*/ dpal rdo rje srin po la gsol ba btab cing the tshom ma zos na/ sdug bsngal nad dang gnod pa las thar bar nges/ de'i phyir na mtshur phu'i ri lung thams cad la yang rab tu gnas pa'i de kho na nyid bzhugs shing brtan par byin gyis brlabs pa ste/ rmongs pa'i gang zag rnams kyis mngon du ma gyur gyi bar du the tshom za zhing yid mi ches pa'i phyir na/ byin rlabs dngos grub 'byung bar ga la 'gyur/

yid ches byin rlabs 'jug pa la/ rten rab tu gnas pa byin rlabs dang ldan pa la dad pa mos gus nges shes brtan pa'i gang zag yod na/ skad cig tsam gyis yon tan dngos grub rgyud la zhugs par the tshom med do// zam ka'i rdo ba 'od zer zhugs pa 'di la yang sku khrus gsol zhing khrus byas 'thung nas/ mos gus bskor ba zhag bdun bdun tsam re byas na/ mtshams med pa lnga dang*/ mi dge ba bcu dang*/ lji ba bzhi dang*/ log pa brgyad la sogs pa rnams kyang dag cing sgrib pa dag pa'i snga ltas su rmi lam bzang po sna tshogs rmi ba dang*/ dag pa'i snang ba 'char ba dang*/ lus sems bde zhing sdug bsngal tshogs rnams zhi ba'i nyams myong 'char bar shes par mdzod/ lha chen po 'dzam gling rgyan tshad dang ldan zhing bzo rgyu cha rkyen 'di rnams ma lhag na/ de bas kyang sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba dang sems can bde ba la 'god pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ba yin te/ 'on kyang mi skyon/ lhag ma la rgyal ba rigs lnga bzhengs pa 'di yang sangs rgyas bstan la phan pa dang*/ sems can bde la 'god pa mang po 'byung bar 'dug pa'i phyir na/ bzo rgyu zangs ma ra gan rnams rab gnas byin gyis brlabs shing rab tu gnas pa'i dus su/ yul khams thams cad du sa'i bcud gyen du bton zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlabs na yang*/ sems can rmongs pa dang the tshom za ba rnams kyis bden pa dang brdzun pa'i sa mtshams mi go ba'i phyir na/ dbu ru stod smad kyi yul khams 'di nyid du rgyal ba rigs lnga'i 'od zer cha gcig rab tu gnas shing byin gyis brlabs pas sa'i bcud chen po gyen du bton zhing*/ gseg ma yan chod 'bru dang nas su byin gyis brlabs pa ste/ khyad par du mtshur phu lung pa mthong chos kyi 'bras bu las 'bru dang longs spyod kyi mdzod du/ byin gyis brlabs shing*/ 'bras bu rtags mngon sum tshad mar bkod pa'i phyir na/ lha rgyal ba rigs lnga 'di yang 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub phun sum tshogs pa dus gsum dus med rgyun chad med par 'byung ba'i rten du bzhengs pa ste/

dngos grub rgya che chung du 'byung ba dang*/ skyon dang yon tan ji ltar du 'byung ba rnams yul khams kyi mi rnams kyis yang dag pa'i lta ba dang*/ log pa'i lta ba'i dbang gis gsol ba ji ltar du btab pa bzhin du skyon sna tshogs dang yon tan sna tshogs/ gsol ba ji ltar btab pa dang phyag ji ltar 'tshal ba bzhin du 'byung bar bstan par bya ste/ lha rgyal ba rigs lnga bzhengs pa la'ang*/ phyi nang gi mi rnams kyi sems su bdud kyi tshogs rnams zhugs shing bar chad sna tshogs byung ste/ dpal rdo rje srin po padma dbang gi dkyil 'khor du dbang du bsdus shing zil gyis mnan nas/ thams cad zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang drag po'i pho nya las mkhan mdzad par the tshom med pa'i phyir na/ 'jig rten gyi lha 'dre'i tshogs dang bdud rnams kyis rten chen po bzhengs pa dang*/ dge ba'i las ka rgya chen po mdzad pa'i dus su/ khong rnams pho nya las mkhan byed cing rten rab tu gnas pa can gyi zhabs su dam la 'dogs pa'i phyir na/ yul phyi nang thams cad du 'khrug pa sna tshogs la sbyor ba dang*/ lha bzo rnams shir bcug / yon mchod mi dum du bcug pa dang*/ yon bdag 'khor bcas sh-ir bcug /nar bcug nas rten rnams mi tshar zhing brgya la gal te tshar yang*/ phyi ma'i mu mthar thug gi bar du phyi nang gi 'khrug pa sna tshogs 'byung zhing*/ las ngan pa rgyun mi 'chad par bdud dang lha 'dre rnams mi snying du zhugs pa'i don des sangs rgyas kyi chos la bar du gcod cing*/ phrin las log pa sna tshogs bsgrub pa'i phyir na bdud ces ming 'dogs pa ste/ rin chen chos kyang dkon la rtag tu 'tshe ba'ang mang gsungs pa'i phyir na/ lha rten chen po bzhengs pa la bar chad sna tshogs 'byung zhing*/ bde bar tshar ba nyung ba'i don de yin pa'i phyir na/ sems can rnams kyis mi shes so/ /sngags 'chang rang 'byung rdo rje ni/ /tshe rabs mang po'i sngon rol nas/

/dpa' bo bdud las rnal rgyal zhing*/ /bdud bzhi rab tu 'joms pa'i phyir/ /rten mchog rgyal ba rigs lnga la/ /bar chad bdud dpung mi 'byung zhing*/ / 'dzam gling kun gyi dpal gyur na/ /mthong thos dran pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /dpa' bo rnam par rgyal ba ru/ /byin gyis rlob cing rab tu gnas/ /de kho na nyid ye shes kyis/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i rten mchod tu/ /'gro ba yongs kyi dpal dang mgon/ /rgyun tu phrin las 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so// yang 'bum thang thams cad rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha lngas gang bar gzigs te thugs rje chen po'i lha khang bzhengs shing*/ yig bcu dang phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun la tsha ba'i rgyun btsugs te thugs rje chen po dang sems can sdug bsngal can rnams tha dad med pa ni nga'i yi dam yin gsungs/ de ltar lha chen 'dzam gling rgyan dang ldem gnyis rigs lnga thugs rje chen po ste lha dgu tshar zhing gtang rag gi mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma mdzad pa'i dus su mgon po 'khor bcas kyi rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul sprin ltar 'du zhing rlung ltar du 'tshubs pa gzigs/ lha rten 'di rnams dang khyed kyi bya ba thams cad nged kyis bsgrub pa yin te/ da rung ma 'ongs pa'i dus su yang*/ khyod 'khrul pa med par bsams bzhin du srid pa nye bar len cing khams gsum khyab par gdul bya sems can rnams kyi don byed par 'gyur ba'i dus su yang*/ nged rnams kyis bstan pa bsrung zhing bya ba bsgrub/ gdul bya sems can rnams thar pa'i lam la 'god gsung ba byung*/ de'i tshe mtshur phu bla brang du rdo rje 'chang dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs rnams dang*/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha la sogs pa grub thob brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad khyab cing gcig gis gcig mi sgrib par zhabs skyil mo krung bca' zhing*/ phyag rgya sa gnon gyi phyag rgya mdzad nas ma hā mu tra'i sgra brag cha lta bur phyogs med du sgrogs shing*/

zhag 'ga'i bar du de ltar lhun gyis grub par bzhugs shing snang ba ni da phyin chad gar yang mi 'gro bar 'dug gsungs pa'i brda' dang byin rlabs su go nas/ dgon pa'i nang na yang yol ba byas shing bsdad pa las thams cad byin gyis rlobs shing smin cing grol nas dag snang sna tshogs dang*/ 'gro don rtsol bsgrub med pa mthal yas pa lhun gyis grub par 'dug pa de/ bla ma yi dam ḍā ki'i tshogs kyis byin gyis brlabs shing*/ chos dbyings rab 'byams ma hā mu dra sku bzhi ngo sprod kyis khyab pa'i brda' ston par snang gsungs mtshur phur pheb nas lo gnyis song ba'i tshe/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i mchod pa yar tshes gsum la byed pa'i dus su/ rdo rje 'chang rnal 'byor bla na med pa sprin med nam mkha'i mdog dang 'dra bar 'od zer sngon po kun la ma khyab pa med pa la/ rnal 'byor dang ḍā ki'i tshogs nam mkha'i 'od lta bus bskor zhing*/ rnal 'byor nam mkha' 'od ye shes mdzod kyi rnam 'phrul/ ind+ra bo dhi phyag na rdo rje tha dad med pa'i dag pa'i snang ba smig rgyu tsam ring por snang zhing byung ba'i dus su/ sgra brnyan lta bur gsang ba bzhi bcu'i rgyud dang*/ phyag rgya chen po thig le nyi shu rtsa lnga'i rgyud gdod nas lhan cig skyes pa'i rdo rje rigs kyi gnas lugs sngar 'dus shing*/ thabs dang shes rab dbyer med ye shes rgya mtsho gsang ba sku brgyad kye rdo rje bde mchog 'khor lo la gtogs tshad rnams ma rgyud phyogs re min par thabs shes gnyis med kyi rgyud de/ rgyud de dag gi gdams ngag med par sku bzhi ngo sprod ston pa rnams kyang ngal ba don med pa ste/ bskyed rdzogs dmigs bcas la sku bzhi ngo sprod du tha snyad 'dogs pa mang po ston yang*/ de kho na nyid kyi sgron ma 'bras bu'i rgyud kyi dgongs pa med na lo gcig so nam byas pa la/ phub sog mang po yod kyang 'bras bu med pa'i dpe bzhin du yid byed dmigs pa mang na yang*/

sku lnga'i sangs rgyas rang nyid la rdzogs pa shin tu dka' bar 'dug pa'i lung bstan brdar shar nas/ de phyin chad du rang byung gnas lugs ye shes rgya mtsho ngo sprod kyi gdams ngag phyogs med du bstan/ 'phags pa rin po che bod la phyi ma pheb pa'i tshe/ me glang gi lo la rje dgung lo don gnyis pa dang bla ma chos kyi rgyal po zhe gsum bzhes pa gnam du mjal/ phyag dang bzhugs gdan mnyam po mdzad ces tshal pa'i deb ther du 'byung*/ sngar ngas khyed la pho brang du byang chub sems dpa' mthong na dga' bar mtshan btags pa ma yin nam gsungs/ yang mtshur phur byi lo zla ba drug pa'i nyi shu dgu'i nub mo nam phyed tsam gyi dus na/ dpal mgon po ber nag can ral pa nam mkha'i dbyings la sleb pa dar nag gi 'jol ber gyis 'dzam bu'i gling khyab pa tsam gyis snying gi phreng ba se ral khar khur ba/ snying gi phreng ba la grangs du yod dgongs tsa na/ brgya lnga bcu tsam yod pa byung*/ phyogs bcu mgon po'i 'khor gyis bskor zhing khro gnyer rab tu 'bar ba thugs nyams la shar ba'i dus su/ 'di ci yin dgongs nas phyi nub gtor ma rgya chen po gtong ba'i dus na/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pa sku bltams pa'i gnas tre kaṃ khyim mi ngan rnams kyis gtor zhing*/ rgog tu bcug pa'i ltas yin par 'dug de'i dus na dpal mgon po'i zhal nas/ bstan pa dar zhing bstan pa rgyas// phyogs bcur bstan pa khyab par bgyis// zhes gsungs shing*/ de rnams la 'khrul pa med cing rdzun ma yin na tre nyag rab sgang shar rma zla'i sgang la sogs par ming yongs su grags pa/ karma pa'i bstan pa bu slob kyis phyogs med du khyab pa 'ong ste mchi/ khyad par tre kaṃ khyim gyi phyogs na mi don med pa rnams 'grim na'ang skrag cing sngangs pa 'byung yang shes zhes gsungs/ yang rdo rje 'chang dang rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i lha tshogs kyi 'od zer sngon pos ma khyab pa med par gzigs pa dang*/

bud med rus pa'i rgyan can mang pos ye shes kyi bdud rtsi phyogs thams cad du gtor ba dang*/ yang rlung sems nar son pa'i stobs kyis dag snang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor pho mo'i tshogs 'od dang gzugs brnyan gyi tshul du snang zhing*/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug grangs mtha' yas pa rgyun chad med par 'byung zhes grags pa sogs byung*/ yang mnal cung zad byung ba las/ phyi nang thams cad bde mchog rigs lngar gsal/ tilli nā ro yang de'i rnam 'phrul du snang zhing mnal sad nas zhag mang po'i bar du'ang dag snang de nyid byung*/ yang skabs zhig mnal lam du rten med nam mkha'i dkyil du byon song ba na/ chang ka pā la gang 'thung ba'i rnal 'byor pa zhig snang*/ ind+ra buddhi yin nam dgongs tsam na/ nga ni sku gsum sa ra ha// rnal 'byor bdun la sogs pa yi// grub thob thams cad nga las byung*// nga las byung zhing nga ru thim// zhes chang nam mkhar la gtor bas rnal 'byor pa dpag tu med par gyur te/ ā li kā li'i rang sgra sgrogs pa las bde mchog rgyud bla ma sogs gsang sngags kyi don thams cad rtogs shing*/ nyid kyis kyang chang ka pā la gang sprul nas gtor bas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dpag tu med par gyur te/ de thams cad nam mkha' la 'phur song ba'i rjes su nyid kyang sgyu mas sgyu ma sprul/ rmi lam gyis rmi lam sprul zhing byon pa'i tshe/ sngar gyi rnal 'byor pa de steng gi phyogs zhig na bzhugs zin/

sems kyi mtha' la thug pa med// nam mkha' la ni mtha' dbus med// ma rig 'khrul ba'i skyes bu rnams// 'khrul pas nam mkha'i mtha' 'tshol ba// rmongs pas nam mkha' mtho la 'jal// zhes grags/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad dang rnal 'byor pa de rje nyid la thim pa snyam du dgongs/ yang steng 'og phyogs mtshams nyid kyi sku phyi nang thams cad sprul pa'i sku shākya thub pa lta bus gang zhing*/ de re re'i mdun na 'phags pa 'jam dpal re re glegs bam sgrogs shing bzhugs pa'i gzigs snang yun ring du byung*/ yang 'khor ba'i chos drug cu rtsa bzhi bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa bzhir dra ba sdom pa'i dag snang shar nas de'i sgrub thabs dang dbang bskur mdzad/ yang mnal lam du yul khams chen po mtha' yas pa mtho dma' mang du snang ba la/ zam pa phra mo nyam nga ba mang po 'dug cing*/ brul na gnam sa tsam du 'byon dgos 'dug pa'i tshe/ ting nge 'dzin ye shes kyi rtsal gyis skad cig gcig gis bskal pa dran par mdzad de/ mtho zhing mtho ba'i rtse mo rgyal ba mtha' yas pa'i gnas su pheb pa'i dus su/ dwags lha sgam po yin zer ba'i rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang rtse bran bzhin du ri thams cad shel gyi rir gyur nas/ gang yang mi sgrib par dbus kyi rtse mo mtho khyad dang ldan pa'i steng na rje nyid bzhugs pa la/ rtse bran gyi ri re re yang thang shing gi bye'uu 'am/ snye ma'i spun pa bzhin shel gyi mchod rten 'od kyi rang bzhin gcig rgyab tu gcig yod pa/ tsha tsha mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad pa ste/ mchod rten re re'i nang du yang zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar gsal ba la/ rje dwags po lha rje chos gos gsol ba 'od kyi rang bzhin can bzhengs te/ phyag gi mdzub mo phyogs thams cad du gtad nas ltos shig gsungs shing*/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams mtha' yas pa gcig la gcig ma bsgrib par/

sku dang mchod rten gyis ma khyab pa med par gsal ba/ mnal sad nas kyang nyin zhag bdun gyi bar de kho na ltar snang*/ yang ri bo po ta la na spyan ras gzigs kha sar pa ṇi bzhugs pa dang*/ shing gi ri sprul pa'i pho brang na sgrol ma lha sum cu so gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor 'od zer mang du 'phro ba gzigs/ sbrul lo zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu la kun snang du dpal 'khor lo sdom pa rmi lam ye shes kyi 'khor lo la mnyam par bzhag cing*/ rlung sems gnyis kyi 'dus tshul la steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad du yi ge bdun pa'i rang sgra grag cing phyogs kun nas yi ge bdun pa char bzhin du 'bab pa zhig byung ba'i dus su/ gsang ba mdzod kyi sgo khyod kyis phyes gsung pa'i sgra gsan/ de la sogs pa dag pa rab 'byams dang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rol pa rnams kyi/ phyogs tsam mtshon par bya ba'i slad du gdul bya thun mong ba rnams kyi snang ba dang sgo bstun nas da lta'i rnam thar gyi yi ge rnams su 'byung ba bzhin mdo tsam bkod pa ste/ gzhan du 'phags chen rnams kyi skad cig ma gcig gi rnam par thar pa'ang so so skye bos blos gzhal bar ga la nus/ rje nyid kyi tshems kho nas 'gro don mdzad pa'ang bsam gyis mi khyab pa ste/ tshems kyi rnam par thar pa las/ rtogs ldan rang byung rdo rje ngag rlung sems gnyis la cung zad dbang thob pa'i snga ltas su/ mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lor rang byung ā li kā li mnyam par sbyor zhing*/ ngag longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skus/ rang byung rang rig pa'i ye shes su byin gyis brlabs pa'i snga ltas su/ rab 'byams bka' la lung chen thob cing ngag gis brjod bya 'byung ba'i gnas/ so dang dbugs dang lce la sogs pa rnams kyang longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i nyams dang rtogs pa mdzad pa phrin las phyogs re mi 'char mi 'byung na/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i thun mong khyad par du ma rtogs shing*/

ngag ma rig 'khrul 'khor tha mal ba'i ngag longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku lo rgyus brjod pa mngon sum tshad ma'o// las rab 'byams grub pa'i karma pa ni/ dang po bu tsha chung chung gi dus su so skyes pa rnams brjes shing*/ phyogs med du mos gus kyi rten la zhu zer ba rnams la bskur te/ de rjes su so skyes pa rnams la rim pa mang por phyi nang du skyes shing*/ so chung chung yang 'ga' re skyes shing ring bsrel dang bcas pa brjes pa rnams so'i bye brag mang du byon pa ni/ dper na 'bru'i sbun snying po lta bur brjes shing skyes pa la/ tshems ring bsrel dang bcas pa khyad par du 'phags pa gnyis lha chen 'dzam gling rgyan gyi nang na bzhugs shing*/ yang tshems ring bsrel dang bcas pa drug /rigs lnga dang thugs rje chen po'i nang na bzhugs pa la/ rtags dang yon tan byin rlabs mang po 'byung zhing 'dug /de'i rjes su tshems ring bsrel dang bcas pa gnyis sems dpa' ldem sku gnyis kyi nang na bzhugs shing*/ phyi ma'i mu mthar thug gi bar du sku bzhi'i phrin las rgyun chad med par rab du gnas pa'o// de'i rjes su yang so'i 'du brje ba la sogs pa mang po byung ba la/ rje ras chung ba'i gdan sa lo re bye'u mgo na sku lder bzhengs pa'i nang na/ bla ma dbon po'i tshems ring bsrel dang bcas pa mang po byon zhing 'byon bdo pa bzhugs pa ste/ la stod myu gu lung*/ gnam ldengs pa la tshems ring bsrel dang bcas pa gcig byin yod pa dang*/ gtsang dbu ri na ring bsrel dpag med byon nas tshems cung zad pa las kha sar pa ṇi'i sku ring bsrel las grub pa gcig byon nas/ dbu ri na nam yang yod du chug bzlas pa yin/ ba ri khams gsum grags la/ tshems ring bsrel dang bcas pa gcig byin nas byang phyogs su byin rlabs rgya chen pos khyab tu chug gsungs so/ /mdog shākya byang chub la tshems ring bsrel dang bcas pa gcig byin nas longs sku'i phrin las nub tu ma bcug

/gnas nang na bla ma dar ma grags la tshems ring bsrel dang bcas pa gcig byin nas bka' brgyud kyi gdan sa 'dzin du chug gsungs shing*/ dge bshes shākya grags la tshems ring bsrel dang bcas pa gcig byin nas bka' brgyud kyi dgongs pa nub tu ma bcug gsungs so/ /tre na pho yong ras pa bsod nams 'bum la tshems ring bsrel dang bcas pa gcig bskur nas 'gro don gyis gsungs pa dang*/ rong yul 'dzing ka na dge bshes bya bral ba la tshems ring bsrel dang bcas pa byin nas phrin las chud ma gsan gsungs pa dang*/ klong thang ba shākya seng ge la tshems ring bsrel dang bcas pa gcig byin nas bstan pa'i zhabs tog gyis gsungs so// rgya mi nyag gi yul du bla ma thugs rje dang*/ bkra shis rin chen/ rgya sgom hun tshul ba gsum la tshems ring bsrel mang du byon pa 'gran zla med pa gsum byin cing bskur ba yis/ rgya mi nyag la sogs skad rigs mi gcig pa thams cad phyi ma'i mu mthar thug gi bar du thams cad smin cing grol ba dang*/ phrin las sna tshogs 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes byin gyis brlabs shing gdams pa ste/ bod yul gyi 'di tsho rang bas rgya mi nyag gi tshems 'di rnams phrin las mtha' yas par 'byung bar 'gyur ba kun gyis shes par mdzod/ ming yongs su grags pa karma pa'i ngag rtogs pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i so'i snga ltas dang po tsam gyi rtags gzhan snang du 'byung zhing 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ dper na rnga bo che la rdung mi dgos pa bzhin du/ tshems 'di rnams la dad pa dang mos gus nya ra zhabs tog yag po byed mi yod na/ ma 'ongs pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ba'i phyir na/ 'di rnams bri ba'i don de sems can gyi so bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir na/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su gang dang gang gis kyang ngo mi shes shing bar ma dor chud za dog pa'o/ /ring bsrel rnams tshems la phyed 'phur tsam du 'byar zhing*/

gsol ba theb na tshems las ring bsrel mang po 'ang 'byon shes pa'o// bla ma bya phug pas tshems las byon pa'i ring bsrel bskur gsung ba las/ tshems dang tha dad med pa'i ring bsrel bzhi sde gnyis bskur zhing*/ de man yang phyogs thams cad na 'dod zer ba rnams la ring bsrel re re zung zung bskur ba la phrin las rgya chen po 'byung bar 'gyur/ karma sangs rgyas kyi gdan sa na tshems ring bsrel dang bcas pa dngos su ring bsrel bzhi sde bskur ba chos khri la mchod rten gyis gsungs pa'o/ /lha sa 'phrul snang gi chos khri'i mchod rten sku 'di yi nang na/ tshems ring bsrel dang bcas pa gcig bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes rgyas par gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam par thar pa rnams kyi don bsdu ba'ang*/ grub chen nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rnam thar gsang mdzod chen mo las/ sngags 'chang rang byung rdo rje ni/ /tshe rabs snga ma phan chad kyi/ /skye gnas grangs mtha' yas pa yi/ /slob dpon slob ma'i 'brel ba dang*/ /dam chos rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /lung dang brgyud pa du ma yis/ /gdul bya 'dul byed bsam mi khyab/ /gnas dgon gtsug lag khang la sogs/ /ya mtshan sku gsung thugs kyi rten/ /sna tshogs rten gyis 'gro ba'i don/ / dpag tu med pa 'byung ba dang*/ /tshe rabs gong ma'i dge tshogs rnams/ /brjod mi langs pas 'gro don mdzad/ /'dzam gling 'jig rten 'di nyid du/ /da res skyes par gyur pa yang*// don med 'khrul pas skyes pa min/ /tshe rabs mang po'i sbyangs stobs dang*/ /rtogs pa dang ni smon lam stobs/ /ye shes rgya mtsho'i mthu stobs kyis/ /theg chen rigs su sku 'khrungs shing*/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi che ba 'don/ /'gro drug sems can smin grol mdzad/ / dgongs pa lung bstan gnyis kyis skyes/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa'i gnas/ /dge ba can gyi yul du skyes/ /sprul sku'i bstan pa dang po ste/

/mkhan slob mtshan dang ldan pa la/ / grub mtha'i blos bsgyur bstan la zhugs/ /bsam gtan bzhi ldan tshul khrims rdzogs/ / btsun po tshad dang ldan par grags/ /sprul sku'i bstan pa theg chen mchog /byang chub sems kyi dbang sdud kyis/ /'gro don phyogs med sems dpa' mchog /phan brtse khyad par 'phags par grags/ /dgongs pa lung bstan gsang ba'i mdzod/ /nā ro brgyud pas byin brlabs pa'i/ /sku gsum ngo sprod gsang mdzod la/ /dbugs chen phyin cing rtsal chen rdzogs/ /grub rtags sna tshogs char bzhin 'bebs/ /grub thob khyad par 'phags par grags/ /sprul sku thogs med rtsal rdzogs pas/ /rlung sems gnyis kyi 'dus tshul gyis/ / gzugs can gzugs med 'gro ba rnams/ /phyogs ris med par g.yo 'gul mdzad/ / dbang sdud chen por yongs su grags/ /yul ris rgyal khams thams cad kyi/ /rdzas dang longs spyod ma lus pa/ /rtsol sgrub med par dbang du bsdus/ /'phags pa mchod cing sems can sbyin/ /longs spyod chen por yongs su grags/ /sku gsum ngo sprod dkyil 'khor du/ /rlung sems drag tu 'dus pa yis/ /rdo rje srin po la sogs pa/ /khro bo rmad du byung ba yi/ /lha tshogs thams cad rang la brtag /gtum drag khro bo'i mdzad spyod kyis/ /ye shes ma mgon lcam dral dang*/ /dregs pa pho dgu mo dgu sogs/ /'dzam gling gnas pa'i lha srin rnams/ /rnam 'gyur lta stangs ting 'dzin gyis/ /dbang du bsdus shing pho nya bkye/ /bstan pa bsrung zhing 'gro don mdzad/ /mthu stobs rmad du byung ba grags/ /grangs med bskal pa'i sngon rol na/ /yid dam lha ru mnga' gsol ba/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho spyan ras gzigs/ /shar phyogs spung ri'i dgon pa ru/ /snang srid rgyal ba rgya mtshor shar/ /'dzam gling khyab par byin gyis brlabs/ /'dzam gling rgyal ba rgya mtshos khyab/ /spyan ras gzigs dang mnyam par grags/ /sngags 'chang rang byung rdo rje yang*/

/da res skye ba 'di nyid la/ /rnam 'phrul cha lugs bsam mi khyab/ /phyi nang gnyis kyi grub mtha' dang*/ /shes dang shes bya'i tshogs rnams la/ /mthong dang thos pa tsam gyis kyang*/ /bde gshegs bka' la lung chen thob/ / phyoḍa bcu'i zhing khams mtha' yas na/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis chos gsungs pa/ /rlung sems gnyis kyi 'dus tshul gyis/ /mthong dang thos snyam byed pa byung*/ /rmongs pa med pa'i mkhas par grags/ /res 'ga' dben par sgrub pa byed/ /nyan thos drang srong tshogs dang 'dra/ / res 'ga' g.yengs pas rgyal khams bskor/ /sprin dang bar snang glog dang 'dra/ /res 'ga' 'gro drug smin grol mdzad/ /rgyal ba rnams dang mdzad spyod bstun/ /'dzam gling bdag po kun gyi rje/ /lcags kyi 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyi/ /dbang sgyur dbang bskur mchog tu gyur/ /mi yi bdag po'i bdag po 'dra/ /'dzam gling dmag dpon chen po yis/ /dbang bskur mnga' bdag gsol bas na/ /dmag dpon gyi yang dmag dpon 'dra/ /skad rigs mi gcig yul rnams su/ /sku gsung thugs kyi gtsug lag khang*/ /'gran med khyad par 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /gzhi dang mchod pa bsam mi khyab/ /chos rgyal mya ngan med pa yi/ / mdzad spyod phyag rjes nyid dang mtshungs/ /las rgyun gcod pa'i mdzad pa dang*/ /cho 'phrul mngon 'byung theg pa 'dra/ /da lta skye ba 'di nyid la/ /gnas dgon 'dug mal grangs mang zhing*/ /chos khri phyag rtags zhabs rjes sogs/ /yul khams khyab cing grangs mang ba/ /sku gsum ngo sprod phrin las kyis/ /smin grol 'gro don bsam mi khyab/ /theg dgu chos kyi 'khor lo yi/ /zab mo'i gdams ngag bsam mi khyab/ /phyi ma'i mu mthar thug gi bar/ / smin grol 'gro don rgyun mi 'tshad/ /gdul bya rab 'bring tha ma sogs/ /'brel pa thogs tshad thar lam 'dren/ /smin grol bu slob mtha' yas pas/ /'gro don rgyun chad med par mdzad/ /sprul sku 'jig rten byon pa bzhin/

/'gro ba'i 'dren pa grangs mtha' yas/ /gang na 'dug pa'i yul rnams kyang*/ /mchod rten lta bur byin brlabs shing*/ /dpa' bo'i tshogs dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /dam can dang ni lha klu'i tshogs/ /bka' nyan dam la btags pa'i phyir/ /gnas mchog byin gyis rlob pa dang*/ /bka' srung bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir/ /byin rlabs can gyi gnas mchog tu/ /smin grol 'gro don rgyun mi 'chad/ / sems dpa' rang byung rdo rje yi/ /lugs ma ras bris gzugs brnyan sogs/ /gang dang gang gis mthong ba dang*/ /mos shing mchod par gyur pa yang*/ /rim gyis smin grol 'gro don 'byung*/ /rgas dang rgud dang na la sogs/ /sems can mos pa sna tshogs la/ /ltas ni du ma ston par byed/ /des kyang 'gro drug lam sna 'dren/ /rnal 'byor rang byung rdo rje yang*/ / ye shes rgya mtsho kye rdor gyi/ /gsang ba sku brgyad don rtogs pas/ /skye ba med kyang skye tshul ston/ /gnas pa med kyang gnas tshul ston/ /'gro 'ongs med kyang 'gro dang 'ongs/ /'chi ba med kyang 'chi tshul ston/ /da ltar skye ba 'di nyid kyi/ /cho 'phrul rnam 'phrul mdzad spyod de/ /gzugs can mi yi mthong snang tsam/ /gzugs med 'gro ba'i tshoḍa rnams la/ /smin grol ci mdzad su yis shes/ /sngags 'chang rang byung rdo rje yi/ /da ltar skye ba 'di nyid kyi/ / cha lugs rnam 'gyur cung zad bris/ /lus sems gnyis kyi sgyu lus 'jig /de dang de yi dus nyid du/ /gnam sa gnyis la dag snang ston/ /gdul bya rab 'bring tha ma la/ /go dang rtogs tshul sna tshogs 'char/ /rab rnams de nyid chos skur ston/ /'bring rnams longs sku bde chen 'char/ /tha ma sprul sku mngon zhen ldog /sngags 'chang rang byung rdo rje yi/ /'di phyi gnyis kyi sa mtshams su/ /smin grol phrin las bsam mi khyab/ /ind+ra bhū ti la sogs pa/ / ye shes gsang ba sku brgyad kyi/ /dag snang lha tshogs phyogs med 'char/

/gsang ba sku brgyad rnal 'byor tshogs/ /skyo dub med par sgom sgrub mdzod/ /dbugs phyin rtsal chen rdzogs lags na/ /gzugs sku gdul bya'i grangs dang mnyam/ /'gro don mi 'byung dogs ma mchis/ /yid dang mthun par sgom sgrub mdzod/ /rang ma smin pa'i 'gro don de/ /long bas long ba khrid pa 'dra/ /sku gsum ngo sprod stsal rdzogs na/ /sku lnga'i sangs rgyas rang nyid yin/ /nyi ma 'char ba'i dpe bzhin du/ /'di don gang gis rtogs shing goms/ /'gro drug ma rig mun pa sel/ /sel byed med pa e ma ho/ /sngags 'chang rang byung rdo rje ni/ /

tshe rabs mang po'i sngon rol nas/ /theg dgu chos kyi 'khor lo yi/ /dgongs pa mchog du gyur ba ni/ /gsang mchog rdo rje theg pa ste/ /de rnams kun gyis bcud bsdus pa/ /thabs dang shes rab dbyer med pa/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho kyai rdor te/ /sku gsum ngo sprod gnad dang ldan/ /de yi sgra don mchog gyur pa/ /sku gsum sku bzhi sku lnga yi/ /ngo sprod grangs mtha' yas pa yis/ /gzhi rtogs lam rtogs 'bras bu rtogs/ /lhan skyes yab yum dkyil 'khor du/ / 'gro drug bar dor bcas pa rnams/ /skad cig nyid la smin grol mdzad/ /rnal 'byor rang byung rdo rje ni/ /'di nas mi snang gyur ba'i tshe/ /chos sku dri med mnyam rjes med/ /gnas lugs rang sa zin pas na/ /ye shes rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa/ /dus gsum dus med rgyun bar gnas/ /longs sku bde chen rtsal rdzogs pas/ /'gro drug sems can ma lus kyi/ /bya byed tshogs dang snang ba'i tshogs/ /gsang ba sku brgyad dkyil 'khor du/ /rang bzhin lhun gyis grub par 'char/ /sprul sku thogs med dbang thob pas/ /'gro drug bar dor bcas pa la/ /sprul sku thogs med char bzhin 'bebs/ /de rnams ma lus thams cad kyi/ /gshis dbyings dang ni rang bzhin dang*/ /ngo bo mtshan nyid la sogs pa/ /sku bzhi 'du 'bral med par rdzogs/ /rdzu 'phrul cho 'phrul sna tshogs kyis/ /'brel pa thogs dang ma thogs bcas// smin grol phrin las chen po ni/ /gsang dbang mtshan nyid ldan pa dang*/ /shes rab ye shes phyogs med sbyor/ /dbang gsum mtshan nyid ldan par bskur/ /dug lnga rdo rje rigs lnga ste/ / lnga 'dus dbang bzhi bskur thob med/ /sngags 'chang rang byung rdo rje ni/ /dus gsum dus med phyogs med 'byung*/ /ma mo srid pa'i rgyud lung las/ /nga ni dus gsum sngar yang byung*/ / nga ni dus gsum phyis kyang 'byung*/ /nga ni dus gsum da lta bzhugs/ /gsungs pa ltar/

ye shes gsang ba sku brgyad kyi/ /mdzad pa phrin las lung bstan pa/ /nga yis goms 'dris rtsal rdzogs phyir/ /deng nas bzung ste phyi ma'i mthar/ /smin grol sna tshogs 'byung ba 'dra/ / lung bstan skyes bu gsum po dang*/ /dkyil 'khor mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyi/ /rgyud lung man ngag bsgrub pa yi/ /gdul byar gyur pa thams cad la/ /bar do rmi lam dngos su yang*/ /dbang bskur byin rlabs lung bstan cing*/ /lus ngag yid gsum snang ba bzhi/ /sku gsum sku bzhi ngo sprod 'gyur/ /brgyud pa mchog gyur 'di nyid la/ /sngags 'chang rnal 'byor dpag med 'byung*/ /rgyud lung man ngag thams cad kyis/ /phyogs med khyab par the tshom med/ /sku gsum ngo sprod gnad mchog 'di/ /mthong thos dran pa'i skal ldan rnams/ / yun mi ring bar smin grol zhing*/ /sprang po sa 'og shi gyur kyang*/ /rtags ni nam mkha' nyid la 'byung*/ /lus kyi lhag ma sku gdung 'gyur/ /skye bo ngo mtshar skye bar 'gyur/ /dus gsum dus med thams cad kyi/ /skal ldan rnams kyis mkhyen mdzod cig /ces gsungs pa ltar ro// rje nyid kyis phyi nang gi grub mtha' dang theg pa sna tshogs pa rnams kyang*/ rdo rje theg pa'i nges gsang snying po'i don kho na la gzhol zhing 'bab par 'gyur ba'i bstan bcos kyi rim pa'ang bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gnyis 'gyur tsam bstan cing*/ de dag gi gleng gzhi dang 'brel ba'i rnam thar mang po 'thor nas yod par gsung ste/ rnam thar dus gsum dus med gcig tu rtogs shing rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i gleng gzhi las/ da ltar gyi dus su ming yongs su grags pa karma pas rab 'byams bka' la lung chen thob nas/ bstan pa rgya mtsho mtha' yas/ ye shes mtha' yas man chod tshigs bzhi tshigs su bcad pa yan chad la 'gyur ro 'tshal gnyis tsam 'dzam gling khyab par bstan cing bsdus pa yin pa'i nang na/ gleng gzhi rnam thar mang po 'thor nas yod pa ste/

kor tse kor tse yang rnal 'byor rang byung rdo rje'i rnam thar gleng gzhi rgyas bsdus mang pos yul khams khyab nas yod pa la tshad gzhal bzung du med pa yin/ da ltar gyi rje dus gsum mkhyen pa dang*/ kun mkhyen rang byung rdo rje tha dad med pa'i gdul bya lcags kyi 'khor los sgyur ba gsum gyi gleng gzhi gleng slong rnam thar 'di rnams 'dzam bu gling pa 'di rnams kun gyis shes shing thos pa dang*/ skad rigs mi gcig pa sum brgya dang drug cu la mngon du gyur cing lkog tu ma gyur pa dpang po dam pa yod pa ste/ sprin med nam mkha' la khri gdugs shar ba lta bu'o/ /zhes gsungs/ chu rta lo nas brtsams te mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed pa'i gsung mang du byon/ de'i tshe grub thob chen po o rgyan pa dgung lo nga gsum pa zhig dbus gtsang gi 'gro don chen mo la byon/ gtsang phyogs su than mo che byung ba gar phebs su char pa babs pas zhi bar mdzad/ drag po'i sbyin sreg gis 'gegs thams cad 'dul zhing byon/ rong chen dang sil ma la nas 'byon par dgongs/ stag gru khar phebs tshe da res rin po che karma pa mjal dgos par 'dug gsung nas gtsang po byang la byon/ grub thob chen pos kyang*/ kye mtshur phu ba kha 'khyag nam langs/ grub thob o rgyan pa gnam sa gnyis kyi ka ba lta bu de 'byon zhing 'dug gsung nas grab yul cher byas/ auḍyan pa'i gsung nas karma pa'i grā pa rnams brel bdo 'dug gcags mal gyis gsung nas lam zhig tu gcags mal mdzad/ yang byon te dbu ri brgal bar bzhugs nas mngon mkhyen e 'dug lta'o gsung nas mtshan 'gros kyis bteg grub thob chen pos mkhyen nas tho rangs bsu ba rnams btang ba byams pa chos khrir mjal bas auḍyan pa'i thugs rgyal dang po chag /phyir gzim sbra chen mo la bzhugs nas rin po che'i gz-im khang na rten mchod bkod pa 'di ltar 'dug gsungs pas mtshur phu ba rnams mos/

nang du phebs te gus pas grub thob chen po'i zhabs la phyag mdzad/ stan bzang po bshams pa la bzhugs/ grub thob chen pos khyed dpon slob rnams ngas dkrugs pa 'dra ba zhig bya'am gsungs pas mdzad par zhu gsungs/ de ma thag tu rlung dang lta stangs mdzad pas grub chen ba dpon slob thams cad nyams 'ur te bkrabs pas da sdod gsungs te thugs rgyal gnyis pa chag /de nub dpon slob kun gyis tshogs mchod mdzad pa'i sha zan rnams khyis khyer ba ma tshor/ nang par drung du tsha ba la byon pa'i tshe rin po che'i gsung gis khyed rnams kyi tshogs rdzas khyis bros pa e tshor gsungs/ da lta bod na khyed pas grub thob che ba med ang gsungs/ de tsam gyi rlom pa mi bdog zhus pas/ 'o na khyed kyis a su ra'i brag phug tu blangs pa'i mgur de long dang gsungs/ der thugs rgyal rtsa ba nas chag /e auḍyan pa khyed sil ma la nas 'gro chis 'dug ste nga'i byang chub kyi sems kyis rang dbang med par bkug pa yin i shes gsungs/ ka to ra nas kyis bkang ba rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sba lcag gis dkrugs nas spyi bor bzhag ste dbang bskur/ zhag gsum du gdams ngag mtha' yas pa gnang*/ khyed kyi brgyud pa la zhwa nag can du mchi zhus pas/ spyir gang byas nyan/ gya pa gangs pas gu ba byas/ de'i skye mched la brten nas zhwa nag po gyon pa'i brgyud pa chad/ 'on kyang da dung nyi ma nub phyogs nas zhwa nag po gyon pa zhig yong ba yin gsungs/ 'di ni rje rang byung ba lung bstan pa dang*/ spyir gya pa gangs pa'i mdzad pa la rje dus mkhyen ma mnyes pas bar der sprul sku cung zad 'gyangs pa la dgongs pa yin no// de nas gnang sbyin bzang po mdzad/ bsre 'pho'i zhal gdams dang sku gsum ngo sprod sogs kyi phyag dpe khyad par ba dang*/ /dbu zhwa zhwa nag cig gtad de 'di rnams khyed kyis mgo 'don byed dgos pa zhig yong bas de la gtod/ khyed 'di nas lho phyogs su song dang 'gro don rgya chen po 'grub/

nga rang myur du phrad do gsungs/ sku tshe 'di la zhag gsum kho na las ma mjal yang pha dang bu 'phrad pa lta bur gyur/ grub thob auḍyan pas kyang de phyin rje rgod tshang ba dang tha mi dad pa'i rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin/ spyir thugs rgyud tha mi dad pa'i sku'i bkod pa'ang yin par snang la brgyud pa gtad cing phyis lam bar kun du'ang gdams ngag gi shog dril yang yang du/ grub thob chen po thegs 'phral zhig tu mang yul gyi gangs zhur mo'i mdun phyogs kyi mi mang po jo bo bskor ba la 'ongs te/ lam gzhu'i phu nas grub thob chen po mjal du 'ongs pa rnams la chos dang byin rlabs gnang*/ de'i nang nas do ha dang rnying ma dang zhi byed rgyud phyi la mkhas pa'i ston pa chos dpal bya ba snyoms chung zhig yod pa la khyod cung zad sdod gsungs/ zas gos dang gnang sbyin bzang po mdzad nas da khyod la gnas tshang zhig g.yar dgos par 'dug pas de thong zhig gsungs/ khong gis kyang ma go bar gzhan la smras pas khyod rang gar sdod med pa la gnas tshang gar 'ong zer nas bzhad gad du song skad/ rnam thar zhal chems ma las/ ming yongs su grags pa karma pa'ang skye ba 'di nyid la ar ta hor gyi rgyal sa na 'dug pa'i dus su/ rlung sems bum pa can la 'bring tsam du dbang thob kyang sna tshogs rkyen gyi dbang gis lus sems 'bral ba'i snga ltas mang du 'dug nas/ mtshur phu 'dir gser yig pa mgyogs pa btang zhing*/ dpal ldan 'bras spung gi mchod rten zhig myur du bzhengs byas pas 'di na 'dug pa rnams kyis bzhengs zin/ bla ma yi dam ḍā ki phyi nang gsang gsum gyi tshogs kyis bskul nas/ rgyal po rgyal brgyud kyi mdzod rnams kyang dkon mchog mchod/ sems can la sbyin pa rgya chen po btang nas/ 'chi rkyen tshogs gnyis su rdzogs pa min na/ karma pa'i rus bu mchod rten 'di'i nang du bzhag snyam pas/ na ning phyis rten mang po bzhugs shing rab gnas byas pa ste/

da rung yang karma pa'i rus bu cha gcig 'di na bzhag pa yin pa'i phyir na/ sa rdo shing gsum las byas pa'i mchod rten gzhan mi dgos thams cad kyis shes par mdzod/ de'i rjes su rlung sems bum pa can la dbang thob kyang gzhan snang rkyen gyis bskul nas/ 'dzam gling bdag pos gsung gi 'khor lo drag por bskor ba de lus sems 'bral ba'i snga ltas mtha' yas pa byung ba las/ 'jigs pa med pa'i dbyings su bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dpal ldan lha mo rang byung ye shes kyi dbyings su gsol ba btab pa ni 'di 'dra ste/ ma gcig lha mo dpal lha mo// sangs rgyas bstan pa bdag gis bsrung*// 'gro drug lam sna bdag gis drangs// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol// zhes thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul ba tsam gyis phrin las rnam bzhi'i ltas dngos su yul khams mang por byung nas/ 'chi rkyen las rab 'byams su grub pa'i ltas dngos grub sna tshogs su shar nas/ lha chen po 'dzam gling rgyan gyi dbu mdzad sku gsung thugs kyi rten mtha' yas pa dbus gtsang khams gsum khyab par bzhengs shing*/ sgyu ma lta bus rnam par 'phrul nas 'chi rkyen sna tshogs 'gro don lhun gyis grub pa'i rgyu rkyen 'khor lo bskor ba'o// de'i rjes su dbus gtsang*/ rje dus mkhyen pa'i gdan sa mtshur phur phyin nas ring zhig lon pa'i dus na/ phyi nang gsang gsum de kho na nyid kyi las dang nyon mongs bag chags kyi sgrib pa cha phra'u la sogs pa rnams re dog ma rig pa'i rgyu cha phra'u dang rkyen bzang ngan sna tshogs bdud bzhi'i rgyan du ldang nas/ rje btsun mi la la bdud dang 'dre'i dmag gi tshogs kyi nyams snang sna tshogs 'char ba bzhin du/ rtogs ldan rang byung rdo rje yang rlung sems gnyis la dbang thob 'pho 'gyur med kyang*/ phyi nang bar gsum rkyen snang sna tshogs lus sems bral ba'i snga ltas 'gro drug bdud sogs 'jigs tshul sna tshogs kyi snang ba/

nad dang bgegs sogs yid du mi 'ong ba sna tshogs ban bun tsam du byung ba dang*/ mtho ris sna tshogs zhen 'dzin thob par re zhing*/ bral gyi dogs pa mtha' yas pa rnams yun ring du ci rigs par 'chi rkyen sna tshogs cir yang snang zhing*/ thams cad rang snang gzhan snang gnyis kar byung ba las/ rgyu rkyen sna tshogs lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su rtogs nas chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid gnyis can thams cad gnyis med du lhan cig skyes par rtsal rdzogs shing*/ zhag bzhi bcu'i bar du rang snang du sangs rgyas zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor zhing khams chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam par rang nyid la rdzogs shing*/ phyogs med du 'phro zhing 'khrul pa'i nyams myong dang*/ ma rig 'khrul 'khor sems can gyi tshogs rnams kyang phyi nang snod bcud khams gsum khyab par nyams snang nyams myong ma rig 'khrul 'khor du nyams rtogs gnyis su med par bstan na yang*/ rmi lam la sogs skabs skabs su cir yang 'char zhing cir yang nyams su myong ba sna tshogs su snang ba rang snang du byung ba ste/ de yang lus sems 'bral ba'i snga ltas su 'dug kyang*/ sku gsum lhun gyis grub/ sku bzhi 'du 'bral med pa'i rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i snga ltas tsam du thag chod nas/ sngar gyi sku bzhi ngo sprod kyi gdams ngag la yang sku gsum yid byed kyi 'phro 'du sna tshogs par yod par 'dug pa ste/ bag chags yid byed kyi sku bzhir 'dzin pa'i sgrib pa yod pa i yod ma tshor bar snang ba de/ de phyin chad du sku bzhi ma rig pa rang gis rang rig pa/ chos sku dri ma med pa sku bzhi 'dzin pa yid byed sku gcig tu ngo sprod rtogs nas/ bye brag gang yang gdod ma nas ma grub par ngo sprod rang byung ye shes su byin gyis rlob pa'i gnad/ gdul bya snod du rung ba dang mi rung ba thams cad la ngo sprod pa'o// de'i tshe de'i dus na gzhan snang du yang zhag bzhi bcu tsam la sku bzhi ngo sprod kyi rtags sna tshogs nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang la byung zhing 'char nas thams cad kyis karma pa

na zhing 'chi bar 'dug kun gyis zer bar gda' ba'i dus su rang re'i bu slob rnams kyis kyang*/ nor yod tshad rim gro byed pa yin zer zhing*/ mang skol la sogs pa rgyun chad med par byas zin/ rje btsun mi la'i gsungs las kyang*/ glo bur tshe la 'jigs 'jigs nas// ngas rlung sems gnyis la rten 'brel bsgrigs// gsungs pa bzhin/ ming yongs su grags pa karma pa'ang*/ rlung sems bum pa can la rang dbang thob pa min na sha khrag gi phung po 'di la gnas kyi bar du ji ltar du byas kyang 'chi ba'i rkyen du ma gyur pa gcig kyang med pa'i phyir na/ sna khung gi dbugs nyid 'gro ldog ma nus pa'i tshe na 'chi zhes bya ba skad cig la 'byung zhing 'dug pa'i phyir na/ sgom chen pa la sogs pa thams cad kyis shes par mdzod/ rta'i lo 'di la dper na khang rgan zhig tshang pa thams cad g.yo zhing 'khrug pa'i dpe bzhin du/ ming yongs su grags pa karma pa yang rlung sems bum pa can la cung zad dbang thob kyang*/ 'byung bzhi'i lus 'di zhig tshad pa'i snga ltas phyi nang bar gsum la rkyen ngan pa sna tshogs 'byung zhing 'dug pa ste/ dper na nyi ma rgas kha'i grib so bzhin du/ bla ma chen po phya phug pas mgo byas yul khams thams cad na 'gro don byed nus pa'i bla ma dge bshes brgya tsam 'di na tshor bar ma tshor bar 'das zin/ de rnams kyang karma pa'i phrin las 'grib tshad pa'i snga ltas yin pa ste/ rta lo zla ba brgyad pa'i yar tshes brgyad kyi dus su rgyu rkyen sna tshogs kyis byas nas blo bur du bzhugs pa'i khang sgo'i them len las drag tu 'gyel zhing ras rus yan lag brdabs nas/ dbugs rgyu ba chad dus su goms pa'i stobs kyis rlung bum pa can khug pa gcig zin/ lus sems kyi skyon rnams rang mal du tshud nas/ shin tu bde bar byung ba'i dus su rtsa na khong gsum 'dug pa la su la yang ma zlo gsang bya ba las lus g.yo 'gul mi shes pa zhag mang rab tu byung zhing*/

zhag sum cu tsam la khyog la 'khyer dgos pa byung zhing*/ nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang las sku bzhi'i rtags dang*/ dbyar gzhung chen bzhin du nam sla phyogs med du dros pa la sogs pa'i rtags mang po 'dug pa de rkyen ngan dngos grub tu 'char zhing*/ srog rtsol rlung la dbang thob pa'i snga ltas dang*/ rtags su 'dug pa'i phyir na de snga rkyen dang 'chi ltas drug tsam byung ba las/ da res kyi 'di shin tu 'jigs shing bar chad shin tu che bar 'dug /ming yongs su grags pa karma pa min na skye ba 'di nyid la skye 'chi drug tsam gyi snang ba gsum la sogs pa 'char bar 'dug ste/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub rlung sems gnyis la dbang cung zad thob pa'i snga ltas kyis 'byung bzhi'i lus sems g.yo ba brtan par gyur pa'o//

bshad sgom dam chos mang na'ang rlung sems gnyis la rtsal chen po ma rdzogs kyi bar du/ skye 'chi gnyis la rang dbang mi thob pa ste/ ma 'ongs pa'i gdul bya thams cad kyis go zhing shes nas sems nyid gshis 'gyur ba med pa las sku bzhi 'du 'bral med par rtogs shing rtsal rdzogs nas srog rtsol rlung la rang dbang gzhan dbang thob par mdzod/ rin po che spom brag pa'i zhal chems las/ khyed kyi shi sa karmar gyis gsungs pa de khams pa kun gyis 'ga' re la thos su bcug cing*/ karma 'bum thang gi stod na chos khri brtsigs shing*/ thang bzhi tsam du theg chen chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing 'di na yang mchod rten cig gyis dang*/ karma pa'i rus bu 'jug dgos pa yin bzlas pa de 'ga' zhig gis 'di yang bzla shes/ brgyud pa gong ma rnams kyi gnya' na byas zin zer yang shes te/ gong ma 'og ma sus shes/ shes mi yod na dpang po gyis bzlas pa ste/ karma pa'i chos khri'i steng na mchod rten byed dgos yod pa yin/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus na karma pa'i phrin las dar drag la yun ring ba yul khams thams cad khyab par 'byung yang shes pa'i phyir na/ bla ma'i bka' bsgrub pa ma gtogs pa/ ming yongs grags pa karma pa karma gcig pur shi bas ma 'ongs pa'i phrin las rab 'byams phyogs med du rdzogs par ga la 'gyur/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas kyang*/ mya ngan las 'da' khar chos thams cad gtan la phab cing*/ bka' chems 'bum phrag gsungs shing bzhugs pa ste/ shākya thub pa'i ming yongs grags pa rang byung rdo rje yang*/ sangs rgyas kyi brgyud 'dzin gdul bya mchog tu gyur pa yin pa'i phyir na/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bzhin bsgrub rjes su slob pa ste/ gzhan dang mi 'dra bar dran bzhin du skye/ dran bzhin du gnas/ dran bzhin du 'pho zhing 'gyur ba bstan dgos pa'i phyir na/ da phyin chad kha chems dang ma 'ongs pa'i 'byung tshul mang po 'dzam gling khyab par bshad cing ston shes pa'i phyir na/

rtogs ldan rang byung rdo rje yis/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad sku bzhi ngo sprod du byin gyis brlabs shing bsdus nas/ thams cad sku bzhi 'du 'bral med pa ma gru togs pa spu tsam yang med pa/ ma rig pa rang g-is rang rig pa'i ye shes 'jig rten gyi khams khyab cing rgyun chad med par 'byung ba la/ dang po bla ma slob dpon gyis rtogs shing rtsal chen po rdzogs na/ ma 'ongs pa'i gdul bya thams cad yid ches pa mngon sum tshad ma yin pa kun gyis shes mod/ slob dpon la sku bzhi ngo sprod rtags dang 'bras bu med par slob ma rnams la kha 'phyar kha 'khyil ba'i lugs bzhin/ 'bras bu med pa'i phub ma rtags med pa'i bshad bsgom rgyun chad med par byas kyang sku gsum lhun gyis grub/ sku bzhi 'du 'bral med/ sku lnga'i sangs rgyas rang nyid la mngon sum tshad mar rdzogs par ga na 'gyur/ de'i phyir na chos sku dri med rang byung rdo rjes ni gnas lugs gshis lnga chos kyi dbyings rab 'byams mtha' yas chos sku ye shes lnga dang ldan par rtogs shing rtsal rdzogs pa'i phyir na/ ma 'ongs pa'i gdul bya thams cad kyang ma rig pa rang gis rang rig cing chos sku'i mdzad pa phrin las/ rgyun chad med par ma rtogs pa yid byed yid smon gang la 'ang re dogs med pa sems rtogs pa chos kyi skur sangs rgyas pa'o// sku bzhi ngo sprod kyi gnad kyis ngag rtogs pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur rtogs shing rtsal rdzogs pa'i phyir na/ srog rtsol rlung gi gnad kyis rab 'byams chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam par/ rigs lnga yab yum bcu gdod nas yin par rtogs shing*/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo ru rang byung ā li kā li mnyam par sbyor bas/ rab 'byams bka' la lung chen thob/ da ltar gyi so dang ba'i skye mched rnams smra brjod tshogs dang bcas pa kun/ ma 'ongs gdul bya'i snang ba las ring bsrel rang byung rten gyi tshogs dang*/

gsung mchog smin grol ngo sprod rgyun chad med pa dus gsum rgyun chad med pa shugs las 'byung ba ste/ zab mo sku bzhi ngo sprod kyis gnad kyis bdag gzhan lus kyi rnam 'gyur g.yo 'gul mtha' yas pa rnams dgag bsgrub med par lus rtogs pa sprul ba'i skur rtsol sgrub med par sku gsum lhun gyis grub par gdul bya grangs can grangs med la thogs pa med par 'char ba ste/ rnam par shes pa'i tshogs brgyad grangs can gyi chos thams cad gnyis su med par sku bzhi sku gcig 'du 'bral med par rtogs shing goms 'dris rtsal chen po rdzogs pa ni/ nyi ma dang nyi ma'i 'od kyi dpe bzhin du 'khrul pa'i tshogs thams cad ye shes dbyings gcig ma gtogs pa/ bye brag so so spu tsam yang med pa'i phyir na/ ye shes dbyings gcig 'khrul pa'i dri ma med gsung pa dang mthun zhing*/ so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba/ /smra bsam brjod med rang byung karma pas rtsal rdzogs shing*/ lkog tu ma gyur mngon du gyur pa'i phyir na/ sku bzhi ngo sprod kyi gnad kyis ma khyab pa med par ngo sprod/ rang byung ye shes kyi dbyings kyis byin gyi brlabs pa ni/ 'dus byas la 'dus ma byas kyi sangs rgyas mi re zhing*/ rgyu rkyen gang dang gang la'ang mi ltos par/ gang dang gang gi gnas lugs gshis 'gyur ba med pa la/ dbyings ngo bo rang bzhin mtshan nyid lnga gang dang gang gis ma rig na ni/ 'gro ba rigs drug bar do dang bcas par 'khrul nas ma rig 'khrul 'khor sems can du 'khor ba yin par ngo sprod pa'o// gang dang gang gis rig cing rtogs na ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sku lnga rang nyid la rdzogs par ngo sprod cing byin gyis rlob pa'i phyir na/ sangs rgyas sems can gnyis kyi bar na rig ma rig gnyis kyi sa mtshams nyi ma grib ma'i mtshams tsam cig las med pa yin pa las/ byas pa chos byas kyang chos kyi dri mas ma gos shing*/

chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid karma rang byung ye shes kyis rtogs shing rtsal rdzogs nas/ gdul bya lus ngag yid gsum yod tshad la de ltar ngo sprod cing byin gyis brlabs pa de/ thams cad kyis rang gis rang rig cing rtogs na gdod nas sangs rgyas pa yin pa la/ rang gis rang ma rig cing 'khrul pa las/ gdams ngag 'di'i gnad kyis skad cig gis bye brag phyed/ gnas 'di yis skad cig tsam gyis sangs rgyas sems can gyi mtshams phyed pa dang*/ skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /gsungs pa ni/ sku bzhi ngo sprod kyi gnad kyis 'dzin pa'i sems sangs/ gzung ba'i yul zhi khro rab 'byams kyi skur rgyas shing*/ rnam par rtog pa'i tshogs rnams rang byung ye shes rgya mtsho thams cad mkhyen pa'i dbyings dang ye shes ro mnyam par rtsal rdzogs pa'i rang byung sku bzhi ngo sprod kyi gnad 'di sngon ma byung*/ phyis mi 'byung*/ da lta rang byung ye shes kun khyab rdo rje'i dus 'dir byung ba mngon sum tshad ma ste/ gdul bya ma rig rgyu rkyen yid smon tshogs la re ba rnams kyis phyogs med mkhyen par mdzod/ dper na phas rgyal po thob na/ bu yis rgyal bu'i ming mi thob mi srid pa bzhin du/ ma 'ongs pa'i gdul bya snod du rung dang mi rung med pa yis/ 'di yi gnad kyis sku lnga'i sangs rgyas rang la mi rdzogs kha med pa'i phyir na/ thams cad la ngo sprod cing thos su chug /thos pa tsam gyis kyang yun ring po mi thogs par ma rig pa rang gis rang rig nas sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro// sangs rgyas seng ge sgra 'dzam bu'i gling du byon zhing 'phrul pa'i phrin las rgyun chad med cing byon pa don med du 'gro dogs nas/ bsam 'grub gyi bla chen ras chen gyis rin po che spom brag pa la dgongs pa lung bstan cing*/ rin po che spom brag pas/ kun rdzogs rang byung karma pa la byin gyis brlabs shing zhal chems gnyis bzhag pa yin/

karma sangs rgyas kyi gdan sa yon bdag chen po gar thos pa'i sar karma dgon pa ma thos pa'am/ mi shes pa med cing rdo rje gdan dang*/ karma sangs rgyas kyi gdan sa 'dra ba'i phyir na/ thams cad gnas dgon kun gyi rtsa ba kun la khyab pa karma yin pa'i phyir na/ ma 'ongs pa'i bu slob thams cad kyang karmar 'dus shing*/ zhabs tog bsgom bsgrub mchod pa gyis dang ring por mi thogs par sku bzhi 'du 'bral med par sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro// rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i mdzad pa phrin las 'di nas phyogs med du rgyas shing dgongs pa mtha' dag rdzogs par mdzad pa'i rtsa ba 'di yin pa/ ming yongs su grags pa karma pa'i gdul bya thams cad kyis mkhyen par mdzod/ sangs rgyas chos kyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab kyang*/ sku bzhi ngo sprod rlung sems gnyis la rang dbang ma thob cing rtsal ma rdzogs kyi bar du skye shi gnyis la rang dbang ma thob ste/ sems can thams cad gnyis las nam yang mi thar de ma lags pa sems can thams cad kyis mi shes pas/ nam yang 'chi dgos pa kun gyis shes par mdzod/ de'i phyir na mchog gi sangs rgyas kun bzang rdo rje 'chang*/ thun mong gi sprul pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa grub thob brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi rjes su skyes shing*/ bka' bsrung dgongs pa rdzogs par mdzad pa'i karma pa rang byung rdo rje yang 'chi dgos par 'dug pa'i phyir na/ sems can gzhan pa rnams bzhin tha mal skye bo ma rig mun khang na gnas pa'i dud 'gro la sogs pa rnams 'chi ba dang mi 'dra bar/ skye ba med kyang skye tshul ston/ gnas pa med kyang gnas tshul ston/ 'chi ba med kyang 'chi tshul ston pa'i phyir na/ dus gsum mdzad pa phrin las rgyun chad med pa'i kha chems sna tshogs dang*/ 'chi rtags sna tshogs ston pa dang phyin chad ma 'ongs pa'i bye brag sna tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa ston par 'gyur ba'i phyir na/ rnal 'byor rang byung rdo rje rang 'byung karma pa'i 'chi ba'i bye brag la nges pa med cing su yis shes/

dper na mar me 'da' kha gsal ba bzhin du mkhas par 'dod pa'i the tshom sel/ grub pa thob pa'i gdar sha gcod/ grub thob chen po u rgyan pa byon pa bzhin du/ skal ldan gdul bya mang po 'byung zhing bstan pa yun du gnas par 'gyur yang shes pa'i phyir na/ rkyain ngan sna tshogs kyis ma bskul na blo bur rkyen la 'jigs pa med pa'i phyir na/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par 'dod pa rnams kyi gdul bya rnams sku bzhi ngo sprod rgyal ba rgya mtsho rang byung yi ge lnga rlung sems gnyis la rang dbang thob par mdzod/ gzhan pa kha phyar kha 'khyil tshogs la yid ches blo gtad ma byed cig/ de'i phyir na karma pa'i kha chems bar chad 'chi bdag bdud las rgyal zhing*/ rkyen ngan dngos grub yon tan rgya mtshor 'char ba'i kha chems dang po lags pas/ ma rig gdul bya gang dang gang na yod pa thams cad kyis bris shing*/ kun la thos su chug bsgoms shing rtogs nas ma 'ongs gdul bya thams cad la/ sku gsum lhun gyis grub/ sku bzhi 'du 'bral med pa'i ngo sprod gdams ngag tu ston cing*/ ma rig pa rang gis rang rig pa'i ye shes su sangs rgyas par mdzod/ ces gsungs/ ma 'ongs pa'i tshul yang rnam thar mdzad spyod rol pa las/ nga'i gdan sa gar btsugs pa chos kyi khri dang dkyil 'khor la sogs pa gar byas pa rnams yun ring du gnas shing 'gro ba'i don du 'gyur ba yin gsungs/ nga'i bu slob kyi nang na yang sa thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dus gsum mkhyen pa'i bu rgan mang po yod/ dwags po lha rje'i bu rgan yang mang po yod gsungs/ bla ma rin po che sku skye ba 'di'i rjes la/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas rin chen la bkod pa bya ba na/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po padma rnam par rol pa bya ba cig tu sku 'khrungs nas tshe lo grangs med par byang chub kyi spyad pa spyod pa 'ong*/ sprul pa cha gcig dga' ldan du byon nas mgon po byams pa'i drung du byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyad pa 'byung*/

lha'i lo stong phrag tsam thub pa 'byung gsungs/ da lta nga'i dbang bskur thob pa dang 'brel gang che ba thams cad rgyal po de'i drung na rgyal phran byang chub sems dpa' mang pos/ rang cag gi yon bdag byed pa yin no gsungs so/ /de min kyang 'ga' re 'ong bar 'dug /byams pa'i bstan pa la skye ba nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam gyi bar du byams pa'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par bgyi ba yin gsungs so// da ste lo brgya lhag tsam na bram ze chen po'i sprul pa dus gsum mkhyen pa'i rnam 'phrul cha gcig 'byung nas bstan pa skyong yang srid/ dus tshod mar 'grib tu song ba'i phyir deng sang nga'i phrin las tsam mi 'byung*/ ran tsam 'byung gsungs/ 'di rnams thams cad kyi phug slob dpon padma la thug pa yin gsungs/ deng sang yang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na padma'i rnam 'phrul grangs med pa bzhugs/ dus gsum phrin las la rgyun chad med pa yin/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi lha 'dre thams cad kyang nga'i slob ma yin pa'i phyir/ bu slob rnams kyis brgyud pa zin na lha 'dre thams cad kyis phrin las bsgrub bo gsungs/ zhes 'byung*/ yang rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i gleng gzhi las/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su 'byung bar 'gyur ba/ dper na de ring nyi ma thal na yang*/ sang nyi ma 'char bar 'gyur ba bzhin te/ de'i phyir na/ sangs rgyas mya ngan yongs mi 'da'/ /dam pa'i chos kyang nub mi 'gyur/ /sku yi phrin las rgyun mi 'chad/ /gsungs pa lta bu ste/ sngags 'chang rang byung rdo rje yang*/ /skye ba 'di yi bya ba rdzogs nas kyang*/ /'jig rten 'di nas mi snang gyur pa'i tshe/ /'brel ba rab 'bring tha ma'i snang ba la/ /'gro drug bar dor bcas pa rnams/ /ma rig pa rang rig pa'i ye shes sku rang sar ngo sprod cing byin gyis brlabs pa ste/ lus dang mthun par skur sprul zhing*/ /skad dang mthun par chos gsungs nas/ /khams rgyud mthun par zas kyi 'tsho/

/sems rgyud mthun par ting 'dzin sna tshogs ston/ /spyod lam 'gro ba kun dang mthun par kun spyod kun khyab ste/ /chos sku 'pho 'gyur med pa la/ /gzugs sku gdul bya'i snang ba yin/ /rnam pa sna tshogs cir yang 'char/ /dper na chu zla me long gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /rgyu rkyen sna tshogs cir yang 'char/ /zhes dang*/ 'dul bya ji ltar snang ba bzhin du gdul byed kyi slob dpon de ltar 'byung ba ni/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams mtha' yas par gdul bya 'brel pa can sna tshogs gang dang gang du skye na yang*/ skye shi gnyis la rang dbang thob pa'i slob dpon yang gdul bya sna tshogs kyi don du mi 'byung mi srid pa'i phyir na/ phyi ma'i mu mthar thug gi bar du/ rdo rje 'chang dang tha dad med pa'o// rje dus gsum mkhyen pa chos dbyings kun tu khyab pa las/ rnam 'phrul 'od zer cha gcig gtum zhing gdug pa'i gdul bya'i don du/ sngon byung 'brel pa'i dbang gis 'byung zhing 'byung bar 'gyur ba ste/ da ltar yang sems dpa' rang byung rdo rje yin/ ma 'ongs pa'i bye brag 'di rnams la mang po shes shing dran par 'dug ste/ 'dir 'byung 'dir skye brjod par gyur na dpang po mngon sum tshad ma med pa'i phyir na/ gang yang bden zhing yid ches par mi 'gyur bas mdor bsdus shing ma spros pa'o/ /sngags 'chang rang byung rdo rje yis/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus 'dir 'gro don sems can rnams kyi smin grol sna tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung bar 'gyur te/ sku gsung thugs rten rnams sam/ zhal nas gsungs pa'i chos gdams ngag gi phung po rnams dang*/ bzhugs mal la sogs gnas kyi bye brag rnams dang*/ bsam bzhin du srid pa nye bar len pa la sogs pa bu slob gdul bya rab 'bring tha ma sna tshogs kyi chos kyi mos pa spyod pa'i sa la dbang sgyur ba dang*/ sku bzhi ngo sprod kyi gnad kyis shākya thub pa'i bstan pa ma rdzogs pa dang*/

mgon po byams pa'i bstan pa 'jig rten du ma byung gi bar du sku bzhi ngo sprod kyis gnad kyi rgyun chad med par gdul bya 'brel pa can rnams smin cing grol bar phyogs ris med par byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ rnam 'phrul rang byung rdo rje yis/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su yang bstan pa 'byung zhing byin gyis rlob pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/
