lug lo zla ba dang po la thang dpal mo dpal thang gi stod du rje btsun mi la thod par bdud rtsi gsol zhing 'od zer 'gyed pa dang*/ ma 'ongs par 'di nas phrin las 'byung ngo zhes ston pa gzigs te bstan bcos mdzad/ de phyin snga gzhis pa rnams gangs zhur mo'i mdun du song ngo*/ /zhes yang yang gsungs/ lug lo zla ba gsum pa nas brtsams te sgra dang 'od dang sa g.yo ba yang yang du byung zhing me tog gi char rtag par bab/ rtags 'di dag dge'am mi dge zhus pas byang chub sems dpa' 'khrungs ba dang 'da' ba la rtags 'di lta bu 'byung ba yin shes sam gsungs/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs su gsung chen po phyung ste khyed rang rnams zhu rgyu yod tshad zhus/ ma bde ba yod tshad dris/ rje dus mkhyen gyi gdan sa rnams kyi zhig ral gsos na bstan pa dar rgyas yun ring du 'byung bar bka' brgyud gong ma'i lung bstan yod pas ngas kyang gdan sa 'di rnams la bya ba byas/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i dgongs pa rdzogs par byas pa yin/ 'dzam gling gi bya ba skor cig tshar nyi ma do nub nub kyang sang 'char ba bzhin re zhig 'di nas mi snang bar gyur kyang phrin las kyi dbang gis gdul bya dang mthun par sprul pa'i sku shes bya kun la mkhas pa zhig gnam nas bya babs pa bzhin myur du 'ong ngo zhes gsungs/ de nas chu mo lug gi lo zla ba dgu pa'i tshes gsum la/ grub thob chen po bsnyung ba'i tshul mi mnga' yang sngar bas chung ba/ sku shed chung ba snyam byed pa'i tshe/ nye gnas rnams kyis drung du sku rim zhus pas/ zhal nas ri bo mchog rab g.yo ba la ber gas mi brten kha rog 'dug la sgoms shig gsungs/ yang*/ sprang po tshe 'di nyid nas 'das gyur kyang*// rtaḍa ni nam mkha' dag la 'byung ba yin// lus kyi lhag ma sku gdung ring bsrel 'byung*// bar dor gnas pa'i rang rig rang gsal ba// chos kyi sku dri ma med par mnyam gnas shing*//

gzhan rgyud byin gyis rlob par nus pa'i phyir// 'gro don dpag tu med pa der yang 'byung*// rang cag chos sku dri med rtogs pa'i phyir// 'chi la skrag pa rdul tsam yod ma yin// 'pho bya 'pho byed rten dang bral ba'i phyir// chos kyi sku la 'pho 'gyur med do aṃ// zhes gsungs/ yang dbon rin po che la/ sprul pa'i sku 'dir ma byon gyi bar du khyed kyis dge 'dun kun gyi rgan shos gyis la dgon pa 'di'i ched gnyer dang*/ grā pa'i skyong bran gyis shig ces dang*/ zhag bdun du gdung la ma reg cig gsungs nas/ sgra dang 'od dang me tog gi char pa la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te/ sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor bsdus te chos kyi dbyings su zhugs/ tshes bdun la gdung mchod 'bul ba'i tshe/ slob ma dag pa 'ga' zhig gis dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul zhing*/ rje nyid seng ge la chibs nas nub phyogs la gshegs pa dang*/ lha'i mchod pa dang bcas nas dga' ldan du gshegs par mthong ba byung*/ chos rje'i sku gcig jo bo shākya mu ne la dngos su thim pa lha sa pa 'gas mthong*/ yang 'ga' zhig gis chos rje'i sku 'od dmar po'i dkyil na bzhugs pa 'bum thang gi rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i thugs kar thim pa mthong*/ 'od dmar chos rje'i sku dang bcas pa shar phyogs kyi zhing du bzhud cing 'od zer tshur log gnas mtshur phu gdan sar thim pa bla ma dbu ri pas gzigs/ 'bri gung thel pa'i sgom chen zhig gis chos rje seng ge la chibs nas nam mkhar gshegs pa mjal/ tshes brgyad kyi nyin gdung zhal bstan pa'i tshe/ slob ma mchog rnams kyis la las g.yung drung dmar po'i dbus su rigs lnga he ru ka sogs gar mdzad pa mthong ba dang*/ la las mchod rten/ la las dbyangs gsal gyi yig 'bru/ la las chos rjes dngos su gsung byon pa mthong*/ skye bo kun gyi mthun snang du tshes gsum nas nyi shu bzhi'i bar du/

bar snang du 'ja' tshon gyis khengs pa dang*/ rol mo dang*/ me tog gi char dang*/ dri bzang rgyun chad med pa byung*/ tshes bcu'i nyin mo sku gdung bzhus pas ngo mtshar gyi bkod pa cher snang zhing*/ thugs ljags spyan gsum/ bde dgyes rje btsun ma spyan ras gzigs sogs kyi lha sku dang*/ yig 'bru dang*/ dung g.yas 'khyil sogs phyag mtshan dang*/ yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel dpag tu med pa byon/ de nyin lha sa shun 'phrang na chos rje chibs pa dkar po chibs nas byon te/ mgron po 'ga' la chos gsung pa dang*/ stod lung mthil du mi 'ga' 'tshogs pa la gzhon nu mdzes pa zhwa nag can zhig gis/ nga dpal ldan rang byung rdo rje yin/ khyed rnams la chos sku dri ma med pa'i ngo sprod bya'o gsung nas 'ja' bzhin du yal ba byung*/ gdung dud kyi thad sor lha'i bu rol mo thogs pa mang pos bskor ba byed pa brag sgo dbon pos mthong*/ gdung khang las 'od zer sna lnga gtsang gi phyogs su 'phro ba byung*/ rten byon pa rnams gdung rten lhun po'i dpal dang*/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten dang*/ karma'i gser 'bum sogs gdan sa gong 'og gi rten rnams kyi nang du phal cher bzhugs shing*/ bzhugs gdan dang*/ phyags lhām gyis mthar rten pa'i tshogs kyi zhing rnams mos ldan thams cad la khyab par bkram mo// de ltar grub chen nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rnam thar gsang mdzod chen mo dang*/ dgongs pa lung bstan dang*/ dus gsum dus med gcig tu rtogs shing rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i gleng gzhi dang*/ rnam thar gdug pa tshar gcod dang*/ lha chen 'dzam gling rgyan bzhengs pa'i rnam thar mu tig phreng ba dang*/ rnam thar zhal chems ma dang*/ zhal chems dang po sogs dang gsung sgros bsgrig pa'i rnam thar bka' rgya ma dang*/ gnyan ras kyis mdzad pa'i rnam thar mya ngan 'das chung ma dang*/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang ma mgon gyi gleng gzhi sogs bstan bcos thor bur byung ba rnams dang*/

mkha' spyod pas mdzad pa'i bsam yas lha yi rnga chen/ rje dpa' bo'i chos 'byung sogs yig cha mang po rnams gung bsgrigs nas dus tshigs dang snga phyi'i nges pa rnams mdzad pa po mi gsal ba'i rnam thar gyi yig rnying khung btsun zhig rnyed pa dpang por rab bgyis te cung zad rgyas pa'i tshul tu bkod pa'o// ༈¿¿grub thob chen po karma pa'i sku dngos kyi gdul byar gyur pa'i slob ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab kyang rags par rnam thar rnams su 'khod pa ni/ rgyal po chen po mo gor gan/ rnal 'byor ye shes dbang phyug /nye gnas rin chen dpal /rtogs ldan zhwa dkar ba/ zhwa ser ba/ zhwa dmar ba ste zhwa can gsum/ rtogs ldan g.yag mgo ba/ stag mgo ba/ gzig mgo ba ste mgo can gsum/ gnam mtsho ras pa/ tre bo pho bong ras pa/ a ti yon tan grags/ mdog shākya byang chub/ a mye gnam thog pa/ de'i sras gzhon nu 'bum/ gnyan ras dge 'dun 'bum/ spyan snga sta shod pa/ 'jam dbyangs blo gros seng ge /dbon rin po che/ a dbang ye shes dbang phyug /tshad ma paṇḍita/ rtse ra rdo rje grags/ gtsang pa 'dzam gling pa/ kheng ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rma bya ras pa/ gzhon nu rin po che/ 'bu chung*/ byur chung*/ 'ba' tsha lo sgom/ ye dbang gnyis/ byang sems rgyal ba ye shes/ grub chen u rgyan pa rnams so// ༈¿¿de la rgyal po mo gor gan ni/ chos nyid kyi bden pa mngon sum du rtogs pas rje nyid dang spang rtogs mnyam par byin gyis brlabs/ ༈ rnal 'byor ye shes dbang phyug ni/ tsā ri gsar ma'i rang byung gting zab phug gi gnas zhal 'byed cing tshe chu spyan 'dren pa'i slad du lan gsum bar du lung bstan mdzad nas btang bas/ phyi res gnas sgo phyed cing tshe chu spyan drangs pa mtshur phu nas/ grub thob chen pos ser sbreng gis bsus shing*/ lha sar chu 'gyed zla ba gcig gi bar du mdzad/ des na rtsod pa med pa'i grub thob chen po yin zhing*/

bkra shis ljongs kyi gnas 'dir da lta'i bar du sgrub pa po bzhugs bzhin pa yin pas bka' 'drin shin tu che'o// ༈¿¿dbon por gtogs pa'i nye gnas rin chen dpal ni/ rje nyid kyi nye gnas yun ring du mdzad pa ste/ 'dan glang thang gi rir shog ra dgon btab/ de las 'chad nas tsha sgang gi dgon pa bzung*/ rgya yul du mer bsreg pa la sogs pa'i tshe'ang 'di dang rnal 'byor ye shes dbang phyug bcas dpon slob gsum lhan duu zhugs pa yin yang gnod pas ma brdzis par grags/ ༈¿¿zhwa dkar thugs rje ye shes ni/ rje nyid kyis ri bo gandha'i gnas yig dang*/ gnas der sgrub pa po rnams kyi nyams len dang spyod lam gyi yig cha lung bstan bcas gnang ba ltar/ zhang zhung dang kha che'i yul brgyud nas/ slar ri bo gandha'i gnas sgo phyes/ dus phyis kyi bar du ri pa dang dgon pa yod par grags so// ༈¿¿zhwa dmar thugs rje nyi ma dang*/ zhwa ser thugs rje rgyal mtshan/ rtogs ldan g.yag mgo ba rnams kyis pū rong dang*/ gu ge /stod hor kyi yul rnams su thugs rje chen po'i bstan pa spel zhing yi ge drug pas 'gro don mdzad do// ༈¿¿rtogs ldan stag mgo ba dang gzig mgo ba dag gis/ mnga' ris nas rgya gar gyi grub gnas rnams su gshegs shing 'gro don mdzad do// ༈¿¿gnam mtsho ras pa sangs rgyas nyi ma ni/ gnam mtshor bsgrub pa mdzad pas mtshan der thogs shing*/ tsā rir bsgrubs pas grub pa brnyes/ sang raṃ spang du sku gshegs pa'i sku 'bum yang der yod do// ༈¿¿tre bo pho bong ras pa ni/ grub thob chen por grags shing*/ de'i slob ma chos sku yon tan grags kyis spang dgon btab/ de'i grā pa ston pa bsod nams grags so// ༈¿¿mi nyag a ti yon tan grags kyis seng ge dgon bzung*/ sag gi kha stod na sum tshug gi dgon pa btab nas dus phyis kyi bar du gdan sa'i rim pa dang*/ dar rgyas legs po yod par grags/

༈¿¿mdog shākya byang chub kyis la stod dgon pa btab nas phrin las chen po byung*/ ༈¿¿a mye gnam thog pa yab sras ni/ grub thob chen po'i sku zhang yin la rje nyid kyis dbang khrid phal cher gnang zhing*/ chos skyong ma mgon la rtsal thon par grags/ la gong gnam thog gi dgon pa bzung nas phrin las kyang cher byung ba snang*/ ༈¿¿gnyan ras dge 'dun 'bum ni/ 'khrungs yul khams kyi rdza rgyud/ rin po che la chos ka phal cher gsan zhing*/ slar yang pha zhing gser du bsgyur nas phul/ chos rting rnams rdzogs par zhus/ mtshur thel khong du bzhugs nas sku skye ba phyi ma'i 'dren pa mdzad de/ bka' brgyud kyi srol ma chad par 'dzin pa'i skyes chen no// ༈¿¿dbon po bsod nams dpal ni/ rin po che dbus su byon pa'i shul du/ zhal ta dang rgyu bca' bzhag nas karma'i byams chen gyi sku lha khang dang bcas bzhengs nas/ de'i gdan sa yang mdzad/ de nas dbyi gshis stag shod kyi dgon pa btab pas/ mtshan spyan snga stag gshod par grags/ phrin las dar rgyas che ba byung*/ ༈¿¿'jam dbyangs blo gros seng ge ni/ rje nyid kyi mched yas skya ba'i ston pa zhig ste/ dang por cung zad mi mnyes pa'i tshul gyis bka' bkyon gnang ba zhig yod kyang*/ phyis nyid gyis rjes su bzung bas ston sgom ngo mtshar can zhig byung bar grags/ ༈¿¿dbon rin po che ni/ rje'i snag dbon yin la rin po che gzhan don du gshegs pa'i rjes la mtshur phu'i gdan sa lo gsum bzhi tsam mdzad/ de'i rjes su/ rus dbon du gtogs pa'i bla ma gnas nang pas gdan sa mdzad/ ༈¿¿a dbang ye shes dbang phyug ni/ gcen mchod chen gtsug tor gyi sras yin la/ rin po che'i drung du chos ka mang du zhus nas/ 'bri rgyud 'og tshang gi mkhar du bzhugs pa'i sras bkra shis 'bum dang*/ a dpal gnyis/ bkra shis 'bum rab tu byung nas gnas nang pa'i rjes su gdan sa mdzad/ a mye a dpal la sras dbang rin/

chos rgyal/ chos blo/ dka' thub bzhi snang ba'i/ dbang rin gyis gdan sa lo bdun mdzad pa'i ring la/ nang so'i 'tshams/ mchod khang gi mkhar lan rnams legs po tshar nas khang zur du bzhugs/ ༈¿¿tshad ma paṇḍi ta ni/ mkhas pa'i nga rgyal gyis kheng ste dbu rir grub thob chen po la rjes dpag tshad ma gang yin zer ba na phyag sdigs mdzub gtad pas sna khrag them bu btang ba ltar bab pa la 'di rjes dpag tshad ma yin/ da mngon sum tshad ma dgos sam gsung bas skrag nas zhabs la gtugs pa ste dbang rin gyi rjes su mtshur phu'i gdan sa zla ba drug mdzad nas gshegs/ slar yang bla ma dbang rin pas lo kha yar gdan sar bzhugs pa'i steng du rje rang byung ba hor yul nas pheb pa'o// ༈¿¿kheng ye shes rgyal mtshan dang chung gsum ni/ bu 'bor du phrin las cher byung bar grags/ ༈¿¿rma bya ras pa byang chub brtson 'grus ni/ 'khrungs yul gtsang gi rma bya ba ste rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po'o/ /de'i sras slob dpon don grub/ bla ma nyi ma 'bum/ gzhon tshul rnams ni rim par brgyud pa'ang byung ngo*// ༈¿¿lo sgom ni/ lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du gshegs par snang*/ ༈¿¿nam mkha' 'od kyi sku'i skye ba bkra shis grags pa ni/ yul mdo khams su yab 'phags pa rta mchog gi rnal 'byor pa dbang phyug legs pa dang*/ yum sgrol ma mtsho'i sras su lcags pho spre'u la 'khrungs/ sku skye snga ma'i dad pas mtshams sbyar nas dbus su phebs nas stag lung pa sku yal pa la gdams pa zhus/ shin tu dgyes par mdzad de/ chos drug dang*/ phag mo khams gsum skyed rim sogs chos mtha' chod par gnang*/ sangs rgyas yar byon gyis kyang thugs rjes bzung nas lo mang por sgrub par mdzad/ ston chu sgo la g.yag du btsugs nas mtshan g.yag ru ras par grags/ slob ma'ang chos kyis 'brel pa sum brgya tsam dang*/ sgom chen nyams myong dang ldan pa mang du byung*/ chos rje karma pa dang mtshams khong du mjal/

dad pa dpag tu med pa skyes te/ khyod sngon dus gsum mkhyen pa'i slob ma yin/ skye ba phyi ma kho bo'i slob mar 'gyur/ da lta nyams len dngos gzhi 'di ltar gyis shes gdams ngag gnad bkrol te gnang*/ dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa gsum pa chu pho rta la gshegs/
